docs.description: Translated from the Russian by Irene Aleksanova First published 1986 Revised from the 1983 Russian edition From the Editor In this educational aid, intended for high-school students, an attempt has been made to classify the problems encountered in high-school mathematics by their solution methods. It was rather difficult to attain the aim the authors set for them­ selves. On one hand, a detailed classification of problems by methods of solution would require the consideration of a large number of con­ crete problems and, on the other hand, a schematic classification would not yield a useful aid for solving different kinds of problems. There­ fore, alongside a large number of worked problems, the book includes many problems (about 2500) for the reader to solve. In addition to the traditional problems from the course of high- school mathematics, the book includes methods for solving simple differential and integral calculus problems as well as problems which require the use of coordinates and vector algebra. These sections only include problems whose solutions require knowledge that is beyond the scope of high-school mathematics. Some problems in the book can only be solved by a combined application of the knowledge from the traditional and new divisions of mathematics. These include, for instance, problems connected with the calculation of limits, derivatives and antiderivatives of functions which must first be simplified by means of identity transformations. The authors consider all the most frequent methods of solving problems from the high-school course of mathematics. The fact that many problems are not followed by their solutions makes it possible to use the book for preparing for the entrance examinations to higher educational establishments. From the Authors Our aim when writing this book was to help students to systema­ tize their knowledge of problem solving. The structure of the book Follows from this aim, hence each section begins with some theory (definitions, principal theorems and formulas) which must be known in order to cope with the subsequent problems without resorting to textbooks. Next the method of solving a specific kind of problem is indicated, followed by an example showing how to use the method. The remaining problems are left for the reader to solve. We feel that this form of presentation is the best way of helping the student actively master the methods of problem solving. In a num­ ber of cases, the solution presented is not the briefest or most elegant. This is due, first of all, to our wish to give the most visual application to the method being suggested, rather than to demonstrate non- standard approaches. We arranged the problems not followed by answers or hints in order of increasing difficulty, fully realizing that every reader may want to change the sequence of the problems according to his knowl­edge or inclination. Plane geometry and solid geometry, the tradi­tional divisions of school mathematics, are, in the main, represented by problems on calculations. The material on solid geometry was not structured strictly in the way we explained above since, as distinct from problems in plane geometry, for which the solution methods can be neatly classified, any non-trivia1 problem in solid geometry may require the use of several different methods. Thus the problems considered in Chapter 12 are followed by quite detailed solutions, in which the techniques which reduce the original problem to simpler ones are emphasized. Chapters 6-9 contain problems in mathematical analysis. Many of these should be solved using traditional high-school mathematics. Chapter 13 includes some very difficult problems in geometry whose solution can be considerably simplified with the use of vectors and the method of coordinates. Since the theory of relativity and the related divisions of mathe­matics have drawn considerable attention lately, we deemed it neces­sary to include combinatorics and elements of relativity theory. We nave taken into account that this material is absolutely new to the majority of readers and so the theory part of the chapter is somewhat larger than those in the other chapters. A double numeration system was adopted for both the problems and examples. The first digit indicates the number of the section and the other digit, the number of the problem or example within the sec­tion. An asterisk indicates a difficult problem and two asterisks mean that the problem is followed by a complete solution (given in “Answers and Hints” at the end of the book). In conclusion, we wish to express our gratitude to all those who helped us to improve the structure and content of the book by their advice and remarks, especially to N. V. Reveruk who took part in writing Chapter 13 and who prepared some of the problems for it. Our thanks also go to K. K. Andreev who thoroughly studied the chapters on mathematical analysis and made valuable remarks. The authors are especially grateful to V. I. Blagodatskikh whose cordial attention was felt at every stage of writing this book.

docs.description: This organic chemistry textbook offers a fresh approach to a rapidly evolving field. Acknowledging the challenges posed by the constant discovery of new substances, properties, and advanced investigative methods, the authors prioritize  general principles  over exhaustive descriptive content. They believe this focus on foundational concepts, rooted in A.M. Butlerov's theory of chemical structure and augmented by modern understanding of chemical bonds and reaction mechanisms, is the most effective way to grasp the subject. This approach transforms the study of organic transformations from a collection of isolated facts into a coherent system. The book's primary goal is to make learning organic chemistry more accessible by integrating theory with practical application. It delves into the techniques for synthesizing specific substances, their properties, and their real-world uses, particularly in industry, agriculture, and medicine. The content is organized by  functional groups , which are key to understanding chemical behavior, starting with hydrocarbons and progressing through their derivatives. docs.description: Un grand merci à Henri Leveque pour le scan original. Traduit du russe par V. Granovski et V. Kolimêev Ce livre constitue un cours d’électrotechnique destiné à l’usage des élèves ingénieurs qui, non spécialisés en électrotechnique, auront toutefois besoin de sérieuses connaissances dans ce domaine pour l’exercice de leur métier. L’électrotechnique, en tant que science, étudie d’une part les phénomènes électriques et magnétiques et d’autre part, leurs appli­cations pratiques. L’industrie énergétique moderne est représentée principalement par des usines productrices d’énergie électrique. L’énergie électrique est produite aux centrales équipées d’alternateurs et de génératrices. Elle est transformée aux sous-stations à l’aide d’appareils électri­ques pour être ensuite transportée par des lignes de réseaux élec­triques et distribuée aux récepteurs. La fabrication de machines électriques et de transformateurs occupe un important secteur industriel. Les machines-outils et les mécanismes sont dans la plupart des cas à commande électrique, c’est-à-dire sont entraînés par des moteurs électriques. La technique des mesures utilise largement les appareils et dis­ positifs électriques. Les mesures des grandeurs non électriques à l’aide d’appareils électriques font l’objet d’une discipline à part. La radiotechnique et l’électronique qui constituent depuis longtemps des branches distinctes ont une base théorique commune avec l’électrotechnique et se sont développées au début comme des branches de cette dernière. Les systèmes de commande automatique et de régulation sont le plus souvent des systèmes d’automatismes électriques équipés d’amplificateurs électroniques, de convertisseurs, de relais et d’au­ tres appareils électriques et électromagnétiques. Les calculatrices modernes effectuent des calculs complexes, résolvent des problèmes logiques compliqués et permettent la simu­lation de phénomènes physiques. Les principaux organes de ces machines sont réalisés à partir des appareils et dispositifs électriques, électromagnétiques et électroniques.  Cet emploi à une échelle industrielle des divers dispositifs et équipements électrotechniques et radiotechniques implique la con­ sidération des notions fondamentales du champ électromagnétique. L’étude de certains phénomènes, qui fait intervenir la théorie du champ électromagnétique, permet de sortir du cercle étroit de notions liées uniquement aux circuits électriques et de mieux com­ prendre le sens physique des phénomènes électriques et magnétiques. Les chapitres I, II, III, IV, V, VII, VIII, XV, XVII, XVIII ainsi que les Annexes sont rédigés par A. Blajkine (le chapitre XVII en collaboration avec G. Barabanov), les chapitres VI, XIV, XVI, XIX par B. Frolov (le chapitre XVI en collaboration avec E. Sivérine), les chapitres IX, X par A. Teplinski, les chapitres XII, XIII par E. Fabrikant, le chapitre XI par V. Bessekerski. On doit à A. Blajkine la révision complète de l’ouvrage.

docs.description: This collection contains four works by Kazakevich: Star, Two Men in the Steppe, By the Light of Day and The Blue Notebook. It is prefaced by the tribute that the famous Soviet poet Alexander Tvardovsky wrote in memory of his friend in 1962. The book also contains extracts from Kazakevichís diaries and letters referring to the stories published here. Translated from the Russian. Illustrations by Anatoly Zykov.  Contents PREFACE. In Memory of a Friend by A. Tvardovsky. Translated by Robert Daglish 7 STAR. Translated by Leonard Stoklitsky 15 TWO MEN IN THE STEPPE. Translated by Robert Daglish 105 BY THE LIGHT OF DAY. Translated by Fainna Glagoleva 175 THE BLUE NOTEBOOK. Translated by Ralph Parker 231 NOTES 345 About the author Emmanuel Kazakevich (1913 - 1962) was a Soviet author, poet and playwright of Jewish extraction, he wrote in Russian and Yiddish. His debut short story Zvezda ("Star", 1947, adapted into a film in 1949 (remake - film 2002)) was an instant success and he was awarded a Stalin Prize for literature. This was followed by other books about the war - Two Men in the Steppe, Heart of a Friend, Spring on the Oder, The House in the Square, and several stories, including By the Light of Day. Kazakevichís last work was a short novel about Lenin titled The Blue Notebook. This exercise book actually existed. In it Lenin noted down his thoughts, plans and extracts from other writers. He used it for his famous political treatise The State and Revolution, which Lenin wrote in the tense days that preceded the Great October Revolution of 1917, expounding the theory of building a socialist state. Kazakevich continued with Lenin as a main character in another story, "Enemies", written in his last year, and it is likely that he was planning to bring them together within a larger novel about Lenin. However, his sudden passing away in the summer of 1962 meant that those plans were left unfulfilled. Anatoly Zykov (1930 - 2008) was a Russian artist and illustrator, a member of the Union of Artists of the USSR. In 1980, Zykov was awarded the honorary title "Honored Artist of the RSFSR", and in 1988 - "People's Artist of the RSFSR". For a series of graphic works about A. S. Pushkin, he received the PAX silver medal in 2000, the Pushkin gold medal of the creative unions of Russia in 1999 and was a winner of the Sholokhov Prize (2008). Among his main works are illustrations for "Volokolamsk Highway" by A. Beck (1957), the Maxim Gorky trilogy and work "Childhood", "In the World", "My Universities" (1973) and "Mothers" (1968), "The Fate of a Man" M. A. Sholokhov (1966), the trilogy of L. N. Tolstoy "Childhood", "Boyhood", "Youth" (1977-1981); graphic series "Mother" (1967), "On the Volga" (1966), "About France" (1966), a cycle of graphic sheets "Through the storms of fate. Pushkin "(1987-1995)," Based on the lyrics of Pushkin "(1988-1990).

docs.description: Fixed point theorems have numerous applications in mathematics. Most of the theorems ensuring the existence of solutions for differential, integral, operator, or other equations can be reduced to fixed point theorems. They are also used in new areas of mathematical applications, e.g., in mathematical economics, game theory, etc. The subject of this book is essentially one single problem: whether a closed interval, square, disc, or sphere has the fixed point property. The theory of fixed points belongs to topology, a part of mathematics created at the end of the nineteenth century, and makes extensive use of such topological notions as continuity, compactness, homotopy, and the degree of a mapping. Another aim of the book is to show how combinatorial considerations related to decomposition (triangulation) of figures into distinct parts called faces (simplexes) adjoining each other in a regular fashion are used in this theory. docs.description: The present book deals with methods for calculating the thermodynamic characteristics of individual substances and petroleum fractions, as well as the heats of reactions, equilibrium constants, and equilibrium compositions. It presents the thermodynamic functions of simple substances, hydrocarbons, and their derivatives, together with thermodynamic characteristics of basic production processes. Considerable attention is given to the application of thermodynamic methods to the analysis of reaction mechanisms and kinetics, and to the heat regimes of industrial reactors. The book is intended for scientists, engineers, and technicians working in institutes and enterprises of the chemical, petrochemical, and related industries. **Contents:** Application of Thermodynamic Relations to Calculations of Chemical Processes; Calculations of Heats, Equilibrium Constants, and Equilibrium Compositions of Simple Reactions; Calculation of the Equilibrium Composition of Complex Reactions; Adiabatic Equilibrium Reactions; Calculations of Heats of Industrial Hydrocarbon Treatment Processes; Thermodynamics of Mutual Hydrocarbon Conversion Reactions; Thermodynamics of Reactions of Hydrocarbons and Their Derivatives with the Evolution or Absorption of Hydrogen; Production of Synthesis Gas and Syntheses Based on CO and CO₂; Thermodynamics of Chemical Processes in Natural Gas Treatment. Appendices: Methods of Calculating the Standard Thermodynamic Functions of Hydrocarbons and Their Derivatives; Tables of Standard Thermodynamic Functions for Simple Substances, Selected Inorganic Compounds, Hydrocarbons, and Their Derivatives. Professor Yuri Zhorov, Doctor of Sciences (Chemistry), is a member of the staff of the Gubkin Petrochemical and Gas Industry Institute, Moscow. He is a well-known specialist in the investigation, calculation, and physical and mathematical modelling of petroleum refining, hydrocarbon gas, and petrochemical processes. The mathematical models and optimisation algorithms developed by Yuri M. Zhorov are widely employed by specialists in the USSR, and have been presented at both national and international conferences and congresses. In recent years, Professor Zhorov has conducted extensive research on the thermodynamic analysis of petrochemical processes and has taught courses on the fundamentals of chemical thermodynamics and its application in industrial chemistry. The present book is based on the data he has accumulated and the conclusions he has drawn from this work. He is the author of nine monographs and over 300 articles in Soviet and foreign journals. His monographs Isomerization of Hydrocarbons and Modelling of Physicochemical Processes of Petroleum Refining and Petrochemistry  (both in Russian), among others, have received recognition from specialists in the USSR and abroad. Translated from the Russian by G. Leib

docs.description: L’obstétrique et la gynécologie sont deux branches d'une même science: celle des processus physiologiques et pathologiques qui se produisent dans l’organisme féminin. L'obstétrique est la science de la physiologie et de la pathologie de la grossesse, de l ’accouchement et des suites de couches. Tout ce qui concerne le nouveau-né fait également partie de l ’obstétrique. La gynécologie est la science des maladies des organes génitaux féminins, de la manière de les diagnostiquer, de les prévenir, de les traiter. L’assistance en obstétrique et en gynécologie est organisée suivant les principes généraux de l ’assistance médicale soviétique : orientation prophylactique, gratuité, accessibilité pour tous, liaison entre la science et la pratique, et cependant, l ’obstétrique présente certaines particularités qui la distinguent des autres disciplines. Les obstétriciens-gynécologistes et les sages-femmes prodiguent leur aide non seulement en cas de maladie (comme les médecins et les chirurgiens) mais aussi au cours de processus purement physiologiques, tels que la grossesse et l ’accouchement. Les médecins et les sages-femmes travaillant dans le domaine de l ’obstétrique sont responsables non d’un seul être humain, comme les spécialistes d’autres branches de la médecine, mais de deux: la mère et l’enfant. L’assistance en obstétrique a un caractère de masse: l'aide médicale au cours de l ’accouchement est prodiguée chaque année à des millions de femmes en Union Soviétique. Le besoin de l'aide d’un accoucheur survient souvent subitement. L’assistance obstétricale d’urgence est plus souvent demandée que les autres formes d’assistance médicale. La prophylaxie, qui est à la base de toutes les branches de la médecine soviétique, est le fondement de l ’organisation de l ’aide obstétricale. Les succès de l ’aide thérapeutique et prophylactique aux femmes enceintes ou en couches, aux nouveau-nés et aux malades de gynécologie dépendent de la façon dont le travail est organisé. Les médecins et les sages-femmes travaillant à sauvegarder la santé de la mère et de l ’enfant sont aussi des organisateurs des services de santé. Le caractère de masse de l ’assistance thérapeutique et prophylactique aux femmes, la difficulté et l'importance des tâches de l ’obstétrique et de la gynécologie confèrent à cette discipline médicale une place prépondérante. docs.description: La química orgánica atraviesa un período de notable desarrollo caracterizado por el descubrimiento de nuevas sustancias con propiedades excepcionales y la creación de compuestos innovadores de aplicación práctica en diversas áreas. Este progreso se apoya en el uso de métodos modernos de investigación fundamentados en la física y en una profundización de las nociones teóricas. Sin embargo, esto plantea retos educativos, ya que es necesario condensar una gran cantidad de material en los planes de estudio. Los autores abogan por priorizar las leyes generales de la química orgánica, dejando en segundo plano el contenido puramente descriptivo, y basan su enfoque en la teoría de la estructura química de Bútlerov, complementada con una mejor comprensión de los enlaces químicos y las reacciones orgánicas. Este enfoque permite clasificar las reacciones de manera sistemática y facilitar su aprendizaje. El libro sigue una clasificación basada en los grupos funcionales, que determinan el comportamiento químico de los compuestos orgánicos. Se abordan primero los hidrocarburos y luego sus derivados, incluyendo halogenados e hidroxílicos, destacando aquellos compuestos de relevancia práctica en la industria, agricultura y medicina. Para esta nueva edición, los autores han incorporado recomendaciones de instituciones académicas como las escuelas politécnicas de Moscú y Leningrado, ajustando el contenido al programa aprobado en 1974 para especialidades como química analítica y química de explotaciones petrolíferas. Finalmente, los autores invitan a los lectores a proporcionar observaciones críticas para mejorar la obra en futuras ediciones. Traducido del ruso por Neiml Sosa Todos los créditos a los cargadores originales.  Nota: La calidad del escaneo es promedio

docs.description: “Sister Carrie”  by Theodore Dreiser is a seminal work of American naturalism that chronicles the life of Caroline "Carrie" Meeber, a young woman who moves from her rural home to Chicago in pursuit of a better life. Initially, Carrie faces poverty and struggles to find steady employment. She becomes entangled with Charles Drouet, a charming salesman who introduces her to a more glamorous lifestyle. Eventually, she meets George Hurstwood, a middle-aged manager of a saloon, and the two embark on a romantic affair. Hurstwood steals money and persuades Carrie to flee with him to New York. However, their fortunes decline as Hurstwood's circumstances deteriorate, while Carrie begins to rise as an actress. The novel explores themes of ambition, desire, and the social forces that shape human destiny. Carrie’s journey illustrates the allure and pitfalls of the American Dream, as her material success comes at the cost of emotional fulfilment. Hurstwood, in contrast, represents the decline of those unable to adapt to changing societal pressures. Dreiser’s unflinching portrayal of economic struggles, class disparity, and moral ambiguity underscores the harsh realities of urban life at the turn of the 20th century, making  Sister Carrie  a powerful commentary on the complexities of modern existence. Foreword by I. Dubashinsky Commentary by D. Zhivotovskaya and E. Zeltyn Artist E. Golyakhovsky

docs.description: Esta recopilación reúne una amplia serie de problemas de electrodinámica clásica utilizados durante muchos años en el Instituto de Ingeniería y Física de Moscú tanto en clases prácticas como en tareas individuales para estudiantes. La mayoría de los ejercicios son originales e incluyen también problemas modelo que ilustran la metodología de resolución. Los problemas presentan distintos niveles de dificultad, aunque la mayoría está al alcance de estudiantes que han estudiado la teoría del campo electromagnético. El libro ofrece soluciones detalladas en los casos en que se introducen nuevas ideas o métodos, mientras que otros problemas similares se presentan con respuestas y orientaciones breves, útiles para el autoaprendizaje y el control del progreso. El contenido abarca la electrodinámica en el vacío, incorporando conceptos de densidad de carga y corriente en distintas formas, lo que permite ampliar el tratamiento a situaciones más generales. Cada capítulo incluye una introducción teórica y apéndices con herramientas matemáticas esenciales, como análisis vectorial, cálculo tensorial y funciones especiales, facilitando así la resolución eficiente de los problemas y reduciendo la carga de consulta externa. docs.description: This text reflects the authors' unique approach to the study of the basic types of partial differential equations of mathematical physics. The system­ atic presentation of the material offers the reader a natural entree to the subject. Each of the basic types of equations which are to be studied is motivated by its physical origins. The derivation of an equation from the physics to its final mathematical structure is very instructive to the student. The authors have gone to great length to make clear the meaning of a solution to an initial value or boundary-value problem. Various methods of solving such problems are treated in great detail, as are the questions of existence and uniqueness of solutions. Thus, the student gains an apprecia­ tion of the theoretical foundations of the subject and simultaneously acquires the manipulative skills for solving such problems. The exercises which accompany each chapter have been selected to test the student’s ability both to formulate the correct mathematical statement of the problem and to apply the appropriate method for its solution. The applications treated by the authors are non-trivial and are completely worked out in detail. The present volume covers the two dimensional class of partial differential equations of mathematical physics and is well suited as a basic text for both the undergraduate and graduate level at the university. The second volume will cover the three dimensional counterparts of the present volume and contain an additional chapter on the special functions which arise in mathe­ matical physics.

docs.description: This book offers an introductory treatment of mathematical programming and the numerical methods used to solve extremal and optimisation problems. Based on many years of teaching at Moscow University, it is designed as a first systematic exposure to the subject rather than as a reference manual. Accordingly, the emphasis is on fundamental ideas, core methods, and the logical structure of optimisation theory, not on providing ready-made algorithms for every practical problem. The book develops from basic concepts and mathematical foundations to linear, nonlinear, and convex programming, with particular attention to optimality conditions, stability, and convergence of numerical methods. It covers key techniques such as penalty functions, regularisation, gradient-based methods, and modified Lagrange functions, while also explaining the role of one-dimensional minimisation and unconstrained optimisation within broader programming frameworks. Throughout, the author maintains a critical focus on efficiency, convergence rates, and practical reliability, making the book especially suitable for students and readers seeking a rigorous but accessible introduction to mathematical programming. docs.description: This textbook of linear algebra, which is based on a course of lectures read by the authors at Moscow University, is intended for university students specializing in applied mathematics and physics. If discusses matrices and determinants, linear systems ot equations, finite dimensional vector and Euclidean spaces, linear functionals and linear operators in these spaces, the theory of linear and quadratic forms, the theory of tensors, classification of second-degree surfaces and problems of group representations. Because of the increased emphasis on computational methods the book presents iteration methods of solving linear systems of equations and corresponding eigenvalue problems as well as A. N. Tychonoff's regularization method as applied to incorrectly set problems of linear algebra. Professor Vladimir Aleksandrovich Ilyin is Head of a Chair at Moscow State University and Senior Research Worker at the Institute of Mathematics of the USSR Academy of Sciences. He is a recipient of the Lomonosov Prize and the USSR State Prize. He is the author of a number of university textbooks and more than one hundred scientific papers on the theory of partial differential equations, the theory of functions and functional analysis, and the spectral theory of differential operators. His most important scientific achievements concern the establishment of exact conditions for the expansion of elliptic operators in eigenfunctions, the determination of exact conditions for the convergence of spectral expansions corresponding to non-self-adjoint differential operators, and the search for conditions ensuring the solvability of boundary-value and mixed problems for differential operators with non-smooth coefficients and non-smooth boundary manifolds. Professor Eduard Genrikhovich Poznyak, Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences, is a lecturer in mathematics at the Physics Department of Moscow State University and a recipient of the USSR State Prize. He is the author of several university textbooks and more than seventy scientific papers dealing with various problems of geometry and differential equations related to geometry. His most important results are connected with the theory of isometric embedding of two-dimensional Riemannian manifolds of negative curvature into Euclidean spaces, as well as investigations connected with Lobachevskian geometry and with various branches of natural science. docs.description: El libro  V. Milántiev, S. Temkó – Física del Plasma (Física al Alcance de Todos)  ofrece una introducción accesible y amena al fascinante mundo del plasma, el cuarto estado de la materia. A lo largo de sus catorce capítulos, el lector encontrará explicaciones sobre las cargas en los gases, los métodos experimentales para estudiar el plasma y las propiedades termodinámicas de este estado. Se abordan fenómenos fundamentales de transporte, el comportamiento del plasma en campos eléctricos y magnéticos, así como su descripción como un fluido, incluyendo oscilaciones, ondas y propagación de ondas radioeléctricas. El libro combina rigor científico con claridad, permitiendo comprender incluso los aspectos más complejos de este campo. Además, el texto introduce al lector en fenómenos avanzados como efectos no lineales, turbulencia, radiación y ondas de choque en el plasma, y concluye con perspectivas sobre el futuro de la investigación y la presencia del plasma en el universo. Cada capítulo ofrece problemas y ejemplos concretos que facilitan la comprensión práctica de los conceptos teóricos, haciendo de esta obra un recurso valioso tanto para estudiantes como para aficionados a la física que desean explorar el plasma más allá de la teoría convencional. Traducido del ruso por el ingeniero Antonio Ballesteros Elías Todos los créditos a los uploaders originales.

docs.description: This supplementary book is intended for introductory physics courses. It is assumed that the student has already studied the elementary concepts of wave motion, since the author feels that such concepts are basic to the understanding of quantum theory. The author’s aim is to show that the basic concepts of quantum mechanics can be defined without re­ course to higher mathematics. The main difficulty for the reader will lie here in assimilating some of the entirely novel concepts associated with quantum mechanics. Should he prove equal to the challenge, an unparalleled achievement of the human mind will be his to contemplate—a unique feat that has altered all of our ideas on the nature of motion. The exposition of material in this book follows a systematic conceptual, rather than historic, sequence. Ideas presented in their logical continuity will be grasped more fully. As we go along, however, an occasional excursion into history proves to be useful. The inevitable evolution of ideas can be better understood when viewed in retrospect.

As a child, she dreamed first of becoming a ballerina and then an architect, but in 1959 she graduated from the Moscow Polygraphical Institute and became a graphic artist. In 1964, Galina began working for leading Moscow publishers as an illustrator of children’s books. She travelled widely, and her new impressions inspired interesting works including drawings, lithographs, engravings, and etchings. In 1969, she was appointed head designer of Murzilka, the popular children’s magazine. Galina has taken part in many exhibitions in the Soviet Union and abroad, including in Finland, West Berlin, Austria, Japan, and Italy. docs.description: A political biography of Soviet leader Maxim Litvinov. Maxim Litvinov was a prominent Soviet diplomat and revolutionary, whose life spanned the turbulent years of the early Soviet Union. As an agent of the Iskra, he played a significant role in underground activities in Russia, later becoming a key figure in the diplomatic sphere. His involvement in international affairs began with his work in Berlin and Paris, followed by years in London. Litvinov’s career reached new heights when he became the Soviet Union’s ambassador, representing the people as a herald of peace. His diplomatic work included key assignments in Copenhagen, Estonia, and Genoa, and he later played a crucial role in the Soviet missions to Washington and the League of Nations. Despite facing difficult times, Litvinov’s persistence led to his eventual comeback, marking the final years of his career as one of significant influence on Soviet foreign policy. docs.description: "Hot Snow" by Yuri Bondarev is a gripping war novel set during the Battle of Stalingrad in World War II. It tells the story of a Red Army anti-tank battery facing a relentless German assault led by General von Manstein. Despite overwhelming odds and severe losses, the Soviet soldiers manage to halt the German advance. The novel highlights themes of bravery, sacrifice, and camaraderie among the soldiers, and ends with General Lieutenant Bessonov awarding the surviving soldiers for their heroic efforts. Bondarev's own experiences as a battery commander during the war add a layer of authenticity and emotional depth to the narrative. docs.creator: Yu. I. Yefremov ( Ed.)
docs.description: The soft landing of the automatic lunar probe  Luna-13  on the surface of the Moon marked a new stage in lunar research conducted by means of space vehicles.  Luna-13  continued the long series of lunar investigations that began with the launch of the first Moon rocket in 1959. The panoramic views of the lunar surface transmitted by  Luna-13  substantially expanded the material available for studying the structure of the Moon’s surface. These observations confirmed earlier conclusions regarding the absence of a significant dust layer, the presence of numerous surface rocks, and the predominance of negative relief forms. In addition,  Luna-13  carried out the first direct measurements of the physico-mechanical properties of the surface layer of lunar soil, representing a further important advance in the study of the Moon’s nature. The panoramic images obtained by  Luna-13  are reproduced in this book with documentary accuracy, together with preliminary analyses and detailed descriptions of the experiments conducted to investigate the physico-mechanical properties of the Moon’s surface layer. docs.description: T h e matrix calculus is widely applied nowadays in various branches of mathematics, mechanics, theoretical physics, theoretical electrical engineer­ ing, etc. However, neither in the Soviet nor the foreign literature is there a book that gives a sufficiently complete account of the problems of matrix theory and of its diverse applications. The present book is an attempt to fill this gap in the mathematical literature. The book is based on lecture courses on the theory of matrices and its applications that the author has given several times in the course of the last seventeen years at the Universities of Moscow and Tiflis and at the Moscow Institute of Physical Technology. The book is meant not only for mathematicians (undergraduates and research students) but also for specialists in allied fields (physics, engi­ neering) who are interested in mathematics and its applications. Therefore the author has endeavoured to make his account of the material as accessible as possible, assuming only that the reader is acquainted with the theory of determinants and with the usual course of higher mathematic? within the programme of higher technical education.

docs.description: पृथ्वी का आकार क्या है? एक अजीब सवाल, है ना? दुनिया का एक ग्लोब। यह दौर है। मेरे और आपके लिए यह स्पष्ट है ।  हम 20 वीं सदी के लोग हैं ।  घास हरी है, आकाश नीला है और दुनिया गोल है ।  हम इसे बचपन से ही जानते हैं ।  लेकिन क्या यह वास्तव में इतना स्पष्ट है? देश में बाहर जाओ ।  सबसे बड़े क्षेत्र के बीच में चलें, जब तक कि आप देख सकें कि दूर क्षितिज तक घास और फूल हैं ।  क्या यह गोल दिखता है? क्या आप उभार देख सकते हैं? नहीं।. यह आपके सामने क्षितिज के लिए एक पैनकेक के रूप में फ्लैट है ।  हर झाड़ी और पेड़, हर छोटी पहाड़ी स्पष्ट रूप से बाहर खड़ी है ।  तो कौन कहता है कि दुनिया गोल है? जब कंप्यूटर का उपयोग उपग्रहों की जानकारी से पृथ्वी की सतह की गणना करने के लिए किया गया, तो यह पाया गया कि हमारे ग्रह का आकार इतना सरल नहीं है ।  यह थोड़ा नाशपाती के आकार का होता है ।  उत्तरी गोलार्ध ध्रुव की ओर थोड़ा ऊपर फैला हुआ है, और दक्षिणी गोलार्ध में स्थित है ।  इसकी सतह पर डेंट और धक्कों हैं ।  और यदि आप भूमध्य रेखा पर मध्य के माध्यम से पृथ्वी को काट सकते हैं तो परिणाम एक सर्कल होगा जो सच से थोड़ा बाहर होगा ।  तो यह उस पर थोड़ा टेढ़ा है ।  इस आकृति को क्या कहा जाना चाहिए? वैज्ञानिकों ने सभी प्रकार के नामों की कोशिश की ।  अंत में उन्होंने "जियोइड"चुना ।  यह" जियो"," पृथ्वी "के लिए ग्रीक और" ईडोस","व्यू" के लिए ग्रीक से बना है ।  तो यह सब वास्तव में मतलब है कि पृथ्वी जैसा है ।  वास्तव में पृथ्वी थोड़ा अपूर्ण क्षेत्र है ।  लोगों को यह कैसे पता चला यह एक लंबी और दिलचस्प कहानी है ।  और यही इस पुस्तक के बारे में है ।  डायना मिलर द्वारा पुस्तक का रूसी से अंग्रेजी में अनुवाद किया गया था ।  अद्भुत चित्र यूरी स्मोलनिकोव द्वारा तैयार किए गए हैं ।  अंग्रेजी संस्करण पुस्तक 1984 में रेडुगा द्वारा प्रकाशित की गई थी ।  हिंदी संस्करण का अनुवाद योगेंद्र नागपाल ने किया था और रादुगा द्वारा प्रकाशित किया गया था ।

docs.description: This is the second book of our series “Higher Mathematics’. The series consists of the following three books: (1) Fundamentals of Linear Algebra and Analytical Geometry; (2) Differential and Integral Calculus; (3) Differential Equations. Multiple Integrals. Series. Functions of a Complex Variable. The book presupposes no special preparation beyond the ability to perform ordinary algebraic operations and some elementary knowledge of geometry acquired at high school. Though the text (Chapters 1 to 7) centres on calculus of one variable, analytic geometry and calculus of several variables are also developed (in Chapter 8). The closing chapter (9) deals with series. We think that this book and the first book of the series should be studied parallelly. Therefore, both books are provided with relevant cross-references. Our series “Higher Mathematics” will be completed with a book of problems for all the three books. The latter will appear in 1983. docs.description: Este libro es una exploración rigurosa y estructurada del cálculo moderno, diseñado para proporcionar al lector una comprensión profunda de los fundamentos teóricos y las aplicaciones del análisis matemático. Comenzando con la noción de integral definida, se introducen conceptos esenciales como las sumas superiores e inferiores, la condición de integrabilidad y las propiedades fundamentales de la integral. A lo largo del texto, se refuerza el vínculo entre teoría y práctica mediante fórmulas clave como el valor medio y reglas de integración, con atención especial a la continuidad, la acotación y el comportamiento de funciones discontinuas. Más allá de la integral en una variable, la obra se adentra en el análisis multivariable, desarrollando las ideas de límite, continuidad, derivadas parciales y diferenciales de orden superior, junto con criterios para encontrar extremos locales y condicionados. La teoría se enriquece con aplicaciones geométricas y físicas: cálculo de longitudes de arco, envolventes, osculaciones, y funciones implícitas. A través de este recorrido, el lector no sólo adquiere herramientas de cálculo, sino también una apreciación de su poder explicativo en geometría, física y optimización. Es una obra ideal para quienes buscan una base sólida y elegante del análisis matemático. Traducido del rus por la licaeda en motomáticas aplicadas M. Andriánova y el ingeneiro K. Medkov Todos los créditos a los uploaders originales.

docs.creator: V. L. Bonch-Bruyevich
docs.description: The current interest in solid state theory is, in the main, the result of confluence of two factors: recent progress in the problem of many bodies in quantum-statistical mechanics, and demands of practical semiconductor physics occasioned, in turn, by the ever increasing use of solid state devices in science and technology. Professor Bonch-Bruyevich has rendered a real and welltimed service in pulling together the available information on heavily doped semiconductors, because the problems associated with these materials are among the most pressing in modern applied and theoretical physics. The reader will find here a detailed review of the many-electron approach to the theory of doped semiconductors, as well as a systematic exposition of the many studies done in this area (much of it by the author and his students). Some of the interesting topics covered are the energy spectrum of heavily doped semiconductors, pulse distributions in them, as well as screening effects and absorption of electromagnetic waves. The necessary mathematical machinery of the theory is explained simply and concisely. It is hoped that the book will prove of value not only to specialists in the field, but also to a wider group of solid-state theoreticians and experimentalists. Translation Editor: Robert S. Knox

docs.description: Este manual abarca los conceptos fundamentales de la teoría de probabilidades, la teoría de procesos aleatorios y la estadística matemática. Incluye definiciones, axiomas, fórmulas y métodos usados en razonamientos probabilísticos, como las funciones características, transformadas de Laplace, representaciones espectrales y ecuaciones diferenciales en procesos aleatorios. Los métodos se ilustran con ejemplos sencillos para facilitar su comprensión y aplicación práctica. El libro está dirigido tanto a lectores que buscan familiarizarse con los conceptos sin profundizar en demostraciones matemáticas, como a especialistas que requieren un material informativo para su trabajo científico. Hasta la fecha, no existía un libro que reuniera estos temas de forma tan completa. En la segunda parte, se presentan las nociones principales de la teoría de procesos aleatorios y campos, cubriendo temas como la continuidad absoluta de medidas, teoremas límite y clases importantes de procesos como martingalas, procesos estacionarios y de Markov. La tercera parte aborda los fundamentos de la estadística matemática y sus métodos para formular hipótesis y estimar parámetros en distribuciones probabilísticas, incluyendo aspectos teóricos de la estadística de procesos aleatorios. Por su volumen, no se incluyen aplicaciones extensas ni tablas estadísticas, pero sí se mencionan teorías aplicadas como la teoría de fiabilidad y juegos estocásticos para ilustrar conceptos. El manual es modular, con capítulos y puntos independientes, facilitando su uso según las necesidades del lector. Traduciso del ruso por el ingeniero K. Medkov y S. Kaláshik Todos los créditos a los uploaders originales.

docs.creator: N. Efimov
docs.description: Este libro ofrece una exposición completa y progresiva de la geometría analítica en el plano y en el espacio. En la primera parte se presentan los fundamentos: los sistemas de coordenadas en la recta y en el plano, las transformaciones básicas entre sistemas cartesianos y polares, y los métodos elementales para calcular distancias, áreas y divisiones de segmentos. A continuación, se desarrolla de forma sistemática la teoría de las líneas, desde su representación mediante ecuaciones hasta el estudio detallado de las líneas de primer y segundo orden. La elipse, la hipérbola y la parábola se analizan con atención especial a su forma, sus propiedades métricas y ópticas, así como a sus ecuaciones canónicas y paramétricas. También se muestra cómo transformar ecuaciones por medio de cambios de coordenadas para obtener representaciones más simples y claras. La segunda parte introduce al lector en la geometría analítica del espacio. Se estudian las coordenadas tridimensionales, los vectores y sus operaciones fundamentales, incluidos los productos escalar, vectorial y mixto. Posteriormente se aborda la representación analítica de superficies y líneas en el espacio, el papel central del plano, y las distintas ecuaciones que describen rectas y superficies. El libro culmina con el análisis de las superficies de segundo orden --elipsoides, hiperboloides, conos, paraboloides y cilindros-- y con un apéndice dedicado a los determinantes y su aplicación en la resolución de sistemas lineales. En conjunto, el texto constituye una guía coherente para estudiantes que se inician en la geometría analítica y requieren un tratamiento detallado, sistemático y acompañado de numerosos ejemplos y problemas. docs.description: About the book This book by a prominent Soviet astronomer and imaginative interpreter of the history and latest knowledge of astronomy, an age-old science that has come through two shattering decades of exciting discovery and research, can be dubbed a popular encyclopaedia of astronomy. It is a vivid and fascinating account of almost all the celestial bodies with which astronomy is concerned: planets, omets, meteors, the Sun and stars, gaseous and dust nebulae, quasar , black hole., etc. The tome is lavishly illustrated throughout with a mixture of photographs and specially commissioned artwork in full colour. The book will appeal to the general reader with no astronomical and mathematical background, fascinated by the wonders of the Space Age. The book was translated from the Russian by Alexander Repyev and was published by Mir 1985. This is a cleaned, optimised version of an earlier scan we had added. docs.description: L’ouvrage que nous présentons au lecteur est rédigé sur la base des conférences professées par l’auteur pendant les deux dernières décennies aux étudiants de l’Université de Leningrad. Ces dernières années l’astrophysique théorique a connu des modifications notables. D’abord, l’ensemble des données d’observation que doit interpréter l ’astrophysique théorique s’est extrêmement élargi. Ceci est lié dans une grande mesure à l’apparition et au développement rapide de la radioastronomie et de l’astrophysique extra-atmosphérique. D’autre part, l ’astrophysique théorique elle-même a donné naissance à plusieurs idées nouvelles importantes sur le très grand rôle des réactions nucléaires dans l’énergétique et l’évolution des étoiles, sur l’influence considérable des forces électromagnétiques sur l’état des atmosphères stellaires et du milieu interstellaire, etc. En même temps, de nouvelles et puissantes méthodes ont été élaborées dans cette discipline (en particulier, dans la théorie de transfert du rayonnement), et les méthodes connues ont été perfectionnées dans le but d’utiliser les moyens offerts par les ordinateurs. L’ouvrage présenté compte huit chapitres. Les deux premiers traitent des problèmes de la formation du spectre continu et du spectre de raies des étoiles. Nous y analysons en détail les processus d’absorption et d’émission de l’énergie rayonnante qui se déroulent dans un volume élémentaire, ainsi que les processus de transfert de l’énergie rayonnante à travers les couches superficielles d’une étoile. Nous montrons également comment déterminer d’après l’observation des spectres stellaires les conditions physiques dans les couches superficielles des étoiles et leur composition chimique. Traduit du russe par Valentin Polonski Un grand merci à Henri Leveque pour le livre

This book is dedicated to the history of the creation and development of Soviet liquid-fueled rocket engines (LRE), which are considered the most crucial engines in modern astronautics. The author aims to delineate the contributions made by prominent Soviet figures such as K. E. Tsiolkovsky, Yu. V. Kondratyuk, F. A. Tsander, V. P. Glushko, S. P. Korolev, M. K. Tikhonravov, and others to the field of rocket science and the development of rocket engines utilizing liquid fuels. Additionally, the book highlights the successes attained during the Great Patriotic War in laying the fundamental groundwork for the advancement of rocket engine construction. It also emphasizes the pivotal role played by the Gas Dynamic Laboratory (GDL), Group for the Study of Reaction Engines (GIRD), and the world's first Reaction Scientific Research Institute (RNII). The author acknowledges the impossibility of thoroughly analyzing all the engines designed and manufactured in the USSR. However, in an effort to provide the reader with a comprehensive understanding of the diverse and intricate problems addressed in engine creation, the book thoroughly describes certain LRE designs. The materials used in writing this book were derived from archives of the Academy of Sciences USSR, the GDL Experimental and Design Bureau, and various other institutions. Numerous colleagues generously shared the results of their historical studies and offered valuable recommendations during the manuscript's preparation. The author expresses heartfelt gratitude to all those who contributed to the creation of this book, especially to N. V. Ivanov, V. M. Komarov, and D. A. Shushko. 1. docs.creator: Miriam Morton
docs.description: This first anthology in English of Russian literature for children presents a rich collection of stories, verse, folktales, fables, and prose poems, spanning the period from 1825 to the present. It offers striking confirmation of the idea that a country’s literature for its young readers reflects the essence of its self-image and worldview. The Russians take great pride in their literature for children. Many of Russia’s greatest and most celebrated writers have written for children or have had their works embraced by young readers, as this anthology demonstrates. The authors represented include Alexander Blok, Anton Chekhov, Kornei Chukovsky, Pyotr Ershov, Maxim Gorky, Valentin Kataev, Vladimir Korolenko, Ivan Krylov, Samuel Marshak, Yuri Olesha, Konstantin Paustovsky, Mikhail Sholokhov, Alexei Tolstoy, Leo Tolstoy, and Ivan Turgenev. The selections are grouped according to their general popularity among three age groups: children aged five to seven, eight to eleven, and twelve to approximately fifteen. The genres represented vary with the age groups. For the youngest children, the selections include nursery rhymes, animal tales in verse, simple fables and parables, short folktales, science fairy tales, short modern stories, and story poems. The middle group is offered stories, verse, and fables of a more mature nature, as well as science fantasy. The oldest group encounters classical and modern stories, excerpts from novels, and prose poems. Twenty folktales, several of which will appeal to older readers, are presented in a separate section. In the case of excerpts, summaries or commentary on the full works are provided to ensure the reader’s curiosity and enjoyment are not compromised. The anthology has three main purposes: first, to provide English-speaking children with a representative selection of literature enjoyed by their Russian counterparts; second, to assist teachers of children’s literature, librarianship, librarians, and others who work with children and books; and third, to offer those interested, either professionally or as concerned lay readers, an insight into a significant aspect of Russian culture and how it reflects modern Russia’s ideas and ideals. Since all the selections are currently in print in the Soviet Union, the anthology offers a substantial sampling of what today’s Soviet child is reading. Among the unique features of this literature, as reflected in the selections, are the pervasive humanist tradition and affirmative realism present in nineteenth-century Russian works for children, which is maintained in later Soviet prose and poetry; the wealth of folktales from the many sister republics and ethnic groups of the USSR; the emphasis on poetry for preschool-aged children; and the unusual treatment of scientific subject matter in fiction and fantasy. An added charm of the anthology lies in the inclusion of a large number of original book illustrations by Soviet artists. Miriam Morton is solely responsible for the selections. She translated about half of the material and revised and Americanised many of the remaining translations. Born in Russia and educated in the social sciences at New York University, Mrs Morton has taught in nursery schools, served as a visiting teacher for the Board of Education, and worked as a social worker for the Board of Child Welfare in New York City. Her bilingual skill was previously demonstrated in her annotated translation of Kornei Chukovsky’s From Two to Five.

docs.description: This book is intended for students who have already learned the fundamentals of Russian: the structure of the simple sentence, the types of relationship between the words in a sentence, and the basic rules of conjugation and declension. Students of Russian will find here a brief exposition of the material they have already studied which will prove useful both for revision purposes and for improving speaking skills. Attention has been paid mainly to those themes which usually prove to be the most difficult for non-Russians: the meanings and uses of the cases, the productive and non-productive types of Russian verbs, the verb aspects, verbs of motion, the use of pronouns, and the meanings and uses of conjunctions and conjunctive words in compound and complex sentences. The book contains a large number of drill exercises designed to help the student acquire practical mastery of Russian. As a rule, the examples in the explanations and the first exercises designed to promote the assimilation of a particular grammar rule are based on simple everyday vocabulary to make them easier for the student to understand: however, in exercises in observation sentences and whole passages from modern Russian fiction have been included to acquaint the student with Russian as it is spoken today.

docs.description: Marshal Vasily Chuikov (1900–1982), a well-known Soviet military commander, was a veteran of many campaigns in the Russian Civil War and the Second World War. In the latter, known in the Soviet Union also as the Great Patriotic War, Vasily Chuikov commanded the 62nd Army, reorganised in 1943 into the 8th Guards Army. It played a decisive role in the defence of Stalingrad and later fought its way from the Volga to Berlin. In the closing stages of the war, the 8th Guards Army spearheaded the Soviet Army’s main effort. It took part in the liberation of Poland, broke through a series of formidable German defensive lines on the eastern approaches to Berlin and, finally, stormed the capital of nazi Germany. The book describes the events of the war in powerful detail. The author deals at length with the negotiations for the surrender of the Berlin garrison and Nazi Germany’s armed forces as a whole. These took place in the last days of the battle at the command post of the 8th Guards Army, with Marshal Chuikov participating. Among Marshal Chuikov’s other books on the war are The Battle of the Century, The Stalingrad Guards Head West and From Stalingrad to the West. It will also be helpful to engineers and technicians working in the field of power generation. Internal combustion engines, gas and steam turbines, atomic power stations, district heating stations, refrigeration plants, and magneto-hydrodynamic installations are then analysed in an applied section. Insulation and the design of heat apparatus are also discussed, along with heat and mass transfer in moist bodies. Problems are given with full solutions, and each chapter includes review questions to assist the student. docs.creator: व्सेवोलोद विश्नेवस्की (V. Vishnevsky)
docs.description: व्ह्सेवोलोद विश्नेवस्की (१९००–१९५१)  – एक सुप्रसिद्ध सोव्हिएत नाटककार आणि सार्वजनिक कार्यकर्ते होते. त्यांनी तीन युद्धांमध्ये भाग घेतला. पहिल्या जागतिक युद्धाच्या काळात, अजून पोरवयात असतानाच, ते युद्धआघाडीवर पळून गेले आणि पलटणीत दाखल झाले. त्यांना सैनिकाच्या सर्वोच्च बहुमानाची पदके मिळाली. महान ऑक्टोबर क्रांतीनंतर विश्नेवस्की आरमारी सेवेत दाखल झाले. पुढे त्यांनी लष्करी सेवा सोडून लेखक बनण्याचा निर्णय घेतला. महान पितृभूमिरक्षक युद्धाच्या (१९४१–१९४५) काळात ते युद्धवार्ताहर बनले आणि युद्धाचे वृत्तांत लिहू लागले. `आशावादी शोकांतिका’  या नाटकातील घटना १९१७ सालच्या ऑक्टोबर क्रांतीनंतर अवघ्या काही महिन्यांच्या अवधीत घडतात. नाटकातील मुख्य घटनेसाठी विश्नेवस्कींनी एक अत्यंत असंभाव्य आणि विरोधाभासी प्रसंग निवडला आहे: अराजकवादी खलाशांच्या पलटणीचा कमिसार, म्हणजेच राजकीय नेता, म्हणून एका महिलेची नेमणूक केली जाते. सर्व पारंपरिक नियम झुगारून नाटककार तिला युद्धनौकेवर दाखवतो – जिथे बाईला प्रवेश निषिद्ध मानला जातो, हे सर्वश्रुत आहे. मात्र, ही घटना काल्पनिक नाही. क्रांतीच्या काळात अशा घटना घडलेल्या आहेत. कमिसारच्या व्यक्तिरेखेचे प्रेरणास्थान असणाऱ्यांपैकी  लारीसा रेइस्नेर यांचे नाव विशेष उल्लेखनीय आहे. पीटर्सबर्गच्या एका प्राध्यापकाची ही मुलगी लेखिका होती, आरमारी अधिकाऱ्यांची कमिसार होती आणि क्रांतिकारी खलाशांचे तिने नेतृत्व केले. अशा असामान्य घटनेमधून लेखक विचाराचे सर्वविजयी बळ दाखवतो – असा विचार जो क्रांतीला खलाशांपर्यंत, आणि अखिल जनतेपर्यंत नेतो. अनुवाद : अनिल हवालदार सजावट : यू० स्कोवरदनीकोव

docs.description: La pratique des recherches en statistique appliquée montre que pour mener à bien les tâches auxquelles il est confronté le chercheur doit se sentir à Taise dans trois domaines: l'appareil mathématique de la statistique appliquée, c’est-àdire essentiellement les méthodes appliquées de statistique mathématique; la modélisation mathématique, c’est-à-dire Tart de formaliser le problème posé, un art qui consiste à traduire le problème du langage de la discipline utilisatrice (économie, sociologie, médecine, etc.) dans le langage des schémas et modèles mathématiques abstraits ; le logiciel respectif. Les monographies, manuels et guides de traitement statistique des données publiés en U.R.S.S. et dans les autres pays n’étudient en principe que l’un des trois domaines mentionnés *). Cette situation s’explique à notre sens dans une grande partie par le fait que le point faible des applications statistiques réside dans la distance significative qui sépare l’instant de la mise au point de l’appareil mathématique de l’instant où cet appareil commence à être utilisé avec efficacité dans la résolution des problèmes posés. Le principal objectif des auteurs de cet ouvrage est de proposer un exposé systématique et cohérent sur les trois aspects (énumérés plus haut) de l’analyse statistique de l’information initiale au niveau de la première étape de traitement des données empiriques. Cette étape, appelée dans cet ouvrage étape de traitement statistique primaire, comprend: le dossier d’étude; l’organisation de l’en- #) Ces trois à cinq dernières années, de nombreux ouvrages étrangers ont été publiés qui décrivent les méthodes de traitement statistique en même temps que le logiciel correspondant. Voir par exemple E. Diday et collaborateurs. Optimisation en classification automatique. Paris, INRIA, 1980; Lee Te., Judge G., Zellner A. Estimating theparameters of the Markovprobability model from aggregate time sériés data. North-Holland Publishing Company, Amsterdam-London, 1970. trée et la mémorisation des données dans l’ordinateur; la visualisation des données multidimensionnelles en vue de la formulation des hypothèses de travail ; la manipulation des variables de divers types ; le traitement des données manquantes et des données anomales; la description et l’analyse des répartitions empiriques; le test des hypothèses d’indépendance, d’homogénéité et de stationnarité des échantillons. L’ouvrage se compose de quatre parties. Les principes méthodologiques de la statistique appliquée et les principales définitions et méthodes de la modélisation font l’objet de la première partie. Cette partie est la moins « mathématisée », mais son assimilation permettra au lecteur de bien maîtriser les méthodes de traitement statistique des données. Les parties II et III (chapitres 4 à 9) développent les notions fondamentales de théorie des probabilités et de statistique mathématique. Ces chapitres peuvent servir aux étudiants des facultés scientifiques. L’assimilation de ce matériel exige du lecteur la connaissance des seules notions élémentaires de mathématiques, notamment les notions de fonction et de graphique d’une fonction; de suite numérique et de somme d’une suite ; de dérivée (ordinaire et partielle); d’intégrale (définie et indéfinie); de calcul vectoriel et matriciel. La partie IV enfin est consacrée à la description des méthodes de traitement statistique préliminaire des données (chap. 10 et 11), aux aspects numérique et informatique de leurs réalisations sur ordinateur (chap. 12). docs.description: This translation has been made from the second revised and supplemented Rus­ sian edition, published by the State Med­ ical Publishing House, Moscow 1952. On the occasion of the centenary of Pavlov’s birthday (September 27, 1949) the author of this book lakes the liberty of attempting to fill this gap in the patho-physiologv of the higher nervous activity; his aim is to expound in a number of essays the basic achievements of thi's young branch of science and to give an outline of its development in the Pavlov school (including its ramifica­tions) up to our lime. In the preface to the third edition of the lectures on the Work of the Cerebral Hemispheres published in No­vember 1935, Pavlov wrote: “My new systematic exposi­tion of the whole of our experimental material in the shape of one book will require much labour, and I regard it as my last scientific task. It will take years to complete this work. If only fate will be so kind as to preserve for me at my age the vigour that will enable me to carry out this important duty of my life!’ Death prevented Pavlov from carrying out this desire. In the Essays on the Patho-Physiology of the Higher Nervous Activity the author tries, to the best of his ability, to carry out, even in small measure, Pavlov’s will; the author regards this as his duty to Russian science and to his late teacher.

docs.description: "ચક અને ગેક" એ બે નાના ભાઇઓની કથા છે, જે તેમની મમ્મી સાથે મોસ્કોમાં રહે છે. તેમના પિતા દૂર સાઇબેરિયામાં કામ કરે છે, તેથી તેઓ તેમને ખૂબ ઓછા મળતા છે. એક દિવસ, તેમને તેમના પિતાનો ટેલીગ્રામ મળે છે જેમાં નવું વર્ષ ઉજવવા માટે તેમને મળવા આવવા કહ્યું છે. તેઓ ઉત્સાહથી પોતાનું સામાન પેક કરે છે અને બરફથી ઢંકાયેલાં જંગલો અને પહાડોમાંથી મુસાફરી શરૂ કરે છે. મુસાફરી દરમિયાન, ચક ભૂલથી ટેલીગ્રામ ગુમાવી બેસે છે, જેનાથી તેઓ ચિંતિત થઈ જાય છે કે તેમના પિતા જાણશે કે નહીં કે તેઓ આવી રહ્યાં છે. કેટલીક રસપ્રદ અને થોડાક ડરાવના અનુભવ પછી, તેઓ અંતે તેમના પિતાના કેમ્પ પર પહોંચી જાય છે. તેમના પિતા તેમને જોઈને ખૂબ ખુશ થાય છે અને તેઓ સૌ સાથે મળીને નવું વર્ષ ઉજવે છે. આ કથા કુટુંબના મહત્વ અને શૂરવીરતાથી મુશ્કેલ પરિસ્થિતિઓનો સામનો કરવાની વાત બતાવે છે. અનુવાદક–અતુલ સવાણી ચિત્રકાર – દુબિન્સ્કી ગુપ્તાજીને તમામ ક્રેડિટ

docs.description: પૃથ્વીનો આકાર શું છે? એક વિચિત્ર પ્રશ્ન, તે નથી? વિશ્વ એક ગ્લોબ છે. તે રાઉન્ડ છે. મને અને તમે તે સ્પષ્ટ છે. અમે 20 મી સદીના લોકો છીએ. ઘાસ લીલો છે, આકાશ વાદળી છે અને વિશ્વ ગોળ છે. અમે તેને બાળપણથી જાણીએ છીએ. પરંતુ તે ખરેખર બધા સ્પષ્ટ છે? દેશમાં બહાર જાઓ. સૌથી મોટા ક્ષેત્રની મધ્યમાં ચાલો, જ્યાં સુધી તમે દૂર ક્ષિતિજ સુધી ઘાસ અને ફૂલો ન જોઈ શકો. તે ગોળ દેખાય છે? તમે બલ્જ જોઈ શકો છો? ના. તે ક્ષિતિજની જમણી બાજુએ પેનકેક તરીકે સપાટ થાય તે પહેલાં આવેલું છે. દરેક ઝાડ અને ઝાડ, દરેક નાની ટેકરી સ્પષ્ટ રીતે બહાર આવે છે. તો કોણ કહે છે કે દુનિયા ગોળ છે? જ્યારે ઉપગ્રહોની માહિતી સાથે પૃથ્વીની સપાટીની ગણતરી કરવા માટે કમ્પ્યુટર્સનો ઉપયોગ કરવામાં આવ્યો ત્યારે જાણવા મળ્યું કે આપણા ગ્રહનો આકાર એટલો સરળ નથી. તે સહેજ પિઅર આકારનું છે. ઉત્તરીય ગોળાર્ધ ધ્રુવ તરફ થોડો ખેંચાય છે, અને દક્ષિણ ગોળાર્ધમાં ડેન્ટેડ છે. તેની સપાટી પર ડેન્ટ્સ અને બમ્પ્સ છે. અને જો તમે વિષુવવૃત્ત પર મધ્યમાં પૃથ્વીને કાપી શકો છો, તો પરિણામ એક વર્તુળ હશે જે સાચું છે. તેથી તે થોડો થોડો કુટિલ છે. આ આકારને શું કહેવું જોઈએ? વૈજ્ઞાનિકોએ તમામ પ્રકારના નામ અજમાવ્યા. છેલ્લે તેઓએ "જીઓઇડ"પસંદ કર્યું. આ "જીઓ", ગ્રીક "પૃથ્વી", અને "ઇડોસ" , ગ્રીક "દૃશ્ય"માંથી બનેલું છે. તેથી તે ખરેખર અર્થ એ છે કે પૃથ્વી જેવી છે. હકીકતમાં પૃથ્વી સહેજ અપૂર્ણ ગોળા છે. લોકોને આ કેવી રીતે મળ્યું તે એક લાંબી અને રસપ્રદ વાર્તા છે. અને તે જ આ પુસ્તક વિશે છે. આ પુસ્તકનું રશિયનથી અંગ્રેજીમાં ડાયના મિલર દ્વારા ભાષાંતર કરવામાં આવ્યું હતું. અદ્ભુત ચિત્રો યુરી સ્મોલનિકોવ દ્વારા દોરવામાં આવ્યા છે. આ પુસ્તકનું અંગ્રેજી સંસ્કરણ 1984માં રાડુગા દ્વારા પ્રકાશિત કરવામાં આવ્યું હતું. હિન્દી સંસ્કરણનું ભાષાંતર યોગેન્દ્ર નાગપાલ દ્વારા કરવામાં આવ્યું હતું અને 1986 માં રાડુગા દ્વારા પ્રકાશિત કરવામાં આવ્યું હતું. મૂળ સ્કેન ગુપ્તાજી દ્વારા કરવામાં આવ્યું હતું (નીચે લિંક કરેલ) અમે સ્કેન સાફ કર્યું અને ઓક્રેડ કર્યું. ડિજિટલ લાઇબ્રેરી ઓફ ઇન્ડિયામાંથી હિન્દી (બ્લેક એન્ડ વ્હાઇટ) સ્કેન છે. ચિત્રો — યૂરીય સ્મોલ્નિકોવ  અનુવાદ – ધનંજય વ્યાસ ગુપ્તાજીને તમામ ક્રેડિટ્સ.

docs.description: Este manual nace de la experiencia de años de enseñanza del análisis matemático en la Facultad de Física de la Universidad Estatal de Moscú. Está dirigido tanto a estudiantes como a profesores jóvenes que inician su labor docente, y cubre principalmente funciones de una variable, incluyendo medida e integral de Lebesgue. No se trata de una colección de problemas tradicional, sino de un material estructurado para favorecer una comprensión activa del contenido. Cada sección está organizada en cuatro partes: conceptos y teoremas fundamentales, preguntas de control, ejemplos resueltos y ejercicios para trabajo independiente. La sección teórica presenta nociones clave sin demostraciones, usualmente basadas en el manual de V. A. Ilin y E. G. Poznyak. Las preguntas de control ayudan al estudiante a verificar su comprensión. Los ejemplos explican cómo aplicar la teoría, destacando puntos críticos como condiciones de aplicabilidad. Finalmente, los ejercicios están cuidadosamente seleccionados por su variedad, y se complementan con respuestas e indicaciones. El objetivo general es facilitar tanto el aprendizaje autodirigido de los estudiantes como la enseñanza eficaz por parte del profesorado. Traducido del ruso por G. Lozhkin Todos los créditos a los uploaders originales.

docs.description: Entre las disciplinas que constituyen el fundamento de la formación de ingenieros se encuentra la Geometría Descriptiva. La Geometría Descriptiva tiene por objeto la exposición y argumentación de los métodos de construcción de las imágenes de las formas espaciales sobre un plano, así como los métodos de resolución de problemas de carácter geométrico a partir de las imágenes dadas de estas formas. Las imágenes construidas según las reglas estudiadas en la Geometría Descriptiva permiten comprender la forma de los objetos y su disposición relativa en el espacio, determinar sus dimensiones y estudiar sus propiedades geométricas específicas. La Geometría Descriptiva, al requerir un trabajo intensivo de la imaginación espacial, contribuye a su desarrollo. Por último, la Geometría Descriptiva transmite una parte de sus deducciones a la práctica del dibujo técnico, garantizando su expresividad y precisión, y, por tanto, la posibilidad de realización de los objetos representados. Las reglas de construcción de imágenes, expuestas en la Geometría Descriptiva, se basan en el método de proyecciones. El estudio de dicho método comienza con la construcción de las proyecciones del punto, ya que, al representar cualquier forma espacial, se consideran una serie de puntos que pertenecen a dicha forma. docs.description: Sous la rédaction de V. Rabinovitch Le cours de chimie générale du professeur N. L. Glinka jouit en U.R.S.S., et ce depuis de nombreuses années, d’une renommée justifiée. Du vivant de l’auteur ce cours a été édité 12 fois en russe et a été traduit en anglais et en plusieurs langues de l’U.R.S.S. Ce cours a permis à de nombreuses générations d’étudiants d’assimiler la chimie et aux écoliers de se préparer aux concours d’entrée. Bien souvent des ingénieurs non chimistes y font appel en cas de besoin. Cette bonne renommée du cours de chimie de N. L. Glinka s’explique tout simplement par la clarté de l’exposé, l’enchaînement logique des sujets traités et par le choix rationnel de ces sujets. Néanmoins la période qui s’est écoulée depuis le décès de l’auteur a rendu nécessaire une certaine révision du cours. Cette révision était d’autant plus nécessaire que la chimie s’intégre de plus en plus à de nombreuses branches de l’économie nationale et que l’étude de la chimie s’impose toujours plus dans l’enseignement supérieur. D’autre part, la somme de nos connaissances en chimie s’est énormément accrue au cours de ces décennies et il fallait donc moderniser l’ouvrage. La progression des connaissances stimule le processus de la transformation de la chimie de son état de science empirique à celui d’une science de la nature s’appuyant sur des bases scientifiques aussi solides que les conceptions modernes de la structure de la matière et de la thermodynamique. Cette révision du cours fut entreprise à l’occasion de sa 16e édition en langue russe (1973). Les chapitres consacrés à la structure de la matière, aux bases de la thermodynamique chimique, aux solutions et aux complexes ont été notablement développés. L’étude des processus d’oxydo-réduction et des propriétés des métaux et alliages a été rénovée, les données factuelles sur la chimie des différents éléments ont été remises à jour. Enfin dans la toute dernière édition, le système d’unités internationales (SI) et la terminologie adéquate ont été adoptés. Tout ce travail a été effectué par un collectif de professeurs de l’Université de Léningrad sous la rédaction du professeur V. A. Rabinovitch. L'édition française de ce cours a été une nouvelle fois révisée et complétée. De nos jours une attention particulière doit être accordée aux aspects chimiques de l'interaction entre l'homme et son environnement; aussi les paragraphes 72, 115, 123 et 126 traitant de ce problème ont été révisés et développés. Le professeur A. A. Makarénja a spécialement écrit pour cette édition les §§ 248 à 250 où il traite des problèmes de l’extension de l’industrie chimique et de la protection du milieu naturel, ainsi que du rôle que joue l’étude de la chimie dans nos conceptions sur le monde. En outre le paragraphe 43, dû à V. A. Rabinovitch, traite de la configuration géométrique des molécules en se fondant tant sur la méthode d’hybridation que sur celle de la répulsion des doublets électroniques de valence. Nous espérons que le cours de chimie de N. L. Glinka sera bien accueilli par les lecteurs français. Traduit du Russe par S. Medvédev Un grand merci à Henri Leveque pour le scan original.

docs.description: पुस्तक के बारे में हिन्दी भाषा में अनुदित प्रो० नि० ले० ग्लीनका की प्रस्तुत पुस्तक “ सामान्य रसायन  बहुत प्रचलित है। लेखक के जीवन काल में ही रूसी भाषा में इसके 2 संस्करण  प्रकाशित हुए , अंग्रेजी भाषा में अनूदित की गई एवं सोवियत संघ की प्रांतीय भाषाओ्रों  में अनेक बार प्रकाशित हुई। यह पुस्तक न केवल उच्च अध्ययन संस्थानों और तकनीकी  विद्यालयों के विद्यार्थियों तथा अध्यापकों के बीच प्रचलित थी, बल्कि अरासायनिक  व्यवसायों के विशेषज्ञों के बीच भी लोकप्रिय थी जो स्वयं अध्ययन विधि द्वारा रसायन  के वारे में अपना ज्ञान बढ़ाना चाहते थे। रसायन का तीब्रता से लगातार विकास ,  ग्रार्थिक व्यवस्था में उसका अधिक महत्वपूर्ण स्थान, अनेक व्यवसायों के विशेषज्ञों को  तैयार करने में उसके योग का बढ़ना तथा रसायन का अनुभवमूलक विज्ञान से प्रकृति  विज्ञान के सस क्षेत्र में तीब्रतापूर्ण प्रवेश करने की क्रिया , जो पदार्थ-संरचना के आधु-  निक विचारों और तापीयगतिकी के नियमों पर आधारित है-ये सभी प्रस्तुत पुस्तक  में महत्वपूर्ण परिवर्तते करने के कारण बनें।   उन अध्यायों में ग्रत्यधिक परिवर्तन किये गये हैं जो पदार्थ की संरचना, रासायनिक तापीय गतिकी  के नियमों, विलयनों के सिद्धाँत, अपचयोपचयन क्रियाओं , धातुत्रों तथा ऐलायों के  गणों के साथ सम्बंधित हैं पृथक तत्त्वों के रसायन को समपित की गई सामग्री को  भी नए रूप में प्रस्तुत किया गया है। अतिरिक्त परिवर्तेतन, जो विशेषतः भौतिकीय  परिमापों की इकाईयों ( अन्तर्राष्ट्रीय सिस्टम ) के लागू किये जाने से सम्बंधित हैं,  पुस्तक के 9 वें संस्करण (1979) में कर दिये गये थे।  [  प्रस्तुत अनुवाद पुस्तक के रूसी भाषा में 2 वें संस्करण से किया गया है। हिन्दी  भाषा में अनुवाद करने के समय पुस्तक की सामग्री का पुनः अध्ययन किया गया  तथा उसमें आवश्यक सामग्री सम्मिलित की गई। मानव और प्राकृतिक वातावरण  की पारस्परिक क्रिया के रासायनिक पक्षों पर विशेष ध्यान दिया गया है, और इसके  साथ-साथ प्रस्तुत संस्करण में अरणुश्नरों की ज्यामिती का अध्ययन न केवल संकरण  विधि के दृष्टिकोण से अपितु संयोजकता कोश के इलेक्ट्रानी युगलों की प्रतिकर्षण  विधि के आधार पर भी किया गया है। रूसी से अनुवादित: मोहन मुर्ति शांडिल्य सभी श्रेय गुप्ताजी को विषय-सूची  हिन्दी संस्करण की docs.description: சோவியத் பூகோளவியல் அறிஞர், எழுத்தாளர் நிக்கலாய் மிஹாய்லவ் வெளிநாட்டு வாசகர்களிடையே விரிவாகப் பெயர் பெற்றவர். “தீர்க்கரேகையின் வழியே செல்கிறேன்”, “தாய் நாட்டின் வரைபடத்தை நோக்குவோம்”, “உலகின் ஆரும் பகுதி”, “சோவியத் யூனியனைப் பார்வையிடுவோம்” என்னும் அவருடைய நூல்கள் உலகின் பல மொழிகளில் பெயர்க்கப்பட்டிருக்கின்றன. “சோவியத் நாட்டைச் சுற்றிப் பார்ப்போம்” என்னும் இந்த நூல் சில ஆண்டுகளுக்கு முன்பு ஆங்கில, பிரெஞ்சு, ஸ்பானிய மொழிகளில் முன்னேற்றப் பதிப்பகத்தால் வெளியிடப்பட்டது. பல்வேறு நாடுகளைச் சேர்ந்த வாசகர்கள் இதை மிக விரும்பிப் படித்தார்கள். இந்த நூலைப் படிக்கையில் வாசகர்கள் பால்டிக் கடலில் இருந்து பெரிங் ஜலசந்திவரை, வட துருவத்திலிருந்து ஆப்கானிஸ்தான் எல்லையில் சோவியத் நாட்டின் தெற்குக் கோடிவரை கவர்ச்சிகரமான சுற்றுப்பயணம் செய்ததுபோல உணர்ந்தார்கள். சோவியத் யூனியனின் மையப் பகுதிகள், தேசீயக் குடியரசுகள் ஆகியவற்றின் இயற்கை நிலைமைகளையும் பொருளாதாரத்தையும் அவர்கள் அறிந்துகொண்டார்கள். வாசகர்கள் நாடு முழுவதையும் சுற்றிப் பார்த்தார்கள். அதன் வனப்பு மிக்க இயற்கைக் காட்சிகளையும் புயல் வேகக் கட்டுமான வேலைகளையும்—சிறப்பாக, சைபீரியாவிலும் தூரக் கிழக்கிலும் மத்திய ஆசியாவிலும் அமைக்கப்படும் புதிய நிர்மாண ஸ்தலங்களையும்—அவர்கள் கண்டார்கள். சோவியத் யூனியனில் வாழும் பெருந்தொகையான நாட்டினத்தவரின் வழக்கப் பழக்கங்கள், பண்பாடு ஆகியவை பற்றி நிறைய சுவையான விவரங்களைத் தெரிந்துகொண்டார்கள். இன்றைய சோவியத் நாட்டின் கலை, விஞ்ஞானம், கல்வி ஆகியவற்றையும் இன்னும் பல்வேறு துறைகளையும் அறிமுகம் செய்துகொண்டார்கள். குமிழ் பதிப்புக்காக நூலைச் செப்பம் செய்கையில், கடந்த சில ஆண்டுகளில் நாட்டின் வரைபடம் எவ்வாறு மாறியுள்ளது, நாட்டின் வாழ்க்கையில், சோவியத் குடிமக்களின் வாழ்க்கையில் என்னென்ன முக்கிய நிகழ்ச்சிகள் நடந்துள்ளன என்ற விவரங்களை ஆசிரியர் சேர்த்துள்ளார். Soviet geographer and writer Nikolai Mikhailov is widely known among foreign readers. His books—"I Travel Along the Meridian," "Let Us Turn to the Map of the Motherland," "A Part of the Explored World," and "Let Us View the Soviet Union"—have been translated into many languages around the world. This book, "Let Us Tour the Soviet Country," was published a few years ago in English, French, and Spanish by Progress Publishers. Readers from various countries read it with great enthusiasm. While reading this book, readers felt as if they had taken a fascinating journey from the Baltic Sea to the Bering Strait, from the North Pole to the Soviet southern border at the Afghan frontier. They learned about the natural conditions and economy of the Soviet Union's central regions and national republics. The readers toured the entire country. They witnessed its lush natural landscapes and storm-paced construction works—especially the new industrial sites being built in Siberia, the Far East, and Central Asia. They gained many interesting details about the customs and culture of the numerous nationalities living in the Soviet Union. They became acquainted with the art, science, education, and many other fields of today's Soviet country. For the Kumizhi edition, while revising the book, the author has added details about how the country's map has changed in recent years, and what major events have taken place in the life of the country and the lives of the Soviet people.

L’ordro de lecture importe peu. Si ces quatre « nouvelles » semblent sans rapport, elles n’en possèdent pas moins quelques affinités, dont la plus évidente est le refus délibéré des auteurs d'aborder les sujets traités dans un esprit « puriste », c’est-à-dire celui du mathématicien qui se refuse à constater les liens multiples et féconds existant entre les sciences mathématiques et celles de la nature. docs.description: Ce livre n ’est pas seulement un essai de généralisation d ’un certain nombre de recherches théoriques et expérimentales. C'est aussi le résultat de longues controverses et de polémiques parfois très passionnées. Les circonstances ont été telles que l ’auteur a dû, pendant plusieurs années, prendre part à des discussions sur les différents aspects de la théorie de l ’inconscient dans lesquelles se confrontaient les attitudes psychanalytiques, psychosomatiques et phénoménalistes envers cette théorie, d’une part et, de l ’autre, la compréhension matérialiste-dialectique du problème des formes non conscientes du psychisme et de l ’activité nerveuse supérieure. En U.R.S.S., l ’intérêt pour de telles confrontations s ’est notablement accru après la Session spéciale du Présidium de l ’Académie des Sciences médicales de l ’U.R.S.S. consacrée à la critique du freudisme (1958). A l ’étranger, la présence de délégués soviétiques aux Congrès scientifiques où étaient abordés les questions de la théorie de la conscience, de la théorie de l ’organisation fonctionnelle du cerveau, des troubles cliniques de la vie mentale, etc., a souvent provoqué la discussion (parfois même « hors programme ») du thème de l ’« inconscient » en tant que domaine dans lequel se manifeste à l ’extrême la différence entre les méthodologies et les styles d ’appréhension des questions essentielles de la théorie du cerveau. Traduit du russe par Elli Bronina et révisé par Michel Houzé Un grand merci à Henri Leveque pour le scan original.

docs.description: Nikolai Gogol's The Government Inspector is a satirical comedy that exposes the corruption and incompetence of provincial Russian officials. The plot revolves around a case of mistaken identity when a low-ranking civil servant, Khlestakov, is mistaken for a powerful government inspector by the local officials of a small town. Fearing the inspector's arrival to investigate their misconduct, the officials desperately try to bribe and flatter Khlestakov, who exploits their naivety and greed. Through this farcical situation, Gogol critiques the widespread corruption, hypocrisy, and moral decay in Russia's bureaucracy. நிகொலை கோகோலின்  கவர்ன்மென்ட் இன்ஸ்பெக்டர்  என்பது மாகாண ரஷிய அதிகாரிகளின் ஊழல் மற்றும் தகுதியின்மையை வெளிப்படுத்தும் ஒரு நையாண்டி நகைச்சுவையாகும். கதையின் மையம் தவறான அடையாளம் தொடர்பாக உள்ளது, சிறு நகரத்தின் அதிகாரிகள் ஒரு சாதாரண அரசு பணியாளரான கிளெஸ்டகோவ் என்பவரை ஆட்கொண்ட விசாரணை அதிகாரராக தவறாக கருதுகின்றனர். அதிகாரிகளின் தவறுகளை ஆராய்வதற்காக ஒருவர் வருவார் என்ற பயத்தில், அவர்கள் கிளெஸ்டகோவை கவரவும், லஞ்சம் கொடுக்கவும் முயல்கிறார்கள், ஆனால் அவரோ அவர்களின் அநியாயம் மற்றும் பேராசையைப் பயன்படுத்தி பலன் பெறுகிறார். இந்த நகைச்சுவையான சூழ்நிலையில், கோகோல் ரஷிய அரசாங்கத்தின் பரவலான ஊழல், பாசாங்குத்தனம் மற்றும் நல்லறிவு குறைவைக் கேலியாய்ச் சித்தரிக்கிறார். மொழிபெயர்ப்பாளர்: நா. முகம்மது செரீபு, எம்.ஏ. ஓவியர்: செர்கேய் அலீமவ் பதிப்பாசிரியர்: இவ்கேனி கனவாலவ் All credits to Guptaji.
