docs.creator: M. Prishvin
docs.description: This is a collection of four stories by Russian author Mikhail Prishvin (1873-1954).  The Sun's Storehouse is about two orphaned siblings, ten-year-old Mitya and his twelve-year-old sister Nastya who live in a village near the Bludon Marsh outside the town of Pereslavl-Zalesski. Their mother has died following a short illness and their father is fighting away at war. One day they decide to go out to the marshes in search of cranberries. They remember the advice their father gave them about taking a compass with them so that they can find their way back home. Halfway through their journey the children have an argument about the quickest way of reaching their destination and split up, each going a different way which results in Mitya facing great danger when he gets stuck in the swamp.  Arctic Honey is a story about how bees were transported to the north of Russia and how an Apiary works, while the third story, Woodland Masters, is about a boy who sets fire to a tree and is taught a very important lesson of how to nurture and have respect for nature, particularly the trees and woodland from hearing the story of Dead on the Roots. The final story, Vasya Veslekin is an autobiographical account of how Prishvin's dog was saved by a farmer when chasing the geese.  Prishvin was a well-known Russian author for children and famous for his sharp observation and description of nature and animal life. His stories provide vivid descriptions as well as factual and historical information subject and are accompanied by remarkable vivid colour illustrations by V. Kirillov.  Translated from the Russian by Ivy Litvinov Edited by Olga Shartse Fint printing 1955  Second printing 1975  Third printing 1981

docs.creator: V. M. Potapov
docs.description: The book is devoted to one of the rapidly developing branches of knowledge—the stereochemistry of organic compounds. The discussion of the basic concepts of this science is followed by a treatment of the stereochemistry of the principal classes of organic compounds: aliphatic, alicyclic, unsaturated, aromatic, and heterocyclic compounds. Special chapters deal with the stereochemistry of nitrogen and other elements of Groups V and VI of the Periodic System, as well as the stereochemistry of complex compounds. Much emphasis is placed in all chapters on conformational problems, the results of investigations of spatial structure using modern physico-chemical methods, and steric factors in reactions. The book serves as a course in stereochemistry designed for students of chemistry and biochemistry at the senior undergraduate and graduate levels. It may also be used for studying a specialised course on the theoretical foundations of organic chemistry. A large body of original literature is referenced, with particular emphasis on works published in the 1960s and 1970s, making it useful to postgraduates, educators, and a wide circle of research workers, including chemists, biochemists, biophysicists, and physicists acquainted with the foundations of organic chemistry. Viktor Mikhailovich Potapov received his Doctor’s degree from Moscow State University in 1964. He is currently a Professor of Organic Chemistry at Moscow State University. Dr. Potapov is primarily interested in the spectropolarimetric investigation of optically active compounds. He is a member of the editorial board of the journal  Analytical Chemistry  (USSR) and serves on the advisory boards of Mir Publishers (USSR). Professor Potapov has authored 200 publications, including  Foundations of Stereochemistry  (co-authored with A. P.),  Nomenclature of Organic Compounds , and  Chemical Information , as well as a number of textbooks and study aids for students. Translated from the Russian by Artavaz Beknazarov. Credits to the original uploaders. This is a cleaned, optimised scan. Note: Some of the colour drawings and tables are not reproduced well. docs.description: This book on temperature was written to explain  how physical concepts arise, how new methods of  measuring physical quantities are developed,  and how the progress in physics makes well-worn  concepts move into modern fields of physics of  which our predecessors were understandably  quite ignorant. - Ya. Smorodinsky We now come to the next title in the Science for Everyone Series, Temperature written by Ya. A. Smorodinsky. The books has a lot of historical perspective on how the ideas of thermodynamics developed over the ages. Also the book takes you to many quantum phenomena and discusses in detail about many of them. From the back cover This book starts with a historical background on the notion of temperature and the development of the temperature scale. Then Ya. A. Smorodinsky covers the fundamentals of thermodynamics and statistical physics, only using concepts that will be familiar to high-school students. Having built a solid foundation, he exposes the reader to a number of phenomena that are essentially quantum-mechanical, but for which the concept of temperature "works", and works very well. These include the spins in crystal lattices, inverse population of energy levels, microwave background radiation, black holes, and cooling antiproton beams. Although it has been written for high-school students, the book contains a minimum amount of mathematics. Nevertheless, Ya.A. Smorodinsky compensates for this severe restriction by the lucid manner in which he discusses complicated effects. The book was translated from the Russian by V. I. Kisin and was first published by Mir in 1984. docs.description: The present book, in two volumes, is concerned with a variety of topics which have been left to one side, as it were, but which are never­ theless of great practical importance. In particular, we have in mind problems involving the effects of noise on electronic relays and vacuum- tube oscillators. Recently, there has been increased interest in the oper­ ation of switching devices and self-excited systems, not only because of the development of methods of coherent radar detection, but also in connection with such problems as increasing the accuracy of time measurements, designing particle accelerators and computing ma­ chines, etc. However, the journal literature in these new fields of statistical radio engineering is hard to penetrate. In the present book, noise in relays and oscillators is studied in an organized fashion, from a rather general point of view. Material that can be found in the literature has been systematized, and the results of some original investigations by the author have been included. The physical treatment of the results obtained may be a bit sketchy, but it seems to us that brevity coupled with wide coverage is justified in this instance, since the rapid growth in the total number of published papers has increased the need for some kind of survey, even one resembling a handbook. Part I of Volume I is devoted to a review of the mathematical results used later in the book. In many places, it has seemed appropriate, for the sake of brevity, to depart from the usual presentation of the basic concepts and results of probability theory. The reader who is not familiar with this necessary background material can refer to any one of a number of textbooks. Those already acquainted with elementary probability theory will find that Part 1 contains a different treatment ofcertain well-known topics, in addition to some new results. In fact, Part I ought not to be devoid of interest even to mathematicians, provided, of course, that they make due allowances for the heuristic level of rigor adopted. In Volume I, Part 2 and in Volume II, we systematically use the methods just enumerated to solve specific problems of statistical radio engineering. At the same time, we try to explain the conditions under  which the various methods of analyzing noise phenomena are appli­ cable. Perhaps some of the methods are given in more detail than is necessary for immediate applications3but this is done with a view to further development of the tools needed for future work. It is reason­ able to expect that the progressively more complicated problems which come up in engineering practice will require the use of progressively more sophisticated methods of analysis. The author will regard his task as accomplished if this book serves in some measure to broaden the theoretical outlook of radio scientists, by helping them master certain methods which they may find novel at first. Although the material given here is intended primarily for specialists in the field of statistical radio engineering, it should also interest scientists working in other fields where similar statistical methods can be profitably used.

docs.description: La maladie hypertensive, l ’athérosclérose et l ’insuffisance coronarienne qui s ’y rattache, telle est la triade de maux qui frappent le plus souvent l ’humanité contemporaine. Ce sont ces affections qui emportent prématurément des millions d’existences et troublent la vie et le travail de personnes dans la force de l ’âge. Ce sont elles qui accélèrent la venue de la vieillesse. Tout livre consacré à la médecine clinique doit apporter une aide pratique. J'espère que dans une certaine mesure ce sera le cas pour celui-ci. La raison de cet espoir réside non seulement dans la conviction qu’une meilleure compréhension de la nature des maladies (et de leurs rapports mutuels) est utile pour les médecins, mais aussi dans la conscience d'avoir obtenu, au cours des dernières années, d ’incontestables succès dans l ’étude relative à la prophylaxie et au traitement de ces maladies, succès qui seront exposés dans cet ouvrage. Il est vrai qu’ils sont loin de ce qu’ils devraient être. Pourtant, il n ’y a pas longtemps, quelque quinze ans en arrière, la situation était beaucoup plus grave qu'actuellement. Faire le bilan du travail réalisé au cours de cette période et l ’apprécier de façon critique, n ’est-ce pas, dans une certaine mesure, favoriser le progrès ? Traduit du russe par E. Bronina Un grand merci à Henri Leveque pour le scan original.

docs.description: El libro que ofrecemos a la atención del lector no sólo es un compendio de problemas en su sentido habitual, sino, además, un libro de prácticas para resolver problemas. Esto ha hallado su reflejo en el contenido, y en la estructura de nuestro libro.  El presente manual consta de dos capítulos. El primero está dedicado a resolver problemas de planimetría. En el 1º tema, que en cierto sentido es la introducción a todo el libro, tratan los métodos para resolver problemas geométricos tradicionales, que con actividad se emplean en los siguientes apartados. Aquí se destacan los métodos puramente geométricos, algebraicos y mixtos, así como sus casos particulares: el método del elemento de referencia (que contiene el método de las áreas) y el método de introducción de un parámetro auxiliar. Para que sea más cómodo trabajar, en ese mismo apartado se ofrece la lista de los teoremas de planimetría, necesarios para resolver los problemas. docs.description: ஊர்ஜா உருவாக்கத்திற்கான பல்வேறு புதிய மற்றும் புதுமையான தொழில்நுட்பங்களைப் பற்றிய ஒரு புத்தகம் இது. புத்தகத்தில் பல்வேறு அமைப்புகளின் அடிப்படை செயல்முறைகள் தெளிவுபடுத்தப்பட்டுள்ளன மற்றும் பசுமை ஆற்றலின் எதிர்காலத்தைப் பற்றிய நம்பிக்கையான கருத்துக்கள் வெளிப்படுத்தப்பட்டுள்ளன. வ்லாடிமிர் அலெக்ஸ்மெயேவிச் கிரிலின் அவர்கள் உஷ்ணவியலியல், ஒப்புமை இயற்பியல் மற்றும் ஆற்றல் அறிவியல் போன்ற துறைகளில் ஒரு சிறந்த அறிஞராக உள்ளார். மாஸ்கோவின் அறிவியல் அகாடமியின் தலைவராகவும், அகாடமிசியனாகவும் இருந்த அவருக்கு லெனின் பரிசு மற்றும் பல அரசுப் பரிசுகள் வழங்கப்பட்டுள்ளன. பல நாடுகளின் பல்கலைக்கழகங்களும் கல்வி நிறுவனங்களும் கௌரவ பட்டம் வழங்கி அவரைப் பாராட்டியுள்ளன. 1923 ஆம் ஆண்டு மாஸ்கோவில் பிறந்த கிரிலின் அவர்கள் மாஸ்கோவின் ஆற்றல் அறிவியல் கல்வி நிறுவனத்தில் கல்வி முடித்தார். தற்போது அதே நிறுவனத்தின் ஒப்புமை இயற்பியல் தொழில்நுட்ப துறையின் தலைவராகவும், மாஸ்கோவின் உயர் வெப்பநிலை ஆராய்ச்சி நிறுவனத்தில் பணியாற்றியும் உள்ளார். கடந்த 20 ஆண்டுகளாக, வ்லாடிமிர் அலெக்ஸ்மெயேவிச் கிரிலின் கட்சியிலும் அரசியலிலும் பணியாற்றி வருகின்றார். அதில் 17 ஆண்டுகள் அவர் மாஸ்கோ மாநாட்டின் துணை செயலாளராகவும், மாஸ்கோ ஒன்றியத்தின் அறிவியல் மற்றும் தொழில்நுட்பக் குழுவின் தலைவராகவும் இருந்துள்ளார். தமிழாக்கம்: கி.பரமேஸ்வரன் All credits to Guptaji.

docs.description: பியோதர் சொலவேய்க்கோவ் சிரிப்பும் மகிழ்ச்சியும் மிக்க விறுவிறுப்பான இளைஞன். எல்லோருடனும் நன்கு பழகக்கூடியவன். தொலைவிலுள்ள ஒரு கிராமத்தைச் சேர்ந்த ஸ்தேஷா ரியாஷ்கினா என்ற ஒரு பெண்ணை அவன் காதலிக்கிறான். இருவரும் மணம் முடித்துக்கொள்கிறார்கள். என்றென்றும் இன்பமாகவே வாழ்ந்திருக்க வேண்டும். ஆனால் ரியாஷ்கின்களுடைய குடும்பத்தின் அற்பத்தனமும் பேராசையும் பியோதருக்குச் சிறிதும் ஒத்துவரவில்லை. பியோதரால் அவனது புதிய இல்லத்தையும் மனைவியையும் விட்டு விலகக் கஷ்டமாகத்தான் இருக்கிறது. ஆயினும் வேறு வழியில்லை; அவன் பிரிய வேண்டியதாகிறது. இளம் எழுத்தாளர் தெந்திரியாக்கோவுக்கு 1954-ல் பெயரும் புகழும் பெற்றுத் தந்த இந்தப் புதினத்தின் கதைச் சுருக்கம் இதுவே. பத்திரிகைகளிலும் இலக்கிய வட்டாரங்களிலும் வாசகப் பெருமக்களிடையிலும் மிகவும் விரிவாக விவாதிக்கப்பட்ட புத்தகமாகும் இது. விளாதிமிர் ஃபியோதரவிச் தெந்திரியாக்கோவ் 1923-ல் பிறந்தவர். மாபெரும் தேசபக்தப் போரின்போது போர்முனையிலே போராடினார். யுத்தம் முடிவுற்ற பின் மாஸ்கோ எழுத்தாளர் கல்லூரியில் பயிற்சியை முடித்துப் பட்டம் பெற்றார். 1952-ம் ஆண்டு முதல் அவருடைய புத்தகங்கள் பலவும் வெளிவந்திருக்கின்றன.  மருமகன், அற்புதம் காணீர், காலத்தின் நடையைப் பின்தொடர்வோம், நீதி விசாரணை, அசாதாரணமானது, இறுதி முடிவு  முதலானவை வாசகர்களால் மிகவும் வரவேற்கப்பட்டு, இலக்கியத் துறையில் அவருக்கு வெற்றி கிட்டச் செய்தன. வி. தெந்திரியாக்கோவ் தமக்கே உரிய கதைப் பொருள்களையும், எழுத்துப் பாணியையும், வாழ்க்கைக் கண்ணோட்டத்தையும் கொண்டு இலக்கியத் துறையில் பணியாற்றி வருகிறார். மொழிபெயர்ப்பாளர்‌: ரா. கருஷ்ணையா குயாரிப்பு: யு. ரெப்ரோவ்‌

docs.description: Este texto pertenece a un manual matemático riguroso que abarca desde los fundamentos de los números reales hasta los principios del análisis diferencial e integral. En los primeros capítulos se introducen los conceptos básicos de números reales, sus operaciones aritméticas y propiedades fundamentales. Se tratan también conversiones entre sistemas de numeración (decimal y binario) y los errores por redondeo. A continuación, se desarrolla la noción de sucesión numérica, incluyendo sucesiones convergentes, monótonas, y sus propiedades clave, con especial atención a límites, subsucesiones y puntos límite. Los capítulos posteriores abordan el concepto de función, continuidad, y valor límite, explorando funciones elementales, trigonométricas, inversas y sus discontinuidades. Se presentan con detalle la derivada, su interpretación física y geométrica, reglas de diferenciación y derivadas de orden superior. Se continúa con la integral indefinida, métodos de integración, y finalmente se introduce el álgebra de polinomios, números complejos, fracciones racionales y la integración de expresiones complejas e irracionales, incluyendo integrales elípticas. La obra culmina con teoremas fundamentales sobre funciones continuas y derivables. Traducido del ruso por la licenciada en matemáticas aplicadas M. Andriánova Todos los créditos a los uploaders originales.

docs.description: Professor Sushkov’s  Technical Thermodynamics  was compiled primarily for students of technical colleges that do not specialise in power engineering. Owing to its happy combination of clarity and brevity, it has become the most widely used of the many books on this subject published in recent years. Five editions of the book have already been sold out, and this sixth edition not only preserves all the virtues of the previous editions, but has also been brought up to date in accordance with the latest curricula approved by the Ministry of Higher Education of the U.S.S.R. In view of the fact that an understanding of the physical fundamentals of the subject is important from any point of view, and also because considerable and well-deserved attention has been paid in recent years to what is known as the  entropic method  of defining power losses, this edition retains the two chapters that were added to the fifth edition:  Entropy and Probability  (§5-13) and  Reversibility and the Performance of Work  (§5-14). Further additions and amendments reflect the development of science and engineering in the years that have elapsed since the fifth edition was published. The  Introduction , in particular, has been extended to include the development plans for Soviet power engineering in the coming years. The range of the thermodynamic tables for water and steam has been extended, and some corrections have been made. Translated from the Russian by H. docs.description: Une condition sine qua non du progrès de la physique est que la mise en équation de cette science, i.e. l’élaboration et l’étude des modèles mathématiques de phénomènes physiques, s’effectue moyennant des concepts mathématiques de plus en plus abstraits. On se rappelle à ce propos ce que Dirac a dit en 1930 dans un article où il a prédit en théoricien l ’existence d’antiparticules: « Il paraît que cette oeuvre d’abstraction se poursuivra et que si elle veut aller de l ’avant, la physique doit s’appuyer constamment sur les modifications et les généralisations des axiomes dans l’esprit mathématique plutôt que sur le développement logique d’une branche mathématique dans des limites fixes. » (Dirac [1]) Dirac a vu juste. Témoin l’histoire ultérieure de la physique théorique et surtout de la physique quantique (Bogolioubov a bien écrit en 1963 : « On assiste à une mathématisation continue des grandes notions et méthodes de la théorie quantique des champs. »). La physique mathématique de nos jours emprunte abondamment aux mathématiques modernes, notamment à la théorie des distributions. Les fondements de la théorie mathématique des distributions ont été posés dès 1936 par Sobolev (15; [11) qui les a appliquées avec succès au problème de Cauchy pour les équations hyperboliques. En 1950-1951, Laurent Schwartz a fait paraître sa monographie connue où il a utilisé la théorie des espaces vectoriels topologiques localement convexes. Sobolev et Schwartz ont été suivis de,nombreux autres mathématiciens qui ont développé la théorie des distributions selon les besoins de la physique mathématique et de la physique théorique, tout particulièrement de la théorie des équations différentielles et de la physique quantique. Les distributions constituent aujourd'hui une branche scientifique évoluée, elles débouchent largement sur la physique et les mathématiques et attirent toujours plus les physiciens, les mathématiciens et les ingénieurs (*). Les distributions possèdent plusieurs propriétés remarquables qui étendent les possibilités de l'analyse classique : toute distribution admet des dérivées (au sens généralisé) de tout ordre, les séries convergentes de distributions sont indéfiniment dérivables terme à terme, toute distribution a sa transformée de Fourier, et ainsi de suite. Aussi le recours aux distributions élargit sensiblement la gamme des problèmes étudiés et conduit de plus à des simplifications importantes par automatisation des opérations élémentaires. La présente monographie développe un cours fait à l'Institut des ingénieurs physiciens de Moscou et à l'Institut mathématique Stéklov. Traduit du raaae par Irina Petrova Un grand merci à Henri Leveque pour le scan original.

docs.creator: P.L. Kapitza
docs.description: The problems compiled in this collection were designed for students at the Moscow Physical-Technical Institute and for postgraduate examinations at the Institute of Physical Problems. These problems aim to foster analytical and creative thinking, essential qualities for scientific research. Unlike conventional problems, these require students to apply known physical laws to analyse phenomena quantitatively. They often permit multiple approaches, encouraging individuality and deeper exploration. By excluding numerical values for constants and parameters, the problems train students to estimate and contextualise physical magnitudes, an important skill for scientific work. The emphasis is on cultivating scientific thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to visualise and work with concrete quantitative values. The methodology of teaching through problem-solving also reveals students' inclinations and capabilities. Students are encouraged to consult literature, seek advice, and discuss solutions, replicating real scientific practices. This approach is particularly useful in selecting postgraduate candidates and nurturing future researchers. The problems reflect a broader educational goal of developing skilled scientists and researchers, critical for the cultural and economic advancement of the state. While tailored for physics, this approach is applicable to other exact sciences like mathematics and chemistry, underlining its value in shaping competent researchers across disciplines. docs.creator: I. M. Gelfand; N. Ya. Vilenkin
docs.description: The first systematic theory of generalized functions (also known as distributions) was created in the early 1950s, although some aspects were developed much earlier, most notably in the definition of the Green's function in mathematics and in the work of Paul Dirac on quantum electrodynamics in physics. The six-volume collection, Generalized Functions, written by I. M. Gel′fand and co-authors and published in Russian between 1958 and 1966, gives an introduction to generalized functions and presents various applications to analysis, PDE, stochastic processes, and representation theory. The main goal of Volume 4 is to develop the functional analysis setup for the universe of generalized functions. The main notion introduced in this volume is the notion of rigged Hilbert space (also known as the equipped Hilbert space, or Gelfand triple). Such space is, in fact, a triple of topological vector spaces E⊂H⊂E′, where H is a Hilbert space, E′ is dual to E, and inclusions E⊂H and H⊂E′ are nuclear operators. The book is devoted to various applications of this notion, such as the theory of positive definite generalized functions, the theory of generalized stochastic processes, and the study of measures on linear topological spaces.

docs.description: Este libro, escrito por dos autores, aborda el fascinante tema de los cristales líquidos, sustancias insólitas ampliamente utilizadas en dispositivos electrónicos modernos. Aunque la ciencia de los cristales líquidos es una de las ramas más jóvenes y complejas de la física, los autores se propusieron explicar su teoría de manera accesible, sin recurrir a fórmulas matemáticas complicadas. Combinando rigor científico con ejemplos y analogías de la naturaleza, el libro busca hacer comprensible este tema para un público amplio, especialmente estudiantes de niveles superiores. Además de explorar la estructura y propiedades de los cristales líquidos, el libro también destaca sus aplicaciones en tecnología y biología. Los autores esperan que esta obra no solo sea útil, sino que también inspire a jóvenes lectores a interesarse por esta cautivadora rama de la ciencia. A través de un enfoque claro y didáctico, el libro pretende acercar a los lectores a los misterios y potencialidades de los cristales líquidos. docs.creator: N. Rudenko
docs.description: Materials handling equipment is an integral part of mechanical equipment in every modern industrial enterprise. The numerous designs of materials handling equipment result from the great variety of loads being moved and the wide range of transporting operations without which modern production is unthinkable. The entire production process in every enterprise essentially depends on the rational selection of materials handling equipment, the correct determination of its main parameters, and its efficient operation. Every mechanical engineer must therefore have a thorough knowledge of the design and operational features of this equipment, as well as the methods of its design and practical application. This textbook is intended for students majoring in general engineering. The book comprises three parts. Part One provides general information on materials handling equipment—its role in production, its application in modern engineering practice, and an enumeration of the main types of materials handling equipment. Part Two is devoted to the description of the parts and units of hoisting machines: chains, ropes, pulleys, sprockets, drums, grabbing and braking gear, drives, and the hoisting, travelling, slewing, jib, and luffing mechanisms of cranes, along with their stability. General-purpose cranes employed in mechanical engineering include various types of stationary rotary cranes, cantilever and jib cranes (both fixed-path and trackless), as well as locomotive, crawler-mounted, and bridge-type cranes. Since these types of machines are also subjects for students' practical design work, the theory and design models are presented in relation to general-purpose machines. Special-type cranes are not considered in this textbook and are only mentioned briefly in the relevant sections of the text. The third and final part provides a brief description of elevators (lifts). Translated from the Russian by A. docs.description: ইভান তুর্গেনেভের 'পূর্বক্ষণ' (১৮৬০) তাঁর অতি বিখ্যাত উপন্যাসগুলির অন্যতম। এই উপন্যাস সম্বন্ধে তুর্গেনেভ বলেছিলেন, 'এটি বীরোচিত প্রকৃতির নরনারীর কাহিনী।' এই রোমান্টিক ও আবেগমূলক উপন্যাস নিয়ে সর্বদাই উত্তেজিত তর্কবিতর্ক' হয়েছে। এর মূল প্রসঙ্গ হচ্ছে এলেনা আর ইনসারভের খাঁটি ও আত্মত্যাগী প্রেমের সত্য কাহিনী। এলেন। রূশী অভিজাত মহিলা আর ইনসারভ বুলগেরীয় বিপ্লবী। তুর্গেনেভকে এই প্রেমের কাহিনী বলেন তাঁর বন্ধু, কারাতেয়েভ। তিনি সাহিত্যরসিক। ইনসারভের প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বী হিসেবে শুবিন নামে এই উপন্যাসে তিনি বর্তমান। তুর্গেনেভ লিখেছিলেন, 'যে সময় এই উপন্যাস প্রকাশিত হয় সেই সময়ের জন্যে এই উপন্যাসের আমি নাম দিই "পূর্বক্ষণ"। রাশিয়া তখন এক নব- জীবনের সন্ধিক্ষণে। সেই নবযুগের অগ্রদূত হচ্ছে এলেনা ও ইনসারভের মতো চরিররা।' 'সব সময়েই তাঁর আসন কবি পুশকিন, কবি লেরমন্তত আর ঔপন্যাসিক গোগলের সঙ্গে। পুশকিনকে তিনি অত্যন্ত শ্রদ্ধা করতেন। তিনি তাঁদের অন্যতম যার প্রতি রাশিয়া গভীরভাবে চির-কৃতজ্ঞ, কারণ রুশবাসীদের তিনি এমন কিছু দিয়েছেন যা অমর আর অমূল্য। সেটি হোলো তাঁর শিল্প, তাঁর অবিস্মরণীয় রচনাবলী। যে-কোনো গৌরবের চেয়ে এই গৌরব বেশী মহার্ঘ ও সুদৃঢ়।' গা দে মোপাসাঁ অনুবাদ: কামাক্ষীপ্রসাদ চট্টোপাধ্যায় প্রচ্ছদপট ও মুদ্রণ পরিকল্পনা: বাসভ All credits to Sovietbooksinbengali blog.

docs.creator: T. Granovsky
docs.description: As an important branch of the national economy, the textile industry is called upon to expand so as to satisfy the needs of the growing personal and industrial use of textiles. This is possible due to recent advances in the process and engineering developments in all fields of production, including good and reliable maintenance and repair. Modern machinery is characterised not only by high productivity and efficiency, but also by high complexity. A more economical operation necessitates a good organisation of technical maintenance and repairs of the available machines and equipment, and their proper adjustment according to prescribed technological procedures. Referring particularly to textile machinery, it should be noted that it works under extremely difficult conditions, i.e. high speeds (the rotational speed of the shaft at open-end spinning is 60,000 min-1 and higher), high dynamic loads (such as those obtained in scutchers, cards, drawing frames, and looms), etc. The majority of textile machines operate in a dust-laden atmosphere at high humidity. The working organs of textile machines are in direct contact with the processed raw materials, which causes machine wear. The proper lubrication of all rubbing machine parts is always important in order to ensure their faultless running, especially under conditions where textile enterprises are working in more than two shifts, which results in high loading on the machines. This causes the accelerated physical wear of working elements, mechanisms, and parts of textile machines, and various disarrangements that result in the reduction of labour productivity, machine efficiency, and product quality. The equipment used at textile enterprises is maintained in good operational condition by adjusters, assistant foremen, repair workers, fitters, oilers, etc. For the same purpose, textile enterprises have various facilities to carry out repair, design, and experimental jobs relating to the never-ending search for new methods and more economical operations. The operation and repair of modern textile machinery involve considerable labour and money inputs. The quality and costs of machine repairs are greatly dependent on the type of equipment used in repair shops, which must be efficient and reduce production costs. However, in order to be more economical, repair and maintenance operations should be performed by highly qualified and properly trained personnel. The present manual is designed as a study aid for the training of repair and maintenance personnel. Translated from the Russian by N. docs.creator: মিখাইল শলোখভ (Mikhail Sholokhov)
docs.description: "Quiet Flows the Don" by Mikhail Sholokhov is an epic novel that chronicles the lives of the Don Cossacks before, during, and after the Russian Revolution and Civil War. The story centers on the Melekhov family, particularly Grigori Melekhov, who struggles with his loyalties amid the chaos and turbulence of the time. The novel delves deeply into the themes of love, betrayal, and the relentless forces of history that shape the characters' lives. Sholokhov's vivid depiction of the Cossack community and the sweeping historical changes they endure paints a poignant and powerful picture of human resilience and the tragic consequences of war. --- মিখাইল শোলোখভের "কোয়ায়েট ফ্লোস দ্য ডন" একটি মহাকাব্যিক উপন্যাস যা রাশিয়ান বিপ্লব এবং গৃহযুদ্ধের আগে, চলাকালীন এবং পরে ডন কসাকদের জীবনকে কেন্দ্র করে। গল্পটি মেলেখভ পরিবার, বিশেষ করে গ্রিগরি মেলেখভকে কেন্দ্র করে আবর্তিত হয়, যে সময়ের বিশৃঙ্খলা এবং অশান্তির মধ্যে তার বিশ্বস্ততার সাথে সংগ্রাম করে। উপন্যাসটি প্রেম, বিশ্বাসঘাতকতা এবং ইতিহাসের নিরলস শক্তিগুলির থিমগুলিতে গভীরভাবে প্রবেশ করে যা চরিত্রগুলির জীবনকে আকৃতি দেয়। শোলোখভের কসাক সম্প্রদায়ের জীবন্ত চিত্রণ এবং তারা যে ব্যাপক ঐতিহাসিক পরিবর্তনের মধ্য দিয়ে যায় তা মানব সহনশীলতা এবং যুদ্ধের করুণ পরিণতির একটি মর্মস্পর্শী এবং শক্তিশালী ছবি আঁকে। অনুবাদ: বদরুল হাসান, অভিজিৎ পোন্দার All credits to sovietbooksinbengali blog.

docs.creator: R. B Winn ( Ed.)
docs.description: This collection presents papers delivered at the 1956 Moscow conference on psychotherapy in the Soviet Union. Compared with the earlier 1948 conference, the emphasis has shifted: while Pavlov’s influence is still strong, much greater attention is now given to suggestion, hypnosis, and speech therapy. Alcoholism emerges as a pressing concern, while psychoanalysis is scarcely mentioned. The volume highlights striking differences between Soviet and Western approaches, since psychotherapy in the Soviet context is treated largely apart from psychoses or mental deficiency. Yet the papers cover topics rarely discussed in American journals, such as the psychotherapy of smoking, hypnotherapy for asthma, psychotherapy in obstetrics and gynaecology, and the use of films in group therapy. Though reflecting Soviet attitudes and methodologies, these papers must be read in a spirit of scientific objectivity. Whatever differences exist across the Iron Curtain, genuine contributions to knowledge deserve attention wherever they arise.

docs.creator: S. Rumyantsev
docs.description: Industrial Radiology is a comprehensive technical manual that introduces the principles, methods, and applications of radiographic inspection using radioactive sources. The book is divided into four main parts. The first part lays the physical and engineering foundations, explaining the structure of matter, radioactive decay, and the interaction of various types of radiation with matter. The second part covers industrial radiographic techniques, focusing on the use of gamma radiation for flaw detection, including equipment, photographic materials, exposure conditions, and methods to locate and measure defects. The third part addresses labour protection and safety, detailing the biological effects of radiation and the protective measures required in industrial environments. The final part explores how defects affect the mechanical properties of materials and welds, linking inspection results to the structural integrity of components. Appendices provide additional technical data and standards. The book serves as both a theoretical guide and practical handbook for engineers, technicians, and safety personnel in the field of non-destructive testing. Translated from the Russian by S. docs.description: This book is intended for readers taking up the study of thermo­ dynamics, statistical physics and kinetics. Accordingly, readers are assumed to have a knowledge of elementary physics, higher mathematics and quantum mechanics. The sections marked by asterisks require a deeper knowledge and can be omitted on the first reading. The book aims to gradually familiarize readers with methods used in thermodynamics, statistical physics and kinetics, to show how the concrete problems should be solved and to bring readers as soon as possible to a level which enables them to tackle more specialized books and papers. It has therefore proved Jnecessary to include some matter, perhaps too simple for some, as well as problems that may be too difficult for others.

docs.creator: Sonya Richmond
docs.description: Based on notes made during the author’s journey across the Soviet Union, this book offers a survey of the musical scene in that vast country with its rich cultural heritage. The author describes the forms and methods through which the younger generation in the Soviet Union is introduced to the arts, showing how contact with the beautiful world of harmony, sound, and movement has, for millions of people, grown into a passion and a daily need, adding depth and colour to their lives. The book also presents an account of the historical evolution of musical culture in the USSR. Special emphasis is placed on its diverse multinational traditions, demonstrating that the true national spirit is the inexhaustible source of music’s power and charm, and that its major role in Soviet society is to help develop the harmonious individual with lofty moral principles. Sonya Richmond, author and journalist, was born in Lancashire, in the North-West of Great Britain. An Arts graduate, she also read for the Bar at the Inns of Court in London. Her books include Yoga and Your Health, The Art of Chinese Cooking, International Vegetarian Cookery, and Common Sense about Yoga. She has also written scripts for musical plays for the theatre and plays for radio. Her first novel, The Wrong Sister, is to be published in the United States. She is married to the Welsh writer John Summers, and they live by the sea on the south coast of Wales. Designed by Sergei Kuzyakov

docs.creator: Sharaf Rashidov
docs.description: The life story of Sharaf Rashidov, Uzbek writer, is typical of the majority of Uzbekistan's present-day intelligentsia. Born in a poor farmer's family, Rashidov had to start helping his father when he was only eleven. Jizak, where the author was born on November 6th, 1917, was a small village, the inhabitants of which eked out a bleak, hungry existence. The brightest moments of his childhood are associated for Rashidov with his father and mother. The people, bowed down by their back-breaking labour, found consolation in song. 'My father,' Sharaf Rashidov recalls, 'taught me to love work since early childhood, and my mother taught me to love songs.' As a schoolboy, Rashidov began to collect folk songs, to put legends and tales in writing, and soon after he tried his hand at writing poetry himself. His first big work, a poem about Soviet frontier guards called 'Border Guards,' was published in 1937. Rashidov graduated from the Philological Department of the Uzbek State University on the eve of the Great Patriotic War, and was appointed editor of the regional newspaper 'Lenin Yuly.' He volunteered soon after war broke out, was badly wounded, demobilized in 1942, and returned to Samarkand to take up his old job. His collection of war-time poetry 'Hatred Came Out' was published in 1945. Rashidov, with his rare journalistic flair, often published his articles in the press; in 1949, they were collected and put out in a separate edition entitled 'History's Verdict.' Rashidov combines writing with an active political career. In May 1950, he was elected Chairman of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet of Uzbekistan and Vice-Chairman of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet of the USSR. Rashidov became especially popular as a writer after his book 'The Victors' came out in 1951. Sharaf Rashidov is also widely known as an active fighter for peace. As a member of different delegations, he has visited Finland, China, India, Indonesia, the United Arab Republic, Pakistan, Burma, Vietnam, Afghanistan, and Mongolia. While sojourning in the different countries of the East, he met many of their authors and showed a keen interest in their folk legends, sayings, and stories. His story 'The Song of Kashmir' (1957) was based on a legend of the Kashmir people. A new novel has come out lately called 'Mightier than Storm,' which is a stirring story of men developing virgin lands. Sharaf Rashidov has been awarded two Orders of Lenin, the Order of the Red Banner of Labour, the Red Star, the Badge of Honour, and others Translated from the Russian by Olga Shartse Designed by K. Vysotskaya Note the decade is approximate

docs.description: Tras la publicación en castellano de la obra de K. A. Ribnikov «Análisis combinatorio», la editorial «Mir» presenta ahora la versión española de «Análisis combinatorio. Problemas y ejercicios». El colectivo de autores de este libro (incluido el autor del Prefacio) se formó durante el trabajo conjunto en la Facultad de Mecánica y Matemáticas de la Universidad Estatal de Moscú M. V. Lomonósov, donde se lleva a cabo una importante iniciativa para la formación de especialistas y el desarrollo de investigaciones científicas en el campo de la matemática discreta. El contenido de ambos libros está estrechamente ligado y persigue un objetivo común: ayudar al lector a adquirir tanto los hábitos de investigación en problemas teóricos del análisis combinatorio como las técnicas para resolver problemas combinatorios prácticos. La experiencia demuestra que el uso de estos libros amplía el conocimiento teórico y realza la importancia de la preparación práctica de los jóvenes matemáticos. En la edición rusa contribuyeron el doctor D. Katona (Hungría) y V. N. Luzguín (URSS), quienes participaron en la preparación de algunos capítulos, mejorando su contenido. Para la versión española, K. A. Ribnikov, A. M. Reviakin y B. S. Stechkin añadieron dos capítulos nuevos y un párrafo adicional, además de revisar minuciosamente textos, soluciones e indicaciones, incorporando así los avances recientes en el análisis combinatorio. docs.description: Les micromachines électriques à courant continu et alternatif occupent une place de choix dans les systèmes de commande et de régulation automatique, les calculateurs et les dispositifs gyrométriques, les appareils ménagers, etc. Parmi les monographies, manuels et guides, consacrés aux machines et micromachines électriques faisant partie des systèmes d’automatisme, qui se proposent d’analyser en détail les problèmes ayant trait à la conception, à la théorie et au calcul des ces dispositifs, il convient de citer les travaux des chercheurs: M. P. Kostenko, L. M. Piotrovski, A. G. Iossifian, V. S. Koulébakine, G. Kron, D. White, G. Wudson, S. Seely, L. Robischo et d’autres. Le but du présent ouvrage est de familiariser le futur spécialiste avec le principe de fonctionnement, la conception et surtout avec les caractéristiques et les possibilités des organes d’automatisme dont l’élément essentiel est la machine électrique, de lui faire apprendre à choisir judicieusement et correctement tel ou tel élément pour l’utiliser ensuite dans les systèmes d’automatisme modernes. Les auteurs remercient vivement leurs collègues dont les précieux conseils ont permis la parution de cet ouvrage. Traduit du, russe par B. Pavlov Un grand merci à Henri Leveque pour le scan original.

docs.description: This monograph presents a modern course in the mathematical theory of elasticity. Unlike the traditional approach to structuring such courses, this book is organised so that each chapter is devoted to a specific mathematical method and its applications to selected problems in elasticity theory. This structure helps focus the reader’s attention on the essential issues from a mathematical standpoint. It aligns with the current view of elasticity theory as a specialised branch of computational mathematics. For the benefit of beginners, Volume I (Chapters 1–3) includes the necessary mathematical background for understanding the central concepts of the course, as well as the fundamental principles of elasticity theory. Additionally, certain problem types in elasticity are introduced, with their solutions reduced to classical problems in the theory of partial differential equations. Volume II (Chapters 4–8) describes the following methods: the method of separation of variables, the method of analytic functions, the method of integral transformations, the method of potentials, variational methods, and finite difference methods. Significant attention is given to the numerical implementation of these methods and their applications to problems in elasticity theory. To demonstrate the effectiveness of these techniques, a wide array of recent scientific literature has been referenced. About the Authors Professor Vladimir Parton, D.Sc., Corresponding Member of the International Academy of Astronautics, is one of the leading Soviet scientists in the field of mechanics of deformable solids and strength of materials in machine building. Born in 1937 in Moscow, Professor Parton graduated from Moscow State University in 1959 and later taught at various academic institutions. Since 1972, he has served as Head of the Department of Higher Mathematics at the Moscow Institute of Chemical Engineering. A recipient of the USSR Council of Ministers Award, Professor Parton is an original theorist and a talented scientist. His work combines rigorous mathematical approaches with approximate mechanical techniques. With a strong technical background and experimental skill, he has achieved significant results in fracture mechanics, elasticity and plasticity theory, oscillation theory, soil mechanics, and numerical methods in mechanics. He is credited with founding a new branch in strength of materials known as fracture mechanics. Professor Parton is the author of over 100 scientific publications and three monographs, which have been translated into English and French. Dr Pyotr Perlin, D.Sc., is a faculty member at the Moscow Physico-Technical Institute. In addition to teaching elasticity and plasticity theory, Dr Perlin offers specialised courses in mathematical topics relevant to elasticity. He is the author of over 60 scientific papers on various aspects of the mechanics of deformable solids, with a particular focus on computational algorithm development. He has proposed a novel method for solving elastic-plastic problems in ideal plastic media and has developed programmes for ideal solidifying media. In recent years, Dr Perlin has devised an effective computational technique for solving singular integral equations arising in fundamental three-dimensional problems in elasticity theory.

La resolucion de los problemas expuestos en este libro requiere conocimientos a nivel de la escuela secundaria (el escaso material que a veces no se incluye en el programa de las escuelas secundarias, aqui se expone especialmente). No obstante, es preciso señalar que da curaría de los problemas presentados son problemas de elevad difficultad.  El presente libro consta de tres partes: "Algebra", "Geometria" y "Trigonometría", cada una de las cuales está dividida en subsecciones. En cada subsección los problemas están dispuestos en un orden determinado en el cual la dificultad de éstos va creciendo. docs.creator: V. G. Boltianski
docs.description: A los alumnos que cursan los últimos años de la enseñanza media, sobre todo a los que se interesan por las matemáticas, la física o la técnica, se les plantea con frecuencia la pregunta: ¿Qué son las matemá- ticas <<superiores»? A veces cuestiones de este tipo se analizan en las reuniones de los círculos matemáticos de las escuelas. El propósito del autor es explicar (de forma comprensible para dichos alumnos) ciertos conceptos de las matemáticas superiores*, como son los de derivada, ecuación diferencial, número e, logaritmo natural (lo corriente es que los alumnos se enteren de la exrstenCia de estos dos últimos conceptos y se interesen por ellos). He procurado que las explicaciones de estos conceptos sean lo más claras posibles, basándome para ello en la resolución de problemas tomados de la física Al proceder así, además del deseo de lograr la claridad antedicha, me ha guiado el de mostrar que los conceptos de las matemáticas <<superiores>> son el reflejo matemático de las propiedades de procesos reales que ocurren en la naturaleza y demostrar una vez más que las matemáticas están ligadas a la vida, y no al margen de ella, que se desarrollan, y no son una ciencia acabada e invariable. No todas las demostraciones y razonamientos contenidos en el libro se hacen con absoluta rigurosidad matemática. Algunos de estos razonamientos tienen carácter de aclaraciones. Este método de exposi- ción me ha parecido el más a propósito para un libro popular Esta obrita puede utilizarse en el trabajo de los círculos matemá- ticos y físicos de las escuelas e institutos de segunda enseñanza· para su comprensión bastan los conocimientos que se adquieren en los pri- meros nueve cursos de las escuelas de enseñanza media. Parte del material que figura en ella procede de un cursillo de conferencias que dio el autor a petición de los dirigentes de los círculos matemáticos escolares adjuntos a la Universidad de Moscú. Aprovecho la ocasión para expresar mi sincero agradecimiento a A I. Markushévich y A. Z 'Rívkin por sus valiosos consejos y sus observaciones al texto o,.riginal. docs.description: Los possibilités offertes par les ordinateurs pour la réalisation des expériences do calcul ont accéléré lo processus do mathématisation scientifique et techniquo. Un nombre do plus on plus grand de professions exigent des connaissances mathématiques approfondies. Pour subvenir aux besoins do renseignement, de nombreux mémentos et monographies ont été édités. Le présent ouvrage appartient à cette série. Cet ouvrage est consacré aux questions liées à l’élaboration des méthodes de solution numérique dos problèmes de mécaniquo et do physique mathématique. Actuellement, la théorie est en pleine essor et est loin d’être achevée. Néanmoins un certain nombre d’idées et de notions assez simples sont devenues fondamentales, elles sont exposées dans le présent ouvrage. Il est évident que la connaissance de l’alphabet des méthodes numériques no saurait faire du lecteur un calculateur qualifié. Il faut à cet effet une étude plus profonde de la littérature et surtout une grande expérience personnelle de résolution des problèmes concrets qui deviennent bien plus efficacos lorsque les fondements de la théorie sont clairs. La diversité des professions et du niveau de préparation du lecteur ont obligé l’auteur à renoncer à un exposé formel, traditionnel pour la littérature mathématique. Il est ainsi possible que certains mathématiciens professionnels raffinés trouvent cet ouvrage banal et peut-être même vulgaire, et nous sommes d’accord avec eux. Mais un « armement » mathématique complet, tenant compte^de toutes les éventualités logiques n’est indispensable que si l’on no dispose que do la logique mathématique. Mais il n’en est pas ainsi pour la majorité dos objectifs réels, ce qui permet d’écrire des ouvrages tels que celui-ci. D’un autre coté nous désirons que ce livre soit lu, nous avons donc essayé de faire.4o,r,te^e sorte que le lecteur n’ait pas de raisons pour le rejeter. ij L’exposé est mené au niveau do rigueur « physique». L’autour tient compte moins do la préparation mathématique du lecteur que do son bon sens et do son intelligence. En général, l’étude de telle ou telle question est menée sur un exemple typique simple, puis la possibilité do généralisation des résultats obtenus à des cas plus compliqués est envisagée. A la fin de chaque paragraphe on trouve des problèmes qui sont de difficultés différentes. La solution de la majorité do ces problèmes exige une compréhension claire des principes oxposés dans le texte et la faculté do les développer indépendamment. Les trois premiers paragraphes servont d’introduction et concernent les questions classiques de calcul numérique, à savoir les méthodes itératives de résolution des équations, les formules d’interpolation et de quadrature, l’intégration numérique des équations différentielles ordinaires. Les autres paragraphes formant le contenu essentiel de l’ouvrage sont consacrés aux méthodes numériques de résolution des équations aux dérivées partiollos, à l’élaboration et a l’étudo des algorithmes do calcul correspondants. On y envisage les procédés concrets d’approximation et de stabilité dos problèmes aux différences, les propriétés des schémas explicites et implicites, les méthodes d’élaboration des formules do calcul, les méthodes de résolution des systèmes d’équations aux différences, la possibilité do réalisation des algorithmes, etc.1 Nous proposons donc au lecteur une théorie simplifiée des méthodes numériques modernes de résolution des problèmes de mécanique, de dynamique des gaz et de physique mathématique donnant lieu à l’intégration des équations différentielles. Cet ouvrage est le fruit de longues années de travail de l'auteur dans le domaine des mathématiques appliquées et de conférences faites a l’Ecole Physico-technique do Moscou. Il peut être utile aux étudiants des facultés des sciences et des Grandes Ecoles pour une première connaissance des méthodes de calcul numérique. Les questions abordées dans les trois premiers paragraphes sont exposées dans de nombreux ouvrages et on peut les trouver en détail dans tous les cours do calcul approché. Traduit du russe par A. Sokovà Un grand merci à Henri Leveque pour le scan original.

docs.description: This book gives an account of the basic problems of medical cybernetics. Information theory, automatic control theory, algorithm theory, and other related concepts are presented in a form which can be grasped by physicians. General questions of biocybernetics, cybernetics of cellular and subcellular structures, cybernetics of physiological systems, problems of neurocybemetics, and the peculiarities of "man-machine" systems are considered. The book devotes a great deal of space to the application of cybernetic methods in diagnostics. The cybernetic aspects of medical electronics are examined. Problems of biological control are considered. The main trends in the development of bionics are reviewed. The book is intended for physicians of various specialties, for biologists, physiologists, engineers and technicians concerned with medical and biological problems, medical students, and for an extensive audience of readers interested in the application of cybernetics in medicine. Translation of "Vvedeniye v meditsinskuyu kibernetiku. Izdatel'stvo "Meditsina," Moscow, 1966.

docs.description: In this post, we will see the book  Solving Problems In Algebra and Trigonometry - V. Litvinenko, A. Mordkovich.  About the book: This study aid is intended for students of physical and mathemati­cal faculties of pedagogical institutes. The book contains about 2000 examples, problems, and exercises of which 1700 problems are for solving independently. Along with rather simple problems, there are also problems whose solution requires serious and sometimes inventive work. In the course of preparing the manuscript for print we tried to distribute the space among the basic types of “school” problems in algebra and trigonom­etry. Solving these problems will help the student to acquire pro­fessional skill necessary for a teacher who must know how to solve mathematical problems of the high-school level. This book is not only a collection of problems, it is rather a study aid for practical work, as can be seen in the structure of the text­ book. Each section contains necessary theoretical material and an ample number of worked examples (the total number of which amounts to about 300), which are very useful for the student pri­ marily from the methodological point of view. docs.description: The book is a practical guide to the erection of prefabricated reinforced-concrete structures and total-prefabricated buildings. It begins with the fundamentals of building classification, building types in civil, industrial and agricultural construction, and the main types of prefabricated reinforced-concrete structures. It then introduces the equipment required for erection work, including ropes and slings, erection appliances and tools, and cranes. Separate sections deal with the transportation, storage and handling of prefabricated elements, with attention to safe working practices. The main part of the book describes the erection of prefabricated reinforced-concrete structures, covering geodetic surveying, erection documentation, pre-assembly, foundations, columns, beams, slabs, stair flights, roofs, wall blocks, large-panel walls and partitions. It also discusses jointing and sealing, erection procedures, acceptance of completed structures, and the erection of agricultural buildings. The final chapter deals with safety rules, organisation of erection work, construction management and labour organisation, making the book a practical reference for construction engineers, supervisors and workers involved in prefabricated construction. docs.description: Durante varias décadas, el desarrollo de la química ha mostrado una clara tendencia hacia el uso de métodos físicos en la investigación científica. Este enfoque es particularmente evidente en la cinética química, que estudia las velocidades y mecanismos de las transformaciones químicas. Uno de los principales desafíos en este campo es determinar los mecanismos detallados de procesos químicos complejos, especialmente aquellos que involucran productos intermedios inestables. Para identificar y detectar estas partículas, se han empleado diversos métodos, como técnicas espectrales, espectroscopía de masas, polarografía y calorimetría. En los últimos años, la cinética química ha experimentado un cambio acelerado con la introducción de métodos radioespectroscópicos, como la resonancia paramagnética electrónica (RPE) y la resonancia magnética nuclear (RMN). Además, métodos clásicos como la espectroscopía infrarroja y ultravioleta han evolucionado gracias a mejoras en los equipos, mientras que técnicas fluorescentes y quimioluminiscentes, como la fotólisis impulsiva y la luminiscencia radiotérmica, han ganado relevancia en el estudio de partículas de corta vida. Hoy en día, prácticamente todas las investigaciones cinéticas utilizan la cromatografía de gas-líquido, conocida por su alta sensibilidad y versatilidad. Además, métodos matemáticos y computacionales, como el análisis de espectros de RPE y RMN o la resolución de sistemas de ecuaciones diferenciales, se han integrado en la investigación química. La cinética química se ha convertido en una base científica crucial para procesos tecnológicos importantes, permitiendo el estudio cuantitativo de mecanismos en química orgánica e inorgánica. Este avance ha impulsado el uso de métodos experimentales modernos, tanto físicos como físico-químicos, aunque su aplicación a menudo requiere equipos costosos y conocimientos teóricos avanzados. En la Universidad Lomonósov de Moscú, los estudiantes tienen la oportunidad de familiarizarse con estas técnicas, lo que no solo beneficia a los alumnos de la cátedra de cinética química, sino también a un público más amplio de estudiantes y posgraduados en química Revisado por el académico N. docs.description: In this volume, scientific research reports written in recent years at the Radio-Astronomy Laboratory in the field of radio-astronomical apparatus and methods of observation are collected. Modern radiometers of high sensitivity, using masers and parametric amplifiers, have been installed at the RT-22 radio telescope of the Laboratory's Radio-Astronomy Station. Some of the papers are devoted to a description of these original radiometers and to their operating conditions. Considerable space is given to a description of the meter-wave equipment and to the adjustment of the DKR-1000 diapason cruciform radio telescope. Two papers describe radio interferometers with radio relaying. This method of increasing the resolving power is extremely effective, and it is expected that it will be further developed under laboratory conditions, primarily in the meter wave range. Problems of radio-telescope design occupy an important place in contemporary radio astronomy and radio engineering. Three articles are devoted to this important line of work. In 1966, an experiment was carried out at the Radio-Astronomy Laboratory on the investigation of the solar wind by a radio-astronomical method. The experiment gave substantially new data concerning the nonuniformity of the plasma around the sun; the experimental part of the work carried out is described in the collection. The Russian text was published by Nauka Press in Moscow in 1969 for the Academy of Sciences of the USSR as Volume 47 of the Proceedings (Trudy) of the P. N. Lebedev Physics Institute. docs.creator: Nikolai Ostrovsky
docs.description: "How the Steel Was Tempered" How the Steel Was Tempered is a Soviet novel by Nikolai Ostrovsky. It tells the story of Pavel Korchagin, a young man who becomes a dedicated revolutionary fighter during the Russian Civil War and subsequent socialist construction. Through personal hardship and immense physical suffering, Pavel embodies the virtues of self-sacrifice, perseverance, and loyalty to the communist cause. His journey from an enthusiastic youth to a battle-hardened, paralyzed soldier reflects the ideological tenets of socialist realism, emphasizing the triumph of the human spirit over adversity and the importance of collective over individual goals. Nikolai Ostrovsky and His Struggles Nikolai Ostrovsky, the author of How the Steel Was Tempered, faced significant personal struggles throughout his life. Born in 1904, he joined the Komsomol and later the Red Army, participating actively in the Russian Civil War. At the age of 19, he was severely injured, leading to paralysis and blindness due to a progressive illness. Despite these debilitating conditions, Ostrovsky wrote his novel using a special frame to guide his pen, dictating to his family, and later typing with one finger. His determination to continue his work despite immense physical suffering mirrored the resilience and dedication of his protagonist, making his life story an inspiring testament to perseverance and the human spirit. docs.description: An anthology of short stories from Soviet Union. This third volume in the Soviet Life and Letters series of Soviet short stories seeks to introduce readers to the emotional and intellectual life of contemporary Soviet citizens. It brings together both familiar names like Simonov, Gorbatov, and Dovzhenko—who is more widely known as a film director—and newer writers. A unifying theme across all the stories is a spirit of exaltation: ordinary individuals who rise to meet extraordinary circumstances with calmness and resilience. The stories balance heroism with Russian realism, showing characters who are brave yet afraid, and heroes often surprised by their own courage. The generational divide is another recurring theme, especially visible in stories such as The Birthday and White Mittens. Younger characters view the war as a struggle that shapes their future, while older characters experience deeper grief and resignation. The bond between parents and children, particularly between soldiers and their families, appears frequently. On the battlefield, the focus is on duty and bravery; at home, it shifts to longing, affection, and the desire for a return to normal life. Kaverin's stories offer a poignant portrayal of young Soviet citizens navigating war and loss, yet managing to create new emotional connections and families out of devastation. These narratives reflect not only Soviet life but also actively shape it. Literature in the Soviet Union does not merely mirror reality; it contributes to building it. The opening essay by Tikhonov, a veteran poet from Leningrad, offers an insider’s view into the function of literature within Soviet society. Understanding the spirit captured in these stories is essential, for it foreshadows the direction of global history. Soviet literature, therefore, serves both as a lens and as a force in shaping the collective Soviet consciousness. docs.description: Le présent ouvrage fait une tentative de caractériser d’une façon plus ou moins complète toutes les parties constitutives de la microélec­ tronique. Une attention particulière est portée aux questions qui n’ont pas été suffisamment étudiées dans les manuels mentionnés: la physique des transistors, la technique de synthèse des circuits à transistors ainsi que la caractéristique générale des circuits intégrés. L’accent étant mis sur ces questions, le volume limité du livre n’a pas permis de traiter de façon aussi détaillée les aspects constructifs et technologiques, les questions de la métrique et certaines autres questions. Or ce défaut ne nous semble pas assez important puisque des renseignements complémentaires sur ces questions peuvent être puisés dans, les ouvrages mentionnés plus haut. Le livre « Principes de la microélectronique » est le premier des trois manuels destinés à assurer une formation universelle des ingé­ nieurs concepteurs de circuits intégrés, c’est-à-dire des spécialistes bien familiarisés avec tous les trois aspects de la microélectronique x). L’auteur espère que ses idées réalisées dans ce livre seront approu­ vées par les étudiants, les chaires intéressées, ainsi que par les spé­ cialistes qui l’utiliseront pour le perfectionnement de leur formation en microélectronique. De plus, il espère que le cours « Principes de la microélectronique » inspiré par le présent manuel deviendra avec le temps aussi traditionnel que les cours « Dispositifs à semi-conduc­ teurs » ou « Bases théoriques de l ’électrotechnique ». Ceci contri­ buerait sans doute à l’uniformité de la formation des spécialistes d’un même profil ainsi qu’à la compréhension mutuelle des spécia­ listes de profils connexes (spécialistes des « éléments » et spécialistes des «appareils ») qui se mettent inévitablement en contact lors de l’élaboration de systèmes microélectroniques complexes. Traduit du russe par V. Kolimêev Un grand merci à Henri Leveque pour le scan original.

docs.description: Ce livre donne une exposition détaillée et systématique des principes fondamentaux de la mécanique quantique non relativiste pour ceux qui ne connaissent pas le sujet. Le caractère de la physique des microparticules et les problèmes de la physique des microphénomènes (interférence des amplitudes, principe de superposition, spécificité des processus de mesure, causalité en mécanique quantique) sont considérés sur la base des concepts d'amplitudes de probabilité. En outre, les systèmes de mécanique quantique-microparticules - avec deux états de base sont analysés en détail. L'appareil de mécanique quantique est considéré comme une synthèse des concepts de la physique et de la théorie des opérateurs linéaires.  Un certain nombre de problèmes et d'exemples spécialement élaborés ont été inclus afin de démontrer le fonctionnement de l'appareil. Traduit du Russe par s. Medvédev Un grand merci à Henri Leveque pour le scan original. English version here

docs.description: This is the third Russian edition of “Automation in Electrical Power Systems" which covers design and operation of automatic control devices intended to prevent and clear faults in electrical power systems and restore power to the loads in the event of breakdown thus assuring continuity of the supply. The reliable and unfailing operation of such devices has been ensured through the research and development effort put into automatic power control systems. The book discusses automatic control in conjunction with protective relaying, since the required reliability and economy of power system operation can be achieved through the combined action of both groups of equipment, each cate­ ring for specific aspects in functioning of loads and generating sources. The wide use of automatic control systems adds to the reliability, stability and economy of power supply systems and takes some burden from attending personnel. The book is designed as a study guide for students of power engineering secondary schools. It may also interest engineers concerned with the operation, installation and design of protective relaying and automatic devices used in electric power stations and networks.

docs.description: Les appareils électriques (Tautomatisme et de commande trouvent une large application pratiquement dans toutes les branches de l’économie et font partie des systèmes de commande automatiques et non automatiques des équipements divers. Leur importance augmente constamment et on les produit en nombre croissant. A l’heure actuelle, on distingue les appareils électriques à contacts et sans contacts. Les appareils à contacts réalisent la commutation des circuits électriques à l’aide de systèmes à contacts et d’extinction d’arc comportant des éléments mobiles. Les appareils sans contacts n’ayant pas de pièces mobiles, la commutation des circuits se fait à l’aide de dispositifs statiques utilisant les semiconducteurs et les amplificateurs magnétiques. Les appareils à contacts trouveront, de toute apparence, le plus large emploi pour des courants et tensions nominaux relativement grands, les appareils sans contacts, pour de faibles courants et tensions à commuter, une grande fréquence de fonctionnement et dans les conditions où le courant commuté doit changer en continu. Le but du présent ouvrage est d’étudier le principe de fonctionnement des appareils électriques d’automatisme et de commande les plus employés, les phénomènes physiques, les rapports et dépendances essentiels et les paramètres techniques des appareils. Les dépendances mathématiques sont données, au possible, sous une forme commode pour les calculs élémentaires des appareils et sont accompagnées par des valeurs numériques des coefficients et grandeurs qui y figurent. Le manuel est basé sur le cours que l’auteur a professé durant de longues années à l’Institut énergétique de Moscou. Conformément au programme de ce cours, on expose au début la théorie élémentaire des appareils électriques, et on examine ensuite les principaux types des appareils électriques d’automatisme et de commande. Je remercie vivement tous mes collègues dont les conseils précieux ont contribué à la parution de ce livre. Traduit du russe par A. Grigoriev Un grand merci à Henri Leveque pour le scan original.

docs.creator: E. Kazakevich
docs.description: "A waxen idol standing beside a fire where pottery was being baked began to melt. 'Why are you so cruel to me?' the idol addressed the fire. 'To pottery, you impart strength, but me you destroy?' The fire replied, 'You have only your own nature to blame. I am always the same.' German professor Sebastian, whom fate had thrown together with Sergei Lubentsov, the main hero of the novel, had done much thinking before he told the parable. The profoundly humane work of the Soviet commandant of the town of Lauterburg convinced the old scholar of the advantages of new relations between people. Sebastian realised the line between men did not necessarily coincide with the borderline between states. A wartime scout, Sergei Lubentsov wrote in his notebook on becoming commandant of the German town: 'The commandant is always right, because he is backed by armed force. That is why he must see to it that he is really always right: like a purifying flame, he is intent on melting the idols of time-honoured prejudice, which stood in his way to the hearts of German people. His trust in man served as a beacon which lit up this laborious path.' The English reader has had the opportunity of reading three books by E. Kazakevich in English. These are:  Star ,  Spring on the Oder ,  Heart of a Friend . These novels form the basis of the soldier-writer's works.  House on the Square  is the logical sequel to  Spring on the Oder . However, while  Spring on the Oder  deals with the Soviet Army’s great victory over fascist Germany,  House on the Square  describes the victors 'building peace,' the day-to-day work of the Soviet Commandant's Office in Lauterburg. This deep book reveals the author's thoughts on the destinies and fates of the peoples."

docs.description: The theory of mechanisms faces the challenge of organising the vast body of mechanical designs developed in engineering practice. Information about these mechanisms is scattered across textbooks, monographs, journals and patents, making it difficult for engineers, designers and inventors to find suitable solutions for specific purposes. This work addresses that need by presenting a systematic collection of mechanisms, classified by their structure and function, with drawings and descriptions to facilitate their selection and use. Originally published in four volumes in Russian between 1947 and 1952, the work has been completely revised and expanded into five volumes. Together, the volumes cover lever, gear, cam, friction, flexible-link, hydraulic, pneumatic and electrical mechanisms. The revised edition includes additional classifications, clearer illustrations, expanded explanations of complex structures, and, where necessary, analytical relationships and kinematic characteristics. Designed as a practical handbook for engineers, technicians and inventors, it aims to make knowledge of mechanisms accessible even to readers without specialised training. Volume II of Mechanisms in Modern Engineering Design continues the systematic study of lever mechanisms, presenting drawings and descriptions of mechanisms composed of turning and sliding pairs. It includes combined mechanisms such as lever-cam, gear-lever and lever-ratchet systems, as well as mechanisms with flexible and elastic links. The second part concludes with wedge-lever and lever-screw mechanisms. The volume contains 1,376 mechanisms, bringing the total across both volumes on lever mechanisms to 2,288. It follows the classifications based on structural features and functions established in Volume I, which also explains how to use the schematic representations, descriptions and classification system. Alphabetical subject indexes at the end of each part help readers locate individual mechanisms. docs.description: The present book is devoted to the study of the stability of elastic systems under the action of non-conservative forces. It is wellknown that for such systems the usual methods of the theory of elastic stability, which are based on an examination of forms of equilibrium close to the undisturbed form, are in general no longer applicable. Here we need to use more general methods and more involved means of investigation. The book contains an introduction and four chapters. The first chapter covers general problems, their formulation and methods of solution. It is based on a paper read by the author at the Third All-Soviet Mathematical Conference in Moscow in 1956. The remaining chapters are devoted to applications. The second chapter considers the stability of elastic systems under the action of non-conservative forces which during the process of loss of stability behave according to some pre-determined law (so called “follower” forces). The third chapter considers the stability of high-speed rotating elastic rotors under the action of various disturbing forces, for example, forces of internal friction, hydrodynamic and electric forces, etc. The fourth chapter deals with problems of stability of elastic systems in a high-speed gas flow; particular attention is paid to the problem of supersonic flutter of elastic plates and shells. A number of problems are con­ sidered in non-linear form, which enables the behavior of the system to be studied after loss of stability. It will be seen that all these problems are of considerable interest in present day mechanical, aeronautical and rocket engineering.

docs.description: Ce cours de mécanique des milieux continus est donc conçu dans l’esprit des indications précédentes. Il représente une version amplifiée du cours professé par l’auteur pendant plusieurs années à l’Université de Moscou et dont le texte existait primitivement en 1966-1968 sous forme polycopiée. Le cours comprend deux tomes. Dans le premier tome sont exposées les méthodes mathématiques et les notions universelles, les bases de la thermodynamique et de l’électrodynamique. Nous espérons qu’un bref exposé des notions de base de ces disciplines sera utile non seulement aux lecteurs se spécialisant dans la méca­ nique. Dans le premier tome on établit également les fondamentales équations physiques et relations complémentaires aux fortes dis­ continuités, ainsi que les conditions initiales, les conditions aux limites et autres. En même temps on attire l’attention sur l’impor­ tance des méthodes approchées, ayant trait, par exemple, à la linéa­ risation des problèmes. C’est dire que le premier tome prépare les bases à la construction de modèles concrets des milieux continus et met en relief les éléments types des procédés de schématisation des problèmes posés. On donne également en supplément au premier tome deux articles dont la matière est organiquement liée au sujet du cours. Le premier traite de la théorie générale de la symétrie dans l’espace tridimen­ sionnel, du problème de classification des cristaux à symétrie ponc­ tuelle et de la théorie de la structure des fonctions tensorielles non linéaires de plusieurs arguments tensoriels. Le second est un exposé systématique de la méthode générale de construction des modèles complexes des milieux continus à degrés de liberté intérieurs,, méthode basée sur l’équation variationnelle universelle. Nous souhaitons que le lecteur prenne connaissance de ces arti­ cles, nécessaires à la lecture compétente d’ouvrages consacrés aux nouveaux théories et modèles de la mécanique des milieux continus. Le second tome traite des modèles concrets et des théories de- l’hydrodynamique, de la dynamique des gaz, de l’élasticité et de la plasticité. On y résout les problèmes types dans le cadre des modèles, classiques et l’on y établit les régularités les plus importantes qu’on rencontre dans de vastes classes de mouvements et de processus. Traduit du russe par V. Platonov et revu par V. Parton Un grand merci à Henri Leveque pour le scan original.

docs.description: En la actualidad, el uso de métodos matemáticos para el tratamiento de datos experimentales es esencial en todas las ciencias exactas. Aunque existen numerosos manuales sobre este tema, la especificidad de la química física justifica la creación de un nuevo libro que combine rigor y simplicidad. Este manual busca llenar un vacío en la formación de los estudiantes de química, quienes a menudo carecen de conocimientos sólidos en métodos estadísticos y análisis numérico. El libro aborda fundamentos como la teoría de errores, el análisis de regresión y métodos gráficos, con ejemplos basados en problemas típicos de la química física. Su objetivo es ser útil tanto para estudiantes como para investigadores que emplean métodos físico-químicos en su trabajo. Sin embargo, la aplicación de la estadística matemática en el tratamiento de datos experimentales no está exenta de desafíos. Existen dificultades en la representación de resultados, la comparación de datos entre autores y la terminología utilizada. Además, persiste un prejuicio sobre la complejidad y la utilidad de estos métodos. Este libro intenta superar estas barreras, destacando la importancia de considerar errores sistemáticos y de escala, y promoviendo el uso de métodos estadísticos en la química física. También se enfoca en enseñar a los estudiantes a realizar cálculos precisos y a aplicar métodos analíticos y gráficos de manera efectiva. Aunque originalmente concebido como un suplemento, el libro se amplió para incluir una variedad de métodos y soluciones, con el fin de despertar el interés y demostrar las posibilidades que ofrece el análisis numérico en la investigación química. docs.description: To describe all the most import­ ant problems that motivated the physics of the 20th century would require many volumes. What the authors have sought to achieve in this book is to con­ centrate on the more funda­ mental issues and to trace their historical development. Whilst no aspect of modern physics is uninteresting, the topics covered here are certain to fascinate any reader, whether trained in physics or not. The achievements and promise of exciting fields — atomic physics, astrophysics, quantum theory, elementary particle physics, quantum elec­tronics, and nonlinear physics — are covered. No attempt has been made to restrain the authors to a dry presentation of the inception of a particular theme, they have striven to enlighten the logic of the evolution of each concept and foresee what direction the future may take. docs.creator: G. Zhdanov
docs.description: This book offers a comprehensive exploration of cosmic rays, their properties, and their role in modern physics. Beginning with historical accounts of accidental discoveries, it guides the reader through methods developed to detect and visualise invisible radiation. The narrative introduces key experimental techniques such as fog chambers and photographic methods, and addresses fundamental questions about the nature of particles—distinguishing between rays and matter. Subsequent chapters delve into the formation of particle cascades in air and lead, the appearance of mesons, and their interactions with atomic nuclei, helping to illuminate the mysterious behaviour of subatomic particles. Further sections of the book focus on the disintegration of nuclei by cosmic rays, the resulting “nuclear stars” and “special showers,” and the implications of these phenomena for understanding the internal structure of matter. The concluding chapters examine the practical applications of cosmic rays, including the possibility of artificially generating them, and speculate on their potential as new energy sources. Drawing connections between observational data and theoretical models, the book presents cosmic ray physics as a vital field that bridges fundamental research with technological possibilities, offering valuable insight into both the microcosm of particles and the macrocosmic processes of the universe.
