docs.description: ### Dr. Ismagilova’s Book on the Ethnic Problems of Tropical Africa Dr. Ismagilova’s book on the ethnic problems of Tropical Africa is the first monograph in Marxist African studies to extensively cover these issues in this region. The author utilizes a wealth of diverse source materials and literature in various languages, along with her personal observations in seventeen African countries. The book's value lies in its ability to highlight and differentiate the general and specific aspects of the complex ethnic evolution of Tropical Africa, demonstrating the applicability of general laws and patterns of social and ethnic development in African conditions. Dr. Ismagilova discusses the role of the ethnic factor in contemporary Tropical Africa, its impact on political life, and the efforts of governments to implement social and economic measures. She reveals the social roots and nature of ethnic contradictions and antagonisms in this area, discusses the principles set out in African government and party programs for addressing national issues, and describes the steps taken by several governments in this regard. Additionally, Dr. Ismagilova examines the special nature of ethnic processes and national integration in Africa, emphasizing the close link between ethnic problems and social and economic reform programs. She outlines possible methods for addressing the ethnic problems of Tropical Africa, dedicating a special chapter to the approaches used in the Soviet Union. Dr. Ismagilova believes that the ethnic problems in Tropical Africa can be resolved through consistent and profound social reforms, acknowledging that this will be a lengthy process of social evolution, not easily addressed through administrative solutions, and ultimately requiring a profound transformation of African society. ### Dr. Roza Ismagilova: A Leading Soviet Africanist Dr. Roza Ismagilova, a leading Soviet Africanist with over twenty-five years of experience in the history and social anthropology of Africa, was born in Tomsk, Siberia, to a Tatar geologist. Educated in Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan, she observed the national policies of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union. After graduating in history from Central Asian University in Tashkent, she pursued postgraduate studies at the Institute of Ethnography of the USSR Academy of Sciences in Moscow, earning her Candidate’s degree in 1955 and her doctorate in history in 1971. Dr. Ismagilova worked at the Institute of Ethnography until 1960, when she joined the newly founded Africa Institute of the Academy, where she has been a staff member since its inception. A skilled linguist, Dr. Ismagilova speaks Tatar and Russian (her mother tongue), and has studied Kazakh, Uzbek, German, French, English, Portuguese, and Swahili. She has visited seventeen African countries, conducting on-site studies of ethnic problems, and has participated in numerous international conferences, symposia, and seminars. An editor of several scientific publications, her own works (in Russian) include The Peoples of Kenya under the Colonial Regime (1956), The Peoples of Nigeria. Ethnic Composition and Brief Ethnographic Description (1963), and Ethnic Problems of Contemporary Tropical Africa (1973). Translated from the Russian by A.N. Uthernitt Designed by D. docs.description: This book offers a comprehensive introduction to the fundamental principles and applications of electrical engineering. Beginning with electrostatics and the electron theory, it develops a clear understanding of electric fields, potential, capacitance, and dielectric materials. It then explores the core laws of direct current, electrochemical effects, and the thermal and magnetic phenomena associated with electric currents. Through systematic explanations and practical exercises, the early chapters establish a solid grounding in electrical concepts and materials essential for understanding both theory and real-world electrical systems. The later chapters advance towards the study of electromagnetic induction, alternating current systems, and polyphase networks, leading naturally to the detailed treatment of transformers, synchronous machines, and induction motors. The text further includes discussions on rectifiers, measuring instruments, and electric motor drives, along with topics such as storage batteries and electrical safety. With its combination of theoretical clarity, applied examples, and systematic progression, the book serves as both an instructional text and a practical reference for students and engineers engaged in electrical and electronic engineering. docs.description: This book treats the fundamentals of a new branch of mining sci­ence -- rock physics. It defines the subject, the basic trends in rese­arch, and concepts of the physical properties of rock. The mechani­cal, acoustic, thermal, electrical, magnetic, and radiation proper­ties of rocks are discussed in detail, and the effect dn them of external fields (viz. temperature, pressure, moisture, etc.) is ana­lysed. Fundamental problems of the utilization of these properties in mining are also discussed. The concluding chapter attempts to establish the intterrelationships between the physical properties of rocks, and the principles for a classification and certification of rocks according to their physical properties. The book is designed as a text­ book for mining students but it may be found useful by all who are working or interested in the field of rock physics.  ABOUT THE AUTHORS   Vladimir Rzhevsky, Corr. Mem. USSR Academy of Sciences, D. Tech. Sc., is Rector of the Moscow Mining Institute and a specialist in the technology mechanization, and automation ot mining and in the physics of rocks. He is the author or editor of many textbooks and other publications in these fields, including works on ultrasonic control and research in mining, and the classification and certification of rocks by their physical properties. Gottfried Novik, Cand. Tech. Sc., is reader in rock physics at the Moscow Mining Institute. Apart from the investigation of the physical properties of rocks, the main line of his work is the breaking and melting of rock by means of high-frequency currents. He has published around 50 pa­ pers on his research.

docs.description: The present textbook offers a comprehensive course in theoretical mechanics, incorporating elements of analytical mechanics. It is structured in three main parts: statics, kinematics, and dynamics. The section on statics begins with the simpler case of plane force systems, progressing to the general equilibrium of a rigid body and covering topics such as friction and internal forces in trusses (Chapter 4). The kinematics section places particular emphasis on Chapter 9, which discusses the general motion of a free rigid body using Euler’s theorem, with Chapter 10 providing alternative proofs for plane motion that do not rely on this theorem. The dynamics section centres around Chapter 19, which outlines the general principles of particle system dynamics through the D'Alembert-Lagrange equation. This approach, influenced by the pedagogical styles of Joukowski, Chaplygin, and Chetayev, avoids introducing constraint reactions and instead uses virtual displacements and first integrals to solve problems. Additional optional chapters cover advanced topics such as stability, vibrations, impacts, variable mass motion, central force fields, and satellite trajectories. The book concludes with mechanics of flexible inextensible threads. With over 200 problems—120 with full solutions and the rest with hints and answers—the textbook serves both as a study guide and a problem-solving resource for engineering students, suitable for classroom instruction and self-study alike. docs.description: The purpose of this book was to generalize the essential facts and ideas about biogeochemical cycles and the mass distribution of chemical elements in the world’s land biosphere. The reason for this endeavour is undoubtedly because the predominant mass of the Earth’s living organisms is confined to land. The land is also the habitat of humanity, and it is the land that has had to sustain the onus and odium of humanity’s productive activities. The study of biogeochemical processes that occur on land is therefore an important issue. The land, to a first approximation, is one of the two general blocks of the biosphere (the other is the ocean). For this reason, the overall estimated mass of the elements in biogeochemical cycles on land provides a basis for estimating the material balance on a planetary scale. A more detailed approach show that the rate of biogeochemical processes and the migrating mass is strongly susceptible to hydrothermal conditions on the Earth’s surface and several other factors. In view of this, the emphasis is on the features of biogeochemical cycles in the major natural zones and, particularly, at the land-ocean interface where the cyclic mass exchange processes are subject to the enormous power of the ocean. This book is to a certain extent a summary of the author’s experience and experimental biogeochemical material collected in the tundra, taiga, steppes and deserts of Eurasia, in the tropics of Africa and on islands in the Indian and Arctic oceans. docs.description: L’ouvrage « Fondements de la théorie des oscillations » que nous avons le plaisir de Vous offrir représente la traduction de la secondo édition russe revue et complétée. Nous nous sommes efforcés de conserver et meme de mettre on relief l’idée principale de ce livro, à savoir, de montrer au lecteur le caractère rationnel et efficace do rapproche générale systématique de l’élude des processus vibratoires sur les exemples des systèmes les plus répandus et des méthodes d’analyse et de calcul adéquates en expliquant la physique des évolutions en cours. La structure et le contenu du livre sont la réplique du cours de la théorie des vibrations professé par l’auteur pendant plusieurs années à la faculté de la physique de 1’ Université de Moscou aux étudiants se spécialisant dans la radiophysique et électronique. Les brillants ouvrages des savants français dans le domaine d’analyse et de calcul de certains systèmes oscillants (F. Le Corbeiller, A. Liénard, O. Blaquière, etc.), les études mathématiques fondamentales de II. Poincaré ont depuis longtemps fait de la Franco un des pays créateurs de la théorie générale des vibrations. Le but do ce livre n’est donc pas d’étonner le lecteur français par de nouvelles données ou méthodes. On s’est posé une tâche plus modeste. On voudrait que la lecture de ce livre apporte au lecteur des lumières sur la nature spécifique de l’étude des processus oscillatoires proprement dits, sur la multitude générale des systèmes oscillants dont chaque classe est décrite par une approche appropriée s’appuyant non pas sur ce qui oscille mais bien sur le comportement oscillatoire particulier des systèmes dynamiques étudiés. C’est un manuel à l’usage de ceux qui étudient les processus oscillatoires dans divers systèmes dynamiques. Pour les spécialistes des branches radiophysique et radiotechnique il constitue la base des bases et pour les autres spécialités il sera fort utile pour la compréhension des caractéristiques générales des processus oscillatoires qu’ils rencontrent. Nous serons très heureux, chers lecteurs, si notre livre Vous aide quelque peu dans votre travail. Sous la direction de V. MIGOULINE Traduit du russe par Valéry Platonov Un grand merci à Henri Leveque pour le livre

docs.description: This textbook is intended for students of secondary special schools majoring in the chemical technology of petroleum and gas. The book deals with the chemical and physical properties of petroleum and hydrocarbon gases, the service characteristics of the most important petroleum products, describes processing methods, and gives flow diagrams of the refining of petroleum and hydrocarbon’ gases, the equipment used for conducting the processes, monitoring and automating them, as well as economic characteristics.  The material has been set out in accordance with the latest achievements of science and engineering and with a view to the present state and prospects for the development of the petroleum refining industry. As regards the chemistry of petroleum, the authors have treated not only the traditional topics of the origin of petroleum and the ways of studying its composition, but also the fundamental information on the chemistry of the major refining processes. In describing the technology, the authors have given special attention to the most popular progressive processes. The present textbook has been written by well-known specialists in the field of petroleum chemistry and technology. The late Vladimir Eriikh worked for over 40 years in the petroleum refining and petrochemical industry, his last position being Deputy Director of the Mendeleev Chemical Technology School, Leningrad. He was the author of a number of textbooks and training aids, including The Chemistry of Petroleum, The Technical Analysis of Petroleum Products and Gas, and The Technology of Synthetic Liquid Fuel (all in Russian). Maiya Rasina, after many years in the petroleum refining industry, devoted herself to the training of specialists in the field and is currently an instructor at the Mendeleev Chemical Technology School, Leningrad. Her principal interests include the development of curricula and methodological materials for courses in the chemistry and technology of petroleum. Mikhail Rudin, Candidate of Sciences (Chemistry), is Deputy Chief Engineer of the Leningrad State Designing Institute of the Petrochemical Industry (Lengiproneftekhim). He has worked in the field for almost 30 years, concentrating primarily on the design and modernisation of petroleum refineries. He is the author of numerous textbooks and monographs, including The Chemistry of Petroleum and Gas, The General Facilities of a Petroleum Refinery, and The Design of Petroleum Refineries (all in Russian). docs.description: La théorie des équations intégrales de Fredholm, incontestablement l’une des plus grandes réalisations de l’analyse mathématique, a pris corps vers le début du XXe siècle. Elle a exercé une influence déterminante sur l’évolution de différentes branches de la physique mathématique et, en particulier, sur celle de la théorie des problèmes aux limites pour les équations aux dérivées partielles. Les équations de Fredholm ont notamment permis, à elles seules, une analyse exhaustive du problème de Dirichlet et du problème de Neumann pour les fonctions harmoniques. Des résultats du plus haut intérêt ont été obtenus dans l’application des équations de Fredholm à l’étude des problèmes plans de l’élasticité. L’apport de N. Muskhelishvili et D. Sherman y est prépondérant. La théorie des équations intégrales singulières multidimensionnelles, qui est une généralisation naturelle de la théorie des équations de Fredholm, a grandement contribué au succès des travaux consacrés à l’étude des problèmes tridimensionnels de l’élasticité. L’appareil de la théorie des intégrales et des équations intégrales singulières multidimensionnelles a été essentiellement élaboré par F. Tricomi, J. Jiro, S. Mikhline, V. Kupradze. Grâce au développement du calcul électronique, les équations intégrales sont de plus en plus largement utilisées par les ingénieurs pour les calculs de résistance. Vu l’importance que revêtent les équations intégrales, les auteurs ont entrepris une tentative de présenter dans un livre une étude qui se veut complète sur la théorie des équations intégrales, aussi bien régulières que singulières, et leurs applications aux problèmes de la théorie de l’élasticité. Sont également traités les différents aspects des algorithmes de calcul, y compris les questions de leur justification. La faveur qu’a trouvée cet ouvrage (Moscou. « Naouka », 1977) auprès des spécialistes soviétiques laisse aux auteurs tout lieu d’espérer qu’il sera profitable aux lecteurs francophones. En 1982, les Editions Mir font paraître la traduction anglaise de cet ouvrage. Pour la version française, des modifications ont été apportées à toute une série de paragraphes. Elle est en outre complétée par un nouveau paragraphe, § 39, où sont cités les résultats contenus dans des travaux récents portant essentiellement sur les algorithmes de calcul numérique des problèmes tridimensionnels. Les auteurs remercient les professeurs S. Mikhline et V. Mazia pour leurs remarques et suggestions qui ont permis de nombreuses améliorations de l’ouvrage Traduit du russe par Christianne Der-Megrcditchian Un grand merci à Henri Leveque pour le livre

docs.description: The present book is intended as a refresher course in chemistry for students preparing for their entrance examinations to higher educational institutions. The difficulties experienced by would-be college students when studying chemistry independently are due, first of all, to a lack of skill in applying their theoretical knowledge to generalisation of the material being studied or to problem-solving. My main objective in preparing this book was to set out the common theoretical concepts of general, inorganic, and organic chemistry in such a way as to provide the required level of knowledge for all the readers, taking into account their various levels of mastering the subject. The book consists of three parts. Part I treats the most important concepts, laws, and theoretical foundations of chemistry in accordance with the syllabus for secondary schools. Part II treats the chemistry of the elements, and Part III — the fundamentals of organic chemistry. Each chapter starts with its objectives and ends in a summary. The chapters of Part I contain examples of solving typical problems. The questions and problems at the end of each section will help the reader evaluate his knowledge and facilitate mastering of the material. Answers to selected problems will be found at the end of the book. A glossary is given in addition to the index. It will be useful for finding the most important definitions and concepts. The book will also be an excellent aid for secondary school pupils preparing for their graduation examinations. Translated from the Russian by G. docs.description: Chemical engineers and technologists (process engineers) must not only know the laws of physical chemistry but also be able to apply them judiciously to solve problems in their specific field of work. Solving problems helps to better assimilate theory and contributes to a deeper understanding of it. The authors have aimed to select problems covering virtually every aspect of the physical chemistry course, addressing different chemical specialties. To ensure that students learn how to use reference books, the authors have excluded values that can be found in readily available handbooks from most problems presented here. This book is divided into three parts: "Basic Theory of Physical-Chemistry Calculations", "Equilibrium State of Systems", and "Kinetics and Catalysis". Each chapter begins with the fundamental equations and symbols, followed by problems with solutions, problems to be solved independently, and multivariate problems. Answers to the problems in the second category are provided at the end of the book. The multivariate problems are designed to allow the teacher to assign individual tasks to each student in the group, recommended for unsupervised work. Multivariate problems can also be approached as single-variable ones, with the teacher selecting the most appropriate option from the 15 to 25 choices available, depending on the student's specialization. In preparing this edition, the authors considered the main changes in the physical chemistry course and the recent trends that have emerged in the field. They have also aligned with the general desire to reinforce the theoretical training of chemical and process engineers, a need recently expressed by representatives of higher education institutions. This has led the authors to include several new chapters. The sequence of chapters follows the rigorous logic of the course: the geometrical parameters and energetic properties of molecules are introduced first (Chapters 1–5), followed by an analysis of the properties of substances in the ideal gaseous state, and the next logical step is the real gaseous and condensed states of individual substances (Chapters 10–12). After covering the properties of individual substances, systems with multiple components in one or more phases are dealt with in Chapters 13–17. More complex systems involved in chemical reactions are considered in equilibrium (Chapters 19–21) and in dynamics (from Chapter 23 onwards). The newly introduced chapters reflect recent advances in physical chemistry. Given the general trend towards promoting independent work in the classroom, the emphasis has shifted accordingly. Theoretical introductions have been significantly reduced. In this respect, the authors aimed to offer something different from a mere textbook. Primary emphasis has been placed on problems with solutions, which serve as reference points for students who find it difficult to select the correct solution during independent work. This edition includes problems that require the use of calculators, marked by asterisks. At the end of some chapters, complex problems are presented. Their solution requires knowledge of several topics from the physical chemistry course and may be recommended for term assignments. Multivariate problems are divided into two major categories: (1) problems covering the entire chapter topic, requiring the use of plots and handbooks, and recommended for homework after the student has gone through the theoretical part and problems with solutions, and (2) problems dealing with a particular part of the chapter, solvable without calculations and plots, recommended for testing. Multivariate problems typically consist of 25 assignments. In cases where no experimental data is available, an assignment may be presented under two or three variant numbers. All values encountered throughout the book are in SI units, with a few exceptions where they are given in other commonly used units. This edition has been prepared with due regard to the remarks and critical comments received from readers. Translated from the Russian by V.G. Vopyan

docs.description: This book has been written on the basis of lectures which I delivered at the department of mathematics and mechanics of Moscow State Uni­ versity. In drawing up the program for my lectures, I proceeded on the belief that the selection of material must not be random nor must it rest exclusively on established tradition. The most important and interesting applications of ordinary differential equations to engineering are found in the theory of oscillations and in the theory of automatic control. These applications were chosen to serve as guides in the selection of material. Since oscillation theory and automatic control theory without doubt also play a very important role in the development of our contemporary tech­ nical culture, my approach to the selection of material for the lecture course is, if not the only possible one, in any case a reasonable one. In attempting to give the students not only a purely mathematical tool suitable for engineering applications, but also to demonstrate the appli­ cations themselves, I included certain engineering problems in the lectures. In the book they are presented in §13, 27, and 29. I consider that these problems constitute an integral organic part of the lecture course and, accordingly, of this book.

docs.description: This book provides a comprehensive introduction to the theory, design, and practical construction of power transformers used in electrical power systems. It begins with an overview of the historical development of transformer engineering and the contributions of scientists and engineers to the field. The early chapters explain the fundamental principles of transformer operation, including magnetic circuits, winding design, and the materials used in transformer construction. Detailed methods are presented for calculating key parameters such as core dimensions, winding turns, open-circuit characteristics, load behaviour, and efficiency, offering a clear framework for understanding how transformer performance is determined. The later chapters address specialised aspects of transformer engineering, including voltage regulation, thermal behaviour, insulation and lightning protection, and the mechanical stresses that arise during operation. The book also examines the design and construction of major transformer components such as magnetic cores, windings, tanks, and auxiliary devices. Practical topics such as testing, installation, maintenance, and economic considerations are discussed, along with examples of design calculations and course projects that demonstrate the application of engineering principles in real transformer design work. Together, these topics provide a systematic guide for students and engineers engaged in the study and design of electrical power transformers. Translated from the Russian by A. docs.creator: Yuri Trifonov
docs.description: The Impatient Ones  is a gripping historical novel that delves into the lives of the young Russian radicals who plotted the assassination of Tsar Alexander II in the late 19th century. With meticulous attention to historical detail and psychological depth, Trifonov reconstructs the inner conflicts, motivations, and moral dilemmas faced by members of the revolutionary group  Narodnaya Volya  (People's Will). The novel captures both the idealism and the tragic consequences of their actions, portraying how personal sacrifice and political urgency intertwined in a time of repression, revolution, and hope. It is both a portrait of a pivotal moment in Russian history and a meditation on the human cost of radical change. The gifted Soviet writer Yun Trifonov, a State Prize winner, is well known for two novels The Quenching of the Thirst and Students, a trilogy of novellas The Exchange, A Preliminary Summing Up and The Long Goodbye, and numerous short stories. He has long been interested in historical subjects. His Reflection from a Fire (1966) looked back at the revolutionary past and his most recent historical novel The Impatient Ones (1972) tells the story of the legendary Andrei Zhelyabov (1850-1881), one of the leaders of the People’s Will movement, and his comrades. “They displayed of the members of the People’s Will, “and ... astonished the world. Undoubtedly these sacrifices were not in vain: undoubtedly they promoted, directly or indirectly, the subsequent revolutionary education of the Russian people.” In a preface to the novel the well-known Soviet literary critic Alexander Svobodin describes the author’s life and work. docs.creator: Fyodor Dostoyevsky
docs.description: The story follows a disillusioned and suicidal man who, in his despair, has a vivid dream of visiting a utopian planet resembling an uncorrupted Earth. There, he encounters a society living in perfect harmony, free from greed, violence, or deceit. However, after he inadvertently introduces the concept of lying to these innocent beings, their civilization rapidly descends into the same moral decay and suffering that plague humanity. The dream serves as a powerful allegory for the loss of innocence and the destructive nature of human corruption. Upon waking, the protagonist undergoes a profound spiritual transformation, realizing that universal love and compassion are the only paths to redemption. Though he remains a "ridiculous man" in society's eyes, his dream convinces him that even a single individual’s actions can ignite hope and change. Dostoevsky’s tale blends existential despair with Christian idealism, ultimately arguing that humanity’s salvation lies in rejecting cynicism and embracing selfless love. docs.description: The work presented in this collection covers three main topics. The first concerns the solution of systems of linear algebraic equations that arise from the discretisation of mathematical physics problems by finite-difference and projection-difference methods. The second is associated with the mathematical modelling of general atmospheric and oceanic circulation, with particular attention to optimisation models for environmental protection. The third topic deals with the mathematical modelling of infectious diseases. Some papers focus on neutron transport equations, vector algorithms, and the randomisation of Monte Carlo methods. These works develop the fundamental theory of vector stochastic algorithms for solving integral equations and of “double randomisation” algorithms. The final paper discusses the technology of software application packages. docs.description: મારું દાઘેસ્તાન – રસૂલ ગમઝાતોવ મારું દાઘેસ્તાન  (અવર ભાષામાં  Дир Дагъистан ) એ અવર કવિ અને લેખક રસૂલ ગમઝાતોવનું એક પ્રસિદ્ધ કાર્ય છે, જે પ્રસંગો, કાવ્ય અને તત્વજ્ઞાનાત્મક વિચારોને ભેગા કરીને તેના જન્મભૂમિ ડાગેસ્ટાન સાથેનો ગાઢ સંબંધ દર્શાવે છે. આ પુસ્તક પ્રથમવાર 1968–1970 દરમિયાન અવર ભાષામાં પ્રકાશિત થયું હતું અને પછી રશિયન અને અંગ્રેજીમાં અનુવાદિત થયું, જે ડાગેસ્ટાની સાહિત્યની શ્રેષ્ઠ કૃતિઓમાં ગણાય છે. કથાવસ્તુ બે ભાગમાં વહેંચાયેલી છે: પ્રથમ ભાગમાં લેખકની સર્જનાત્મક પ્રક્રિયા, ભાષા, શૈલી અને લેખનનું મર્મ જોવા મળે છે. બીજા ભાગમાં વ્યક્તિગત વિચાર અને પરિવાર, ઓળખ અને ડાગેસ્ટાનની સમૃદ્ધ સાંસ્કૃતિક ધરોહર પર ધ્યાન કેન્દ્રિત કરવામાં આવ્યું છે. ગમઝાતોવની ભાષા કાવ્યમય પ્રોજ છે, જેમાં લોકકથા, કહેવતો અને ઉપખાનીઓનો સમાવેશ છે, જે કાર્યને આંતરદૃષ્ટિપ્રદ અને વારસાના ઉજવણીરૂપ બનાવે છે. વિશેષજ્ઞો  મારું દાઘેસ્તાન ને તેના અનોખા કથાકાર્ય અને ભાવનાત્મક ઊંડાણ માટે વખાણ્યા છે. સાહિત્યકાર ચિંગ્ઝૈイトમાતોવએ જણાવ્યું હતું કે આ પુસ્તક "મેં ક્યારેય વાંચ્યું તેવું અનોખું કાર્ય છે," જે તેના વૈશ્વિક સાહિત્યમાં ખાસ સ્થાન દર્શાવે છે. સારાંશરૂપે,  મારું દાઘેસ્તાન  માત્ર સાહિત્યકૃતિ નથી, પરંતુ ડાગેસ્ટાનની ભૂમિ, લોકો અને પરંપરાઓ માટે હૃદયથી કરેલી શ્રદ્ધાંજલિ છે, જે વાચકોને કવિની આત્મા સાથે જોડે છે. અનુવાદકો ગઘ--અતુલ સવાણી કાવ્યો-- બિરાદર અયાચી નારસિંહજી ચિત્રકાર--અલીના ગોલ્યાખોવ્સ્કાયા My Dagestan (Дир Дагъистан) is a seminal work by the Avar poet and writer Rasul Gamzatov, blending prose, poetry, and philosophical reflection to depict his deep connection to his homeland, Dagestan. First published in the Avar language between 1968 and 1970, the book was later translated into Russian and English, earning acclaim as a cornerstone of Dagestani literature.  The narrative unfolds in two parts: the first delves into the author's creative process, exploring themes of language, style, and the essence of writing. The second part shifts focus to personal reflections on family, identity, and the rich cultural tapestry of Dagestan. Gamzatov employs a lyrical prose style, incorporating elements of folklore, proverbs, and parables, creating a work that is both introspective and celebratory of his heritage.  Critics have lauded My Dagestan for its unique narrative structure and emotional depth. Chinghiz Aitmatov, a fellow writer, remarked that the book is "unlike anything I’ve ever read," highlighting its singular place in world literature.  In essence, My Dagestan is more than a literary work; it is a heartfelt tribute to the landscapes, people, and traditions of Dagestan, offering readers a window into the soul of a poet deeply rooted in his land.

docs.creator: Olga Forsh
docs.description: I began writing Pioneers of Freedom in 1950, and the book was published in 1953, the year of my eightieth birthday. The Decembrist Revolt, the first organised struggle of Russian revolutionary nobles against autocracy, had long interested me. My study of historical records strengthened my resolve to write a popular book for young people about this courageous group who, despite their distance from the people, sacrificed their lives for the people's interests. I believe this period, crucial for understanding the history of the Russian revolutionary movement, will continue to inspire writers. A few words about my life and work: I was born in 1873 in Gunib, in the Caucasus, where my father, General D.V. Komarov, was Military Governor. My Armenian mother died at my birth, and I grew up among military men. After studying in various places, including drawing schools in Odessa and Kiev, I trained under painter P.P. Chistyakov. My first short story was published in 1908, and I continued writing while working as a drawing teacher in Tsarskoye Selo. After the Great October Socialist Revolution, I turned to historical novels, drawing on my experiences of life across two centuries and social systems. My works, such as Stone-Clad (1924), a trilogy on Radishchev, and Mikhailovsky Fortress, reflect my efforts to combine historical fidelity with revolutionary ideals, as well as the unity of art and life. I am currently planning a memoir on Maxim Gorky, whose example of tireless work and engagement with readers remains a source of inspiration. Like Gorky, I find readers' letters and interest in my work a constant stimulus for creative effort. — Olga Forsh Note the decade is approximate

The Sun's structure, the nuclear reactions proceeding within its core, and the stability of its nuclear fi res take up an entire chapter. This book will help answer many of the questions o ft en asked, such as where does the wind come from, what are clouds made of, what are ocean currents, and what a ff ects Earth's climate .

docs.description: મેક્સિમ ગોર્કીની 'મા' કથા એક અગ્નિષામક કાર્યક્રમ છે જે રશિયન સમાજ અને કામગારી આંદોલનના વિચારધારાને સ્પષ્ટ પ્રકટ કરે છે. આ કાવ્ય સામગ્રી દ્વારા લોકોની સમસ્યાઓ, સાંપ્રદાયિકતા, અને સર્વોચ્ચ શક્તિની વિરોધાત્મક લડાઈ વિશે ચર્ચા કરે છે. કથાની મુખ્ય પાત્રિકા પેલેવ એક માતા છે જે તેમના સોધાકોને આગળ વધવા માટે લડે છે. મુખ્ય વિષયોમાં સેવા, પ્રેમ, અને આત્માહત્યારીની બહાર હોવાની જીવનની સાથે માટે માતાની સંગતિનો વિશેષ પરિચય આપવામાં આવે છે. ગોર્કી આ કથામાં માતાનો સાથે તેની પ્રીતિ અને આદર અત્યંત સ્પષ્ટ કરે છે. માતા અને તેના સંગતિના વિચારો રાષ્ટ્રીય પ્રમુખતાની સમાજવાદી આંદોલનમાં એક મહત્વની ભૂમિકા નિભાવવા માટે એક સાધન તરીકે પ્રયોગ કરે છે. આ કથા એક નાની કુટુંબની સાથે મહિલાઓ અને કામગારોને સંબોધિત કરે છે જે સમય અને સ્થળને જીવનના પ્રમુખ વિષયો રીતે અનુભવી રહ્યા છે. અનુવાદ–અતુલ સવાણી ગુપ્તાજીને તમામ ક્રેડિટ

docs.description: મેક્સિમ ગોર્કીની My Apprenticeship (મારી તાલીમ) તેમની આત્મકથાત્મક ત્રિલોજીનો બીજો ભાગ છે. તેમાં My Childhood પછીના તેમના યુવાન સમયના સંઘર્ષો અને અનુભવોનું વર્ણન છે. એલેક્સી પેશ્કોવ તરીકે ઓળખાતો યુવાન જીવનનિર્વાહ માટે બેકરી, રેલવે, રસોડું અને અન્ય અનેક સ્થળોએ કામ કરે છે. આ દરમિયાન તે સમાજના વિવિધ વર્ગોના લોકોને મળે છે અને ગરીબી, શોષણ, અન્યાય અને અજ્ઞાનને નજીકથી જુએ છે. સાથે સાથે તેને દયા, મિત્રતા, માનવ ગૌરવ અને જ્ઞાનની શોધ જેવા માનવીય ગુણોનો પણ અનુભવ થાય છે. આ પુસ્તકમાં ઔપચારિક શિક્ષણ કરતાં જીવનમાંથી મળતા શિક્ષણ પર વધુ ભાર છે. ગોર્કી પુસ્તકો વાંચીને, લોકો સાથે વાતચીત કરીને, તેમના જીવનનું નિરીક્ષણ કરીને અને પોતાના અનુભવો પર વિચાર કરીને શીખે છે. જીવનમાં મળેલા લોકો તેના શિક્ષક બને છે અને મુશ્કેલીઓ તેની યુનિવર્સિટી. આ અનુભવો તેના સામાજિક અન્યાય અંગેના વિચારોને ઘડે છે અને વધુ ન્યાયી સમાજની તેની ઇચ્છાને મજબૂત બનાવે છે. અનુવાદ -- અતુલ સવાણી સજાવટ --અનાતોલી મોઈઇસેયેવ

docs.creator: મેક્સિમ ગોર્કી (Maxim Gorky)
docs.description: My Universities  by Maxim Gorky is the third part of his autobiographical trilogy, following  My Childhood  and  My Apprenticeship . It recounts Gorky’s youthful years as he ventures into the wider world to seek education and meaning in life. Despite not attending formal universities, Gorky learns from life’s harsh realities, the people he encounters, and his love for reading. The book reflects his intellectual awakening and the shaping of his revolutionary ideals. મારા વિશ્વવિદ્યાલયો. એ મેક્સિમ ગોર્કીની આત્મકથાત્મક ત્રિલોજીની ત્રીજી ભાગ છે, જે  માય ચાઈલ્ડહુડ  અને  માય એપ્રેન્ટિસશિપ ના અનુસંધાનમાં છે. આમાં ગોર્કીના યુવાન સમયમાં તેઓ શિક્ષણ અને જીવનનો અર્થ શોધવા માટે વિશાળ દુનિયામાં જતા રહે છે. તાત્કાલિક યુનિવર્સિટીમાં ન જતાં છતાં, ગોર્કી જીવનની કઠોર વાસ્તવિકતાઓ, મળેલા લોકો અને વાંચન પ્રત્યેના પ્રેમથી શીખે છે. આ પુસ્તક તેમનું બૌદ્ધિક જાગરણ અને ક્રાંતિસંબંધિત વિચારધારા બનાવવા માટેના અનુભવોને પ્રકાશિત કરે છે. અનુવાદ – અતુલ સવાણી સજાવટ - આનાતોલી મોઈસેયેવ

docs.description: This book is the result of revising and expanding lecture notes from a course on equations of mathematical physics, taught by the author for several years at the Department of Mathematics and Mechanics, Kiev State University. Mathematical physics deals with problems that arise from the study of physical phenomena such as fluid dynamics, electrodynamics, elasticity, heat flow, quantum mechanics, and atomic physics. These phenomena lead to mathematical questions—especially involving partial differential equations—that form the core of this discipline. Instead of following the traditional approach, which introduces hyperbolic equations and separation of variables early on, this book begins with a detailed examination of elliptic equations and the associated mathematical tools. Subsequent chapters explore the physical processes leading to the fundamental equations of mathematical physics and address general issues in the theory of partial differential equations. The methods of separation of variables and integral transformations are applied uniformly to hyperbolic, parabolic, and elliptic equations. Emphasis is placed on providing closed-form solutions wherever possible. Due to constraints on length, not all topics could be addressed in full detail; references are provided for further study. Translated by Scripta Technica, Inc.  Contents Preface 1. docs.description: Sous la direction de P. Poloukhine L’étude de la « Technologie des métaux » est nécessaire à l’assimilation de plusieurs cours spéciaux destinés à la formation de l’ingénieur. Un ingénieur doit connaître les procédés de production des métaux ferreux et non ferreux ou de leurs alliages, leurs propriétés et les procédés de leur usinage pour être en mesure de choisir et d’utiliser judicieusement les matériaux métalliques. Quelle que soit sa spécialité, il doit connaître les modifications que subissent les propriétés des métaux sous l’action du traitement thermique et d’autres facteurs et comment il faut procéder pour modifier ces propriétés dans le sens voulu. Le livre comporte sept parties : « Fabrication des métaux ferreux, de l’aluminium, du cuivre et du titane », « Propriétés fondamentales des métaux et des alliages», « Principes du traitement thermique des métaux et des alliages», « Principes de la fonderie », « Travail des métaux par déformation », « Soudage, oxycoupage et brasage des métaux », « Usinage des métaux ». Traduit du russe par Valentin Polonski Un grand merci à Henri Leveque pour le scan original.

docs.description: Il traite des méthodes de base de la mécanique théorique et de leurs sphères de  demande. Il examine également brièvement le mouvement dans un champ gravitationnel (satellites artificiels et trajectoires elliptiques), le mouvement des corps à masse variable (par ex.. fusées), la théorie élémentaire du mouvement gyroscopique et d'autres sujets. Ces questions sont d'une telle importance aujourd'hui qu'aucun cours de mécanique, même court. peut les négliger complètement.  L'organisation de ce livre est basée sur la conviction profonde, confirmée par de nombreuses années d'expérience, que la meilleure façon de présenter le matériel d'étude, surtout lorsqu'il est contenu dans un cours de courte durée, est de passer du particulier au général. En conséquence, dans ce livre, la statique plane précède la statique tridimensionnelle, la dynamique des particules avant la dynamique des systèmes, le mouvement rectiligne avant le mouvement curviligne, etc. Un tel arrangement aide l'étudiant à comprendre et à digérer le matériel plus rapidement et plus rapidement, et le processus d'enseignement lui-même est rendu plus graphique et cohérent.  À côté des inelliodes géométriques et analytiques de la mécanique, le livre fait un large usage de la méthode vectorielle comme l'une des principales méthodes généralement acceptées qui, de plus, possède un certain nombre d'avantages incontestables. En règle générale, cependant. seules les opérations vectorielles tlio-e sont utilisées, qui sont similaires aux opérations correspondantes avec des quantités scalaires et qui ne nécessitent pas de connaissance supplémentaire de nombreux nouveaux concepts.  Un espace considérable-plus d'un tiers du volume total du livre - est consacré aux exemples et aux problèmes travaillés. Ils ont été choisis avec un œil pour assurer une compréhension claire des phénomènes mécaniques pertinents, et ils englobent tous les principaux types de problèmes et méthodes de résolution des problèmes.  Les solutions aux problèmes contiennent des instructions conçues pour aider l'étudiant dans son  indépendant-travail sur le parcours. À cet égard, le livre devrait s'avérer utile  aux étudiants de nombreux domaines intéressés à approfondir leurs connaissances de la  sujet.  Traduit du russe Un grand merci à Henri Leveque pour le scan original.

docs.description: L’expérience acquise en U.R.S.S. au cours de ces dernières années dans la construction en éléments préfabriqués et précontraints, l’introduction de nouveaux procédés de fabrication de ces éléments en usine et le grand nombre d’études très poussées dans le domaine du béton armé et du béton précontraint ont rendu nécessaire une révision du Cours des constructions en béton armé. Le présent ouvrage, composé de deux parties, a été rédigé conformément aux exigences des programmes des établissements d’enseignement supérieur préparant les ingénieurs de l’industrie du bâtiment. La première partie du manuel est consacrée à l ’étude des propriétés des matériaux et de la résistance du béton armé ainsi qu’au calcul des éléments en béton armé et en béton précontraint ; la deuxième partie contient une description détaillée des structures en béton armé les plus utilisées dans la construction des immeubles d’habitation, des bâtiments culturels et industriels. Les Règlements de calcul du béton armé actuellement en vigueur en U.R.S.S. et les nouveaux standards pour les éléments préfabriqués sont largement reflétés dans ce manuel. Des chapitres entiers sont consacrés à la description des bases expérimentales de la théorie de la résistance du béton armé ou précontraint ainsi qu’aux principes généraux de l’étude des ouvrages en ces matériaux, comptetenu des exigences relatives à l’industrialisation des procédés do fabrication et à l’économie des matériaux. Certaines questions, telles les questions des joints d’éléments préfabriqués, font l’objet d’autres chapitres. Le chapitre 2 de la première partie contient toutes les données expérimentales essentielles relatives au béton armé et toutes les théories fondamentales utilisées pour l’évaluation ^e la résistance des éléments à divers types de sollicitation. Quant au calcul et à la vérification des sections, ceux-ci font l ’objet des chapitres suivants dont chacun contient d ’abord une description des particularités constructives des éléments et ensuite un exposé des méthodes de calcul à utiliser. Cette méthode unifiée a permis un exposé concis* où toute répétition inutile a été évitée. Les divers problèmes relatifs aux méthodes modernes de la construction des bâtiments à ossature ou en panneaux préfabriqués et aux moyens permettant d’assurer leur rigidité spatiale sont traités dans la deuxième partie. Tout comme dans la première partie, chaque chapitre contient d’abord une description de la structure envisagée et ensuite un exposé des méthodes de calcul. Traduit du russe par B. Latchinov et F. Siniavère Un grand merci à Henri Leveque pour le scan original.

docs.description: “The Knight in the Tiger Skin” is the crowning achievement of the twelfth-century Georgian poet Shota Rustaveli and stands as Georgia’s national epic. Composed around 1200 AD at the height of the medieval Georgian Golden Age, this richly woven verse narrative celebrates chivalry, friendship, and the transcendent power of love. Through the adventures of the noble knight Avtandil and the mysterious Princess Nestan-Darejan, Rustaveli explores themes of loyalty, honour, and moral integrity against a backdrop of courtly splendour and fantastical quests. Celebrated for its lyrical beauty, philosophical depth, and intricate structure, “The Knight in the Tiger Skin” continues to inspire readers worldwide as a masterwork of medieval literature. docs.description: There are different ways of loving nature. One might love nature because it is generally accepted to love it and to say, “Look how beautiful,” while actually feeling nothing: neither the beauty of the woods nor the charm of a bird’s song. This kind of love does not count. One may love nature with the sincere love of an artist, in­ quisitively, attempting to unravel her mysteries. And finally, one may love nature with the demanding love of a master who sees its beauty, strives to know it, and at the same time learns to manage it, transform and multiply its riches. Such is how the author of this book, Professor Pyotr Manteufel (1883-1960), loved nature. I was fortunate enough to spend some time with him in the woods as a young girl. I remember at the time it seemed to me that he had not the ordinary five human senses, but many more. When the enormous, broad-shouldered man strolled through the woods, his eyes, keen as a wise bird’s, saw somehow better than those of his young pupils. He heard every crackle and rustle, he absorbed his surroundings into himself. He moved in long, noiseless strides, whistling to the birds, and they would answer him. But the most interesting came later—he would explain every detail and every phenomenon to us, would draw conclusions and arrive at broad generalisations. Contemplation—observation—experimentation. Such was the slogan of this scholar. And this path of research extends through all the stories collected under the title Tales of a Naturalist. These are not mere “sportsman’s sketches”. These are the tales of a great scholar who does not simply write entertaining stories about animals, but actually brings the reader to certain conclusions. This book contains but a portion of his tales, for they are many indeed. 5  For all seventy-seven years of the scholar’s life (with the excep­tion of those during the First World War and his service in the Red Army in 1921-22) were devoted to his beloved science. Manteufel traveled extensively throughout the country, from northern Yakutia to southern Uzbekistan, from Siberia to Kazakhstan. But one can hardly begin to name all the places he visited. Manteufel’s work in science began early in life. He was the pupil of such outstanding Soviet scholars as Williams and Menzbir. Manteufel conducted an abundance of studies, many of which received wide recognition: the breeding of sables in captivity, the study of hare and marten communities, daring experiments in the acclimatization of valuable furbearing animals, to name but a few. In these studies Manteufel used the zoo, where he headed the science department for fourteen years, expeditions, and, finally, the Soviet Union’s numerous wildlife reserves. In his work Manteufel always observed the animal in relation to its environment, he studied the flora, fauna, and soil, for only under these conditions is it possible to know the biology of a given animal. Pyotr Manteufel must also be recognized as an educator and a counselor to young people. He taught at many institutions of learning, and a number of his pupils—now scholars themselves— embarked on their path toward science in childhood in the Moscow Zoo’s club for junior biologists, founded by Manteufel. He gave this country more than one thousand gamekeepers and fur-farmers during his teaching years at the institute of fur-breed­ ing, where he headed the department of systematization and bio­ technology—a young and fascinating science. Manteufel taught young people not only biology and his scientific methods; he taught them love for their homeland, perseverance, accuracy in observa­tion, a sense of friendship and comradery, courage and stamina. Such was the man who wrote this book—a great scholar and a man with a great heart. -- Yelizaveta Uspenskaya Translated by Linda Noble  Designed by Georgi Nikolsky

docs.description: L’étudefde l'électricité comporte trois groupes de questions. Le premier concerne les notions fondamentales et les principes généraux qui sont à la base des phénomènes électriques et magnétiques; le deuxième concerne les propriétés électriques et magnétiques des substances, et enfin les questions du troisième groupe embrassent les applications de l’électricité. Dans ce cours ce sont surtout les questions du premier groupe qui seront traitées avec toute l’ampleur nécessaire. Nous adoptons pour cela la méthode d’induction ; les notions et les principes de base sont établis par généralisation des données expérimentales qui ne présentent elles-mêmes qu’un domaine de validité limité. Une succession continue de généralisations nous conduira petit à petit aux équations de Maxwell que nous utiliserons largement dans la deuxième partie de ce volume. Il est bien naturel que dans un cours de Physique générale on ne saurait traiter avec une ampleur égale les propriétés électriques et magnétiques des substances. D’ailleurs une étude approfondie de ces propriétés doit se fonder sur la mécanique quantique et par conséquent faire l’objet de cours spéciaux. Néanmoins nous nous sommes efforcés de traiter ces questions aussi largement qu’on peut le faire dans un cours destiné aux étudiants des premières années d’étude. Nous faisons largement appel à la thermodynamique, sans laquelle on ne peut donner un exposé clair et complet ni des questions particulières, ni des concepts généraux de l’électrodynamique macroscopique. 6 AVANT-PROPOS Nous avons accordé aux applications de l’électricité beaucoup moins d’attention que ne le méritent ces questions. Quelques questions seulement ont été retenues et encore ne les traitons-nous que du point de vue des principes de calcul. Nous avons adopté dans notre cours le système gaussien d’unités de mesure. Nous avons évoqué dans la préface au tome I les raisons qui nous ont incité à rejeter le Système International. Nous revenons encore une fois sur cette question au § 85 de ce tome. Nous ne pouvons cependant oublier qu’à l’école secondaire et dans les écoles d’ingénieurs l’enseignement de la physique se fonde sur le système SI. Ce même système est de plus en plus largement utilisé dans les publications périodiques, notamment celles traitant des applications techniques. Aussi avons-nous jugé utile d’exposer au § 85 les principes d’établissement de ce système d’unités pour l’électrodynamique ainsi que ses rapports avec le système gaussien. Un tableau, fondé sur une règle générale, aidera à transformer les formules écrites dans un système d’unités en formules fondées sur l’autre système. En outre nous donnons en appendice la liste des principales formules de l’électrodynamique écrites dans le système SI. Le lecteur retrouvera dans cet appendice sous le même numéro les formules figurant dans le cours en système gaussien. Au cas où une formule manquerait, la reconversion s’effectue aisément à l’aide du tableau 1 dont il a été question ci-dessus. Enfin, dans le tableau 2, sont consignées les formules de conversion des unités SI en unités gaussiennes. Tout comme les deux premiers, ce troisième tome est fondé sur les cours que nous avons faits depuis 1957 aux étudiants de deuxième année de l’Institut de Physique technique de Moscou. Aussi tout ce qui a été dit dans les préfaces aux premiers tomes sur les objectifs et la méthode d’enseignement de la physique s’applique à ce troisième tome. Nombre de problèmes donnés dans ce tome avaient figurés aux examens écrits et dans les compositions. Les énoncés de ces problèmes ont été élaborés par les collaborateurs de la chaire de Physique générale. Les expériences de démonstration qui accompagnaient les cours ont été utiles non seulement aux étudiants, mais à nous-mêmes. Nous voulons remercier ici les assistants qui les ont élaborées et réalisées. Traduit du russe par Sergueï Medvédev Un grand merci à Henri Leveque pour le scan original.

docs.description: The monograph is concerned with a systematic presentation of the mechanics (statics) of elastic solids with different elastic properties for different directions, i.e., anisotropic bodies. The book contains the general equations of the theory of elastic equilibrium for bodies with elastic anisotropy of different types, both homogeneous and non-homogeneous. It gives a mathematical formulation of the general problems of equilibrium for elastic anisotropic bodies and some of the most important problems: the extensional, torsional, flexural problems, the plane problem, the axially symmetric problem, and their generalizations. The book give solutions to a large number of problems relating to various topics, obtained by both the author and other researchers. As a rule, all problems are worked down to explicit formulas, and in a number of cases to tables and graphs. The book is intended for scientific workers and engineers in the fields of mechanics, mecha-nical engineering, shipbuilding, aircraft construction, and other fields of engineering. ABOUT THE AUTHOR Professor Sergei Gheorgievich Lekhnitskii is a Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences and a State Prize Winner. A leading scientist in the field of the theory of elasticity and particularly the elasticity of anisotropic bodies, Professor Lekhnitskii graduated from the Physics and Mathematics Faculty of Leningrad State University in 1931, specializing in ‘Mechanics’ tie completed a candidates degree in the same faculty in 1934, his subject being the theory of elasticity. Professor Lekhnitskii has published,sometimes in a number of editions, several books, including Stability of Anisotropic Plates, Anti-sotropic Plates, Theory of Elasticity of Anisotropic Bodies, and Torsion of Anisotropic and Non-homogeneous Bars. He also has more than 60 articles to his credit, appearing in the journals of the Soviet Academy of Sciences, the proceedings of various congresses and conferences, and collections issued by Leningrad and Saratov Universities. A number of his works have been translated into foreign languages.

বিচ্যুত করেছিলেন। দীর্ঘ সময় পরে তিনি জুরির সদস্য হিসেবে আদালতে উপস্থিত হয়ে দেখেন যে অভিযোগের আসামি হিসেবে দাঁড়িয়ে থাকা নারীটি সেই একই ক্যাতিউশা। নিজের অতীত অন্যায়ের মুখোমুখি হয়ে তিনি গভীরভাবে বিচলিত হন এবং উপলব্ধি করেন যে তার অসতর্ক কর্মই ক্যাতিউশার পতনের সূচনা করেছিল। এই উপলব্ধি নেখলিউদভকে আত্মগ্লানিতে ভোগায় এবং পরিবর্তনের পথে পরিচালিত করে। পরবর্তী অংশে নেখলিউদভ ক্যাতিউশার প্রতি দায়বোধ থেকে তাকে সাহায্য করার সিদ্ধান্ত নেন। তিনি আইনগত চেষ্টা চালান, সরকার ও কর্তৃপক্ষের কাছে আবেদন করেন এবং অবশেষে সাইবেরিয়ায় তার নির্বাসনযাত্রায় সঙ্গী হন। এই যাত্রা নেখলিউদভের আত্মিক পুনর্জন্মের পথও বটে, যেখানে তিনি মানবতা, ন্যায় ও করুণার প্রকৃত অর্থ উপলব্ধি করেন। ক্যাতিউশাও ধীরে ধীরে নিজের শক্তি ও মর্যাদা পুনরুদ্ধার করে। উপন্যাসটি ব্যক্তি-অপরাধ, সামাজিক অবিচার ও নৈতিক জাগরণের এক শক্তিশালী চিত্র তুলে ধরে। তলগুয়ের এই উপন্যাস প্রথম যিনি চিত্রিত করেন এবং বর্তমান সংস্করণ যাঁর অঙ্কিত চিত্রসংবলিত হয়ে প্রকাশ পাচ্ছে সেই চিত্রশিল্পী লেওনিদ পাস্তেরনাক তাঁর স্মৃতিচারণ প্রসঙ্গে বলেন: 'আমি ঠিক করলাম সর্বপ্রথম উপন্যাসের নায়ক-নায়িকার স্কেচ করব, তাই রচনার বৈষম্যমূলক দৃশ্য হিশেবে বেছে নিলাম 'কাতিউশার প্রভাত' ও 'নেলিউদভের প্রভাত'। স্কেচদুটি লেভ নিকলায়েভিচকে দেখাৰ বলে ঠিক করার আগে কী পরিমাণ উদ্বেগের মধ্যেই না আমাকে কাটাতে হয়েছে। যাক, এখন ঐ ভয়ঙ্কর মুহূর্তটিও পেছনে ফেলে এসেছি। এখন তাঁর প্রশংসাবাণী আমার কর্ণকুহরে সুধাবর্ষণ করছে, আমি অভিভূত হয়ে পড়ছি পিতার এবং সেই সঙ্গে কন্যা তাতিয়ানা লুভোজনার কথা শুনে যখন তাঁরা উল্লসিত হয়ে বলছেন যে লেড নিকলায়েভিচ যাদের চিত্র এ'কেছেন, অর্থাৎ যাদের আমি কস্মিনকালে চোখে দেখি নি, যাদের কথা কিছুই জানি না, আমি নাকি তাদের প্রায় অবিকল প্রতিকৃতি রূপায়ণে সক্ষম হয়েছি।' বাইরের মলাটে: লেভ তলস্তয়ের প্রতিকৃতি শিল্পী ইলিয়া রেপিন (১৮৮৭, ইয়ায়ায়া পলিয়ানা) অনুবাদ: ক্ষিতীশ রায় সম্পাদনা: অরুণ সোম চিত্রাঙ্কন: লেওনিদ পাস্তেরনাক প্রথম সংস্করণ All credits to docs.description: This book is based upon lectures given by Professor Tsytovich at Culham Laboratory.  The preceding text can only represent the present state of the development of the theory of plasma turbulence. The author has tried to follow the logic, but not the history of this field and, therefore, the references are very fragmented and not by any means complete. The essential physical statements that the author wants to emphasise finally are: The plasma properties in the turbulent region are mostly non-linear. This raises the possibility of universal plasma properties like a universal spectrum that can be independent of the type of instability. Nevertheless, the turbulence is often weak: W/nT < < 1, and when describing the properties of the turbulent oscillation interactions it is not possible to expand the non-linear interactions in terms of the turbulent energy. The elementary excitations such as plasmons and “dressed” particles have thus a finite lifetime which is connected with their non­ linear interactions. The small low-frequency perturbations in a turbulent plasma have quite a different nature because of the frequent turbulent collisions, and the dielectric constant that describes such perturbations cannot be expanded in terms of the turbulent energy. The development of a turbulent state is very probable for a plasma as a result of the fact that the energy applied has a tendency to disperse to the greatest possible degree of freedom. Innumerable numbers of different plasma instabilities can bring the plasma to a turbulent state. The plasmas in astrophysical conditions must, therefore, often be turbulent. This can lead to a way of explaining cosmic-ray origins with a universal power-type spectrum. The development of plasma turbulence can occur as a result of development, firstly, of one or a small number of collective modes, with a subsequent spread of the energy to other modes by non-linear inter­ actions as well as by the excitation of many modes at the first stage. For the case of the excitation of one mode, the first stage is not turbulent and the turbulence develops as the energy is spread, if the system is ergodic. The plasma collective motions seem to be the best test for an investigation of the general problems of the development of the random­ isation process, as well as of the general problems of the possibility of a statistical description of a system. Contents  1. Comparison of plasma and liquid turbulence 2.  General Problems of the Theory of Plasma Turbulence   3. The Balance Equation for a Turbulent Plasma 4. Turbulent Collisions and Resonance Broadening 5.  The Spectrum and Correlation Functions of Ion-sound Turbulence 6. The Spectrum and Correlation Functions of Langmuir Turbulence 7. Electromagnetic Properties of a Turbulent Plasma 8.  The Cosmic-ray Spectrum

docs.description: This text sets forth methods of designing and analyzing metal engineering structures (of steel and aluminium). The first two chapters are devoted to the fundamentals of designing and the theory of analyzing metal structures and structural members with account of the material working not only in the elastic, but also in the elastoplastic stage. Chapters 3-5 describe various structural shapes and methods of joining together structural elements, the actual behaviour of the joints and their investigation, as well as certain industrial requirements which the design of structures must meet. In Chapters 6-8 the reader will find a detailed consideration of the principal elements of metal structures such as beams, girders, trusses, and columns, as well as information on crane girders and eccentrically loaded columns. The design of metal structures consisting of separate structural elements is the subject matterof Chapters 9 and 10. The exposition of this material is based on examples of industrial buildings and some special large-span and high structures. The last chapter sets forth the fundamentals of designing continuous sheet-metal structures (steel shells). All the material contained in the book conforms to the standards for designing steel structures and structures of aluminium alloys, as well as to the general building standards and regulations followed in the USSR.

docs.description: El presente libro refleja los capítulos fundamentales de la química coloidal moderna, una extensa rama independiente de la ciencia química que estudia el estado disperso de la sustancia y los fenómenos superficiales en los sistemas dispersos. El libro representa una sinopsis de la experiencia acumulada en muchos años de trabajo científico, pedagógico y metodológico de la colectividad de la cátedra de química coloidal de la Facultad de Química de la Universidad Estatal Lomonósov de Moscú. el problema de elección del material y de la lógica de exposición de la disciplina, tuvieron en cuenta la conexión con las prácticas, 7 así como los vínculos existentes entre las materias tratadas, y optaron por el orden de disposición ofrecido de los capítulos. Por lo visto, ningún esquema «lineal» de exposición de un sector interdisciplinario tan ramificado de la ciencia como lo es la química coloidal puede considerarse perfecto. Esta es la razón de que en el libro se hacen numerosas referencias tanto a los capítulos anteriores, como a los posteriores; con ello se hace resaltar el nexo intrínseco entre los apartados. El material del que se puede prescindir durante la primera lectura está impreso en gallarda. El presente libro refleja en cierta medida la especificidad del trabajo de la cátedra de química coloidal en la facultad de química de la Universidad Estatal de Moscú. Este enfoque se manifiesta, por una parte, en la particular atención que prestan los autores a los apartados que corresponden al ámbito de los intereses científicos de la cátedra, y, por otra parte, en el afán de evitar, en la medida de lo posible la duplicación del material comprendido en aquellos apartados contiguos que entran en los cursos de la química física, electroquímica y química de los compuestos macromoleculares. Esto se refiere, en particular, a los problemas como la adsorción por la superficie sólida (por adsorbentes microporosos) a partir de la fase gaseosa; la estructura de la parte densa de la doble capa eléctrica y fenómenos electrocapilares; comportamiento específico de las dispersiones de compuestos macromoleculares y algunos otros. En los casos mencionados, la cuestión se aborda sólo en aquel grado en que el material es químico-coloidal en esencia y resulta absolutamente indispensable por lógica de estructuración del curso. Los interesados podrán hallar los pormenores en los manuales y libros de texto que se mencionan. Los autores opinan que la existencia de una serie de manuales que reflejan la fisonomía científica y la experiencia pedagógica de las escuelas químico-coloidales debe contribuir a un estudio profundo, multifacético y no preconcebido de este importante e interesante campo de la ciencia química. El curso ofrecido está destinado, en primer término, a los estudiantes de las facultades de química de las universidades. También puede servir de libro de texto para los estudiantes de otras facultades de las universidades, como asimismo de otras instituciones de enseñanza superior, preferentemente aquellas en que la química coloidal se estudia como disciplina independiente. Además, el libro puede utilizarse por el amplio círculo de colaboradores científicos y postgraduados, así como por los ingenieros y tecnólogos ocupados en distintos campos de la ciencia y de la producción relacionados con la aplicación de sistemas dispersos y de fenómenos superficiales. docs.description: Prof. Myškis' Lectures on Higher Mathematics  is a textbook designed to cover key mathematical concepts for engineering students and technical colleges. It emphasises fundamental ideas and their practical applications in specialised fields, presented in an intuitive and accessible manner without unnecessary pedantry. The book focuses on building understanding through intuitive explanations of mathematical concepts and making their applications straightforward. It is intended for engineering students but is also suitable for home study and self-improvement. The author, Prof. Anatoly Myškis, D.Sc., is well known not only for his original research but also for his equally original approach to the teaching of higher mathematics. He is one of the founders of the theory of differential equations with retarded argument. His publications include Linear Differential Equations with Retarded Argument, Elements of Applied Mathematics (co-author), and Special Courses in Mathematics for Technical Colleges. Translated from the Russian by V. M. Volosov, D. Sc.

docs.description: সোভিয়েত ছোটে। গল্প সিরিজ তাঁর ছোটো জীবনের মধ্যে লিথুয়ানিয়ার লেখক প. ভিকা (১৯০৯-১৯৪৭) সাহিত্যিক ও সা-মাজিক গুরুত্বপূর্ণ বই লিখেছিলেন। তিনি লিখেছিলেন তিনটি উপন্যাস। 'ফ্রাঙ্ক ক্রুক' (১৯৩৪) নামে উপন্যাসটি হলো লিথুয়ানিয়ার কৃষক উদ্বাস্তুদের জীবনযাত্রা সম্বন্ধে; 'মাতা বসুমতী' (১৯৩৫)-যে কুখ্যাত 'কৃষি সংশোধন' চাষীদের প্রতারণা করেছিলো সেটি চালু হবার পর লিথুয়ানিয়ার গ্রামের কথা; 'মিস্ত্রি ও তার ছেলেরা' - ১৯০৫-এর বৈপ্লবিক ঘটনার বিষয়। তাঁর অসংখ্য গল্পগুলি বিভিন্ন বছরে প্রকাশিত হয়েছিলে।। ভিকা গভীরভাবে ভালোবাসতেন তাঁর স্বপ্নময় সবুজ দেশকে। তাঁর সহজ গল্পগুলোয় তিনি লিথুয়ানিয়ার চাষীদের শত্রু এবং বন্ধুদের দেখিয়েছিলেন। সাহসের সঙ্গে লিথুয়ানিয়ার লেখক পেত্রাস ডির্কা'র গল্পের এই ছোট্টো বইয়ের দু'খণ্ডে লিথুয়ানিয়ার জনগণের জীবনের দু'টি অবস্থা প্রতিবিম্বিত হয়েছে: প্রথম খণ্ড হলো 'ভ্রাতৃত্বের বীজ', তাতে বর্ণিত হয়েছে সোভিয়েত লিথুয়ানিয়ার বাস্তব অবস্থার কথা। এর মধ্যে রয়েছে ফাসিস্ট অধিকারের দুর্বৎসরগুলি। দ্বিতীয় খণ্ড হলে। 'অতীতের একটি পৃষ্ঠা'। তাতে রয়েছে প্রতিক্রিয়াশীল বুর্জোয়া লিথুয়ানিয়ার জীবনযাত্রার কথা। অনুবাদ: রেখা চট্টোপাধ্যায় চিত্রাঙ্কন, প্রচ্ছদপট ও মুদ্রণ পরিকল্পনা: গ. জাভিয়ালভা  All credits to sovietbooksinbengali blog.

docs.description: "Open Book" by Veniamin Kaverin is a classic Soviet novel that tells the story of a young woman named Tatyana, who aspires to become a doctor. Set against the backdrop of the tumultuous years of the early Soviet Union, the novel explores themes of personal ambition, dedication, and the pursuit of knowledge. Tatyana faces numerous challenges, including societal expectations and personal hardships, but her unwavering determination and commitment to her goals drive her forward. Through her journey, Kaverin highlights the importance of education, perseverance, and the transformative power of intellectual and personal growth. docs.description: Ce livre a été conçu en s’appuyant sur les cours et les travaux pratiques de cristallographie et de physique cristalline conduits par les auteurs à l ’Institut de l’acier et des alliages de Moscou, ainsi qu’à la faculté de physique de l’Université d'Etat de Moscou. Les auteurs ont oeuvré au livre pendant les années 1966-1979, qui a paru en U.R.S.S. sous deux éditions en 1975 et 1979. Les auteurs ont composé ensemble le plan du livre, discuté le contenu de chacune des divisions et il est, par suite, bien difficile de concrétiser l’apport de chacun. Néanmoins, pour départager la contribution, indiquons que les chapitres I, III et IV sont dus principalement à M. P. Chaskolskaïa, les autres sont essentiellement l ’oeuvre de Y. I. Sirotine. L’auteur principal de ce livre, Youri Isakovitch Sirotine (1923-1974), est mort prématurément avant la parution de la première édition de ce livre et, de ce fait, nombre de ses idées créatrices sont restées inachevées. Il est nécessaire de souligner que le livre s’appuie, pour une grande part, sur les études originales de Y. Sirotine, notamment sur l’élasticité des cristaux, la symétrie des transformations de phases, la symétrie magnétique, etc. Traduit du russe par O. docs.description: Specialists in all fields of medicine practising in the tropics, subtropics, or any other climatic zones should be familiar with the pathognomonic features of diseases common to warm climates. The constantly expanding scope of travel between various countries and the migration of populations are the causes of sporadic appearances in temperate and northern zones of so-called tropical diseases, brought in from abroad. Local doctors must therefore be conversant with the diagnosis and treatment of such diseases. Long-term activities in the field of tropical medicine (both parasitogenic and otherwise) have led the authors to compile this manual containing descriptions of all the most important and widespread diseases of the tropics and subtropics. Diseases of lesser importance or those with controversial nosology are not presented. This work is fundamentally a clinical manual focusing primarily on the clinical findings, pathogenesis, and treatment of ailments in hot climates. The epidemiologic, parasitologic, and prophylactic aspects are discussed briefly, only to the extent required for a comprehensive exposition of the problems involved in each nosologic form. Moreover, the authors have found it desirable to discuss the clinical aspects and pathogenesis of climatic pathology specific to torrid zones (e.g., the effect of environmental heat on fluid and electrolyte metabolism, nutrition, the cardiovascular system, etc.). The manual is intended for a wide range of medical specialists. Translated from the Russian by Miriam Katz

docs.description: S. Mstislavsky's Rook-Herald of Spring (1955) is a Soviet-era novel aimed at young readers, blending adventure and revolutionary themes. The story follows a young protagonist navigating the underground revolutionary movement in pre-revolutionary Russia, featuring clandestine meetings, police pursuits, and acts of defiance against the tsarist regime. Structured in two parts, the narrative includes dramatic episodes such as escapes, strikes, and imprisonment, culminating in the 1905 Revolution, where the characters participate in the broader struggle for workers' rights and social change. Written as part of the "Soviet Literature for Young People" series, the novel combines historical context with moral and ideological lessons, typical of socialist realism. The green-cloth-bound original edition, published by the Foreign Languages Publishing House, reflects its intended role in promoting Soviet values among youth, though it is now a rare collectible. The book’s episodic structure—spanning hideouts, printshops, and labor strikes—mirrors the turbulent era it depicts, offering a dramatized yet educational perspective on early 20th-century revolutionary activism  A story about N. Bauman Translated from the Russian by David Skvirsky Edited by Violet Lansbury Dutt Designed by A. Livanov and V. Chistyakov

Through the story of Dorian Gray, whose portrait bears the scars of his corruption while he remains outwardly youthful, Wilde illustrates the perils of a society fixated on materialism and self-indulgence. Dorian’s descent into vice serves as a cautionary tale, revealing how the pursuit of personal pleasure at the expense of ethical principles ultimately leads to destruction. The novel challenges readers to reflect on the emptiness of individualism when it is divorced from a sense of social responsibility. Preface by E. V. Kornilova Commentary by O. M. docs.creator: Yu. G. Shafer ( Ed.)
docs.description: Cosmic-ray physics is now entering a new stage of development, characterised by a clear emphasis on space physics in cosmic-ray research. In addition, the nuclear aspect of cosmic-ray physics is receiving particular attention in the range of ultrahigh energies, which remain unattainable in laboratory conditions. The enormous advances made thus far in the exploration of space have further stimulated interest in space physics. The use of artificial satellites and rockets has made it possible to address several important theoretical problems in astrophysics, as well as certain practical challenges—especially those related to the prediction of solar radiation bursts and their space-time distribution—in order to ensure the safety of manned space flights. The First All-Union Conference on the Space Physics Aspect of Cosmic-Ray Research, held in Yakutsk from 23 August to 2 September 1962, is further evidence of the radical changes currently taking place in cosmic-ray physics. This conference generated keen interest among Soviet scientists, resulting in the posing and discussion of a large number of scientific problems. One hundred and ten scientists participated in the conference, which was convened under the joint auspices of the Cosmic-Ray Council of the USSR Academy of Sciences, the Siberian Division of the Academy, and the Yakutsk Branch of the Siberian Division of the Academy. The participants represented twenty-six scientific institutions and universities across the Soviet Union. At the conference, seventy-five reports were presented and discussed. These covered a wide range of topics in space physics and related disciplines, including geophysics, solar physics and astronomy, neutrino physics, the neutrino and cosmogony, the origin of cosmic rays, cosmic-ray variations, electromagnetic conditions in interplanetary space, solar cosmic rays, primary galactic and extragalactic radiation, extensive air showers of cosmic rays, nuclear interactions and spectra of π-mesons at high and ultrahigh energies, meteorological effects in cosmic rays, the ionosphere, the upper atmosphere, research methods, and experimental techniques. Forty-two of the reports presented at the conference are included in this collection. Several others, still in preparation at the time this collection went to press, will be published in scientific journals. Translated and Edited by R. docs.description: Mathematical Methods of Cybernetics presents a unified introduction to the mathematical foundations of control, optimization, and decision-making in complex systems. Bringing together concepts from cybernetics, systems theory, probability, graph theory, statistics, and operations research, the book shows how diverse optimization techniques are interconnected through common mathematical principles. Beginning with the basic concepts of control and complex systems, the text gradually develops the tools needed for modelling and analysing real-world processes. Topics include graph theory, linear algebra, probability and statistics, regression analysis, experimental design, linear and nonlinear programming, dynamic programming, game theory, statistical decision theory, scheduling, and queueing theory. Emphasising practical problem-solving, the book demonstrates how control and optimization problems can be translated into computer algorithms while keeping examples simple enough for step-by-step understanding. Designed primarily for students of systems optimization and automatic control, it is also valuable for readers interested in production planning, management science, industrial processes, and decision-making under uncertainty. Translated from the Russian by M. Edelev

docs.description: La teoría de los puntos fijos encuentra sus raíces en el trabajo de Poincaré, Brouwer y Sperner y hace un uso extensivo de nociones topológicas como la continuidad, la compacidad, la homotopía y el grado de mapeo. Los teoremas de punto fijo tienen numerosas aplicaciones en matemáticas; la mayoría de los teoremas que aseguran la existencia de soluciones para ecuaciones diferenciales, integrales, de operador u otras ecuaciones se pueden reducir a teoremas de punto fijo. Además, estos teoremas se utilizan en áreas tales como la economía matemática y la teoría de juegos. Este libro presenta una exposición legible de la teoría de puntos fijos. El autor se centra en el problema de si un intervalo cerrado, cuadrado, disco o esfera tiene la propiedad de punto fijo.Otro objetivo del libro es mostrar cómo la teoría de puntos fijos utiliza ideas combinatorias relacionadas con la descomposición (triangulación) de figuras en partes distintas llamadas caras (símplexes), que se unen entre sí de manera regular. Se explican todos los conceptos básicos necesarios, como la continuidad, la compacidad, el grado de un mapa, etc., lo que hace que el libro sea accesible incluso para los estudiantes de secundaria. Además, el libro contiene ejercicios y descripciones de aplicaciones. Los lectores apreciarán este libro por su presentación lúcida de este tema matemático fundamental.

docs.description: This book has appeared now for the very reason that it didn’t appear 20 centuries or half a century ago—because of speed. Jules Verne’s Around the World in Eighty Days required a speed of 500 kilometres a day. Outer Space and Man requires escape velocity at least. Before the reader embarks on this book we should like to give him a warning. It has several qualities which, if not mentioned in advance, may escape his attention, and he may not like the book so much—which would be a pity. We hope that this book will be easy to read. We should like the reader to smile occasionally and to stop and think occasionally, but never to wrinkle his brow trying to recall some for­ gotten textbook formula. We know that no one has tried to define cosmic humour, but we have  seen Gagarin’s smile and we make so bold as lo claim that if people didn’t know how to laugh they would never have entered outer space. But this is not a funny' book. It has no formulas, but it does have numbers. It has words like “orbit”, “parsec”, and even “explo­ sive decompression”. When it was finished all the authors and editors reread it, and each one understood many things, and all together they understood everything. In any case, the reader will probably realize that outer space is not to be trilled with. The book is far from comprehensive. Many things have not been reflected, described or even mentioned. But why speak of omissions? If it contained everything about outer space it would be another kind of book which we should be unable to judge. When the authors got down to work they knew of only two Soviet cosmonauts. By the time they had finished there were eleven. The ink will dry on the printed pages, the reader will get to the last part and then how many will there be? We can only guess how many new cos­ monauts there will be and what new exploits they will have performed. Per aspera ad astra—through difficulties to the stars—the ancients used to say. They prayed humbly to their gods and dreamed meekly of heaven. List of contributors M. Arlazorov  F. Arsky V. Azernikov  S. Bakanov  I. Belousov  D. Bilenkin  N. Eidelman  A. Emme V. Fedchenko S. docs.description: The Bewitched Tailor is a short story by Shalom Aleichem, first published in 1894. It centres on a poor, struggling tailor named Itzik, who is constantly overwhelmed by his work and finds it difficult to make ends meet. One day, he encounters a mysterious stranger who offers him a magical opportunity. The stranger gives Itzik a coat that has the ability to grant him wealth and success, but only under certain conditions. Itzik soon becomes absorbed in the magical coat's powers, which begin to cause confusion in his life. As he grows more reliant on the coat, he loses sight of his true purpose, and his life becomes increasingly complicated. The story explores themes of greed, human desire, and the consequences of relying too heavily on supernatural forces instead of one’s own efforts. The Bewitched Tailor is both a humorous and cautionary tale, combining Shalom Aleichem’s wit and insight into human nature with a deep exploration of moral lessons. The tale highlights the dangers of relying on shortcuts or external solutions for success, and the importance of hard work, honesty, and contentment.
